review_text:
CK One by Calvin Klein is the perfect fragrance to add a touch of excitement to your daily activities. Papaya and pineapple blend with a touch of sweet jasmine to create an energetic base. Warm notes of green tea and amber add to the fragrance's subtlety. Introduced in 1994, this energetic unisex scent is perfect for daytime use, whether you are at work or enjoying weekend adventures. Splash it on your skin for an instant burst of confidence that will last the whole day.

I have been a fan of CK One since it first came out. I had stopped wearing it for a few years after I fell in love with another fragance but have recently started back wearing it. I get so many compliments when I wear it and I just love it. It's the perfect scent for summer, it's light and not overbearing and it mixes well with your favorite body lotion. CK One has become my favorite all over again!!! Love it!

review_title: CK One VS Calvin Klein's Obsession for Men
review_text:
Recently, I was sent two different Calvin Klein colognes to review. Being both busy and lazy, as well as eager to give both colognes equal treatment, I spent two weeks with my left half doused liberally in CK One, while I drenched my right half in Obsession for Men. Here are the results!

First, much less nausea than I expected. In fact, none nausea. They both pass test number one.

Next, my initial preference is immediately for CK One. Obsession smells like if baby powder grew up into man powder. It smells like a dentist's waiting room if it were also a Baptist church full of freshly showered senior citizens. Over the past two weeks, my right side got mostly "meh"s from the men I hit on. The women I hit on with my right side were more receptive, but not my much. None of this is conclusive; I haven't tried hitting on anyone in a long time, so I'm out of practice.

I also found that Obsession for Men was far too easy to over-apply. I know I previously joked about dousing myself in the stuff, but in actuality I apply cologne by spritzing it in the air and walking through the cloud, so it's less potent than when you spray directly onto the skin.  Even with this approach, the smell was almost too strong. The smell lingers for days.

Although I preferred it, CK One still smells similar to Obsession. It's got that soft powder undertone, but it's much less pronounced in One than it is in Obsession. One is brighter, fresher, and a little fruitier. Not in a gay way (unless you're into that), but in the pineapple and papaya in the top notes. After looking up the notes for both fragrances, I think the baby powder odor must be coming from the musk and amber that both colognes have in their base notes. It makes sense that these two smell a little similar because they have many of the same components (Bergmot in the top notes, nutmeg in the heart notes, and the two aforementioned scents in the base notes).

Anyway, I preferred the CK One to Obsession, although both left the linger of powder hanging on me for days. Like that Shower-to-Shower talcum stuff my grandmother used to use all the time. A clean if not terribly sexy scent.

review_title: Almost 20 years later, still around, unisex, includes regular and spray caps (1.7oz)
review_text:
Launched in the mid 90s as a fashionable and edgy fragrance, it stood the test of time, and aged along with its early adopters, just like Jordache, it's now "safe" for the grandparents to wear too. It is a unisex fragrance by design and in actual smell, handy to have around in case you have guests who may need to freshen up.

Inside the package (opens easily with fingers) you will find the 1.7oz (50ml) bottle with a standard screw-on cap, along with the spray screw-on cap on the side of the bottle. So if you travel or use this as your to-go fragrance, you can switch caps to prevent accidental sprays while it is in your bag.

It is a nice pleasant scent, I did not find it overpowering, and no one complained that I smell like a fragrance counter. While walking outside, one bee (or bee-like creature) landed squarely on the spot I sprayed this. So it has the bee-like creature vote of confidence as well.

product_title: Calvin Klein ck one Eau de Toilette, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_title: Dynamic and deep scent for both men and women
review_text: This product has a complex scent that I really enjoy. This is a scent meant for both men and women, and as a person of the male gender, I find the musky undertones to make it plenty masculine for my own wear. Yet, there is enough complexity in the scent that I wouldn't balk if this were worn by my wife. I find that I don't need that much to achieve the subtle effect I'm going for, and that means I've eschewed the sprayer in favor or just dabbing some using my hand. At the rate I'm currently using it, I expect this relatively small bottle to last many months. You'll have to make your own decision regarding value, as this certainly doesn't rate as an inexpensive scent, but it is dynamic and deep and I really like it. As a somewhat unuseful but potentially helpful-to-some aside, my wife is quite sensitive to many "sharp" and artificial odors (such as many perfumes, car scents, etc.) but this hasn't bothered her at all.

product_title: Calvin Klein ck one Eau de Toilette, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_text:
ck one opens with a blast of pineapple and bergamot, and the sillage of an aircraft carrier.  About ten minutes in, the fruits yield to a heady rose, and for a moment the fragrance is heart-breakingly gorgeous.  But the rose fades quickly into the background with the other quiet florals.  Grassy notes spring up, followed by a whisper of cardamom and the chypre of oakmoss.  After a while, the grasses fade and the cardamom quietens.  What's left is a mossy citrus.

This eau de toilette surprisingly lasts all day, and most people will find it pleasant.  It is a classic sort of fragrance, but not an outstanding one.  It is nice, but not memorable.  It's the kind of signature scent one wears if one wants to wear a signature similar to everyone else's.

review_title: Calvin Klein ck one Eau de Toilette
review_text:
The Calvin Klein ck one fragrance is marketed as gender neutral -- designed to be shared -- worn by either a man or woman. Among many included components, the citrus and green notes definitely create a crisp and fresh fragrance but the other prominent scents are floral -- lily-of-the-valley, jasmine and rose. This is where there may be a problem selling it to both genders.

Granted, so much of this is subjective  what we think smells good  so what may not work for one person is perfect for another, but for me, the florals are too noticeable. Neither gender residing in the household liked the fragrance  the male definitely would not even consider using the product and the female disliked the noticeable lily-of-the-valley floral.

The visual presentation is understated and classic -- frosted glass fashioned into a classic bottle shape with a brushed silver-toned metal top and sprayer packaged in a simple white box featuring an embossed impression of the bottle. The spray is released in a very fine mist and because it is Ea de Toilette the fragrance strength is light. After an hour a small spray on my arm had almost completely dissipated -- little scent remained.

To create this gender-free scent, ingredients typically used in male fragrances are combined with components typically used in female fragrances. The idea of a unisex scent is not new, but successfully creating one that actually appeals to both genders requires balance. The end result of this fragrance stew is not unpleasant, but in my view is decidedly feminine.

review_title: Smells great, but I only received a screw top
review_text:
Calvin Klein ck one is a scent that I first tried about 15 years ago when I was a teenager. I loved the scent then and I still like it now. It is Unisex which means it can be used by Men as a cologne or by Women as a perfume. I tried it and so did my Husband. I personally liked it better on me. His cologne that he wears is a lot stronger and more masculine. The ck one fell a little flat in comparison. I do love it as a perfume though. It smells sweet on my skin and the violets, jasmine and Lilly scents really shine through.

The bottle that I received is 1.7oz. It is a decent size bottle that will last a long time...providing that you do not spill it. This comes to my one and only issue with this bottle. It has a screw on cap and no spray cap (like it shows in the picture). I am not sure if I received a box without the spray cap or if it just does not come with one. However, a spray top is necessary for me with fragrance. I have worn this 4-5 times already and I have already sloshed it all over my wrist once. Frankly, I am a klutz and this would be a pricey spill if I knocked the entire bottle over.

The 1.7oz is the most expensive size that you can buy (currently $28.82 per ounce). The 6.7oz bottle for the current price of $69 is a steal ($10.30 per ounce!). However, that is a lot of perfume. I would only recommend buying that size if you know that you or your gift recipient REALLY loves this perfume and will use it a lot. For me, this is an occasional perfume and the 1.7oz size will last me for years. The 1.7oz is big enough size wise to make a decent gift for a loved one. So, use your discretion and knowledge of the individual you are buying for when purchasing.

I would recommend this perfume. I just hope that my bottle only having a screw top was an error and everyone else receives a spray bottle as pictured.

product_title: Calvin Klein ck one Eau de Toilette, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_text:
This is a good scent to use if you are looking for fresh and youthful scent. It smells very crisp and citrus with a slight bit of spice on the backend. It comes across as an energetic fun smell with a slight touch of sensuality. The notes used in CK One are: Bergamot, Cardamom, Fresh Pineapple, Papaya, Jasmine, Violet, Rose, Nutmeg, Musk.

I read many reviews about this product being questionably authentic. I have purchased CK One many times in the past and this seems to be a legitimate. The packaging appears the same, the screw top cap and spritzer are the same. I think the reason people are questioning the longevity of this product is the duration of the odor. There are different strengths of colognes/perfumes you can buy. Sometimes designers give different options (at different price points). This product is an Eau de Toilette and not an Eau de Parfum. Eau de Toilette is only about 5 to 8 percent of the perfume essence, and is designed for shorter wear on the skin. While, Eau de Parfum typically contains anywhere from 8 to 15 percent of the essential fragrance and lasts longer on the skin.

Overall, I have always have been happy with this scent. I tend to use lots of different colognes in my collection depending on mood and occasion. I personally only use this as a casual scent and occasionally for parties. However, it could easily be a scent that works for any setting. While this scent tends to fade after a few hours try not to put too much on with each use. It is very very strong on the front end then subsides over time.

product_title: Calvin Klein ck one Eau de Toilette, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_text:
The CK One from the bottle I received smells pretty much identical to the cologne I used in 1996, except the newer bottle seems to give me more projection and lasts a lot longer  - almost all day, from just one spray to the chest.

I'm a guy so if I ever smell this scent, even though it works as a unisex fragrance, I think of cologne, I don't think of perfume; and, more importantly, I get absorbed by the nostalgia of 1996, that entire era of my life, from the seasons to the clothes, to the people.

CK One has a safe versatility about it, in that it's great for winter, has a masculine charm about it like a spicy flame, but it's also light and not overpowering, not offenisve or dense, and is therefore great for summer as well. The citrus overtones mellow out to a nice aquatic freshness with only small hints of the floral. This, imo, gives the hue of the fragrance a bias that makes it very suitable for young males.

My bottle came as pictured and with a screw-off cap that you replace with the provided sprayer. At its price I wouldn't worry too much about counterfeits. The unit I got certainly smells authentic and projects all day.

review_title: Yes, it is good and women love it
review_text:
My mom loves this fragrance. Buying it from Amazon makes it even better: the price is good, and combined with free super saver shipping nails it.
At first I was not sure which option I should choose.
There is one option with ASIN B000JCDV00 "3.4 oz", "Product Dimensions: 6.5 x 2.5 x 2 inches ; 7 ounces", which is a little cheaper than the one with ASIN B00021AJ5I "3.4 oz Eau de Parfum Spray", "Product Dimensions: 6 x 5 x 4 inches ; 11.2 ounces". What is confusing is that the pictures seem to be of the same product, therefore I could not see why there is one option a little more expensive than the other.

I decided to buy the most expensive with ASIN B00021AJ5I "3.4 oz Eau de Parfum Spray", "Product Dimensions: 6 x 5 x 4 inches ; 11.2 ounces". But the box dimensions are smaller than the description. I assume there is an error in the product information.

I took out one star because of the inaccuracy of the product description.
Details aside, I received a real 3.4 Oz large bottle, exactly what I was expecting. If you plan to buy, check with Amazon what are the real differences between ASIN B000JCDV00 and ASIN B00021AJ5I. Maybe you can save a few dollars and get the same product for less.

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY for Men Eau de Toilette, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_text: Recommended by the "So You'd like to start wearing cologne" guide on amazon (of which I bought and reviewed them all) this cologne is another almost perfect male fragrance. The term that comes to mind in this case is "EQ". It just has a perfect range of scents that are very well balanced between bass, mids, and high notes. It is not too citrusy like many other colognes that I happen to like, it is more serious and definitively male. Comparatively it is a more serious version of TOMMY, more sex-scent oriented than HUGO, and has a broad spicy mid-range. Being that it doesn't have an over-amount of top notes that never make it to your skin, this cologne is dependable to smell like it did when you put it on hours later.

review_title: Great But Pricey After Shave Product
review_text: For the past 22 years, since graduating from college in 1993, ETERNITY for Men has been the one and only fragrance that I have used because, quite simply, I love the way it smells. In addition to this after shave balm, I have also used daily the Calvin Klein ETERNITY for Men Eau de Toilette, 3.4 fl. oz.. This balm smells exactly like the eau de toilette, yet it is scented lightly enough so as not to be too overpowering. I particularly like that a little of this product seems to go a long way during use. I prefer to use this balm, rather than other products including [[ASIN:B001KZG4WM Calvin Klein ETERNITY for Men After Shave, 3.4 fl. oz.], because it soothes and moisturizes my particularly sensitive skin instead of irritating it. Further, I have received frequent compliments about the very pleasant and noticeable, yet equally refined, fragrance associated with this balm, while using it. My major gripe with this product is its very high cost. In terms of it being just an after shave balm, I think the cost has actually become downright exorbitant! As such, I have rarely purchased this balm by itself and instead found it to be MUCH cheaper when buying it as part of an ETERNITY for Men gift set frequently sold throughout the year. Hence, my 4-star rating instead of 5-stars.

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY for Men Eau de Toilette, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_title: Still gets me compliments after 22 years!
review_text: Since graduating from college in 1993, ETERNITY for Men has been the one and only fragrance that I have used because, quite simply, I love the way it smells. In addition to this eau de toilette spray, I have also used daily the Calvin Klein ETERNITY for Men After Shave Balm, 5 fl. oz. and, occasionally, the Calvin Klein ETERNITY for Men Hair and Body Wash, 6.7 fl. oz.. I prefer to use the after shave balm because I find it to be very soothing and moisturizing to my sensitive skin. I have tried using the Calvin Klein ETERNITY for Men Deodorant 2.6 oz. and Calvin Klein ETERNITY for Men After Shave, 3.4 fl. oz. but did not care for either of them. The deodorant is not also an antiperspirant and , therefore, does not prevent me from sweating throughout the day. I find the after shave spray to be more irritating to my skin after shaving and essentially no different than the eau de toilette spray I am reviewing here; in fact, even in-store salespeople have had great difficulty explaining any difference between the two to me. Many other reviewers have stated that this fragrances smell does not seem to last very long after spraying it on. In all fairness, reviews of several other fragrances also mention this very same problem. As a daily user of ETERNITY for Men fragrance for the past 22 years, I too began questioning its endurance after reading such comments by reviewers, because I've found myself at times being unable to detect its smell on me after what seems like just a few hours. However, truth be told, I think this likely has more to do with me going "nose blind" to the ETERNITY for Men scent from using it for so many years; I routinely receive compliments about my scent when I think it has worn off altogether. Over the years, I have tested and given consideration to many other fragrances but, in the end, I always choose to stick with ETERNITY for Men. Why? Simply put, while the smell of many other CK fragrances and those by other brands can be quite tempting, I have never been able to find a smell similar to ETERNITY for Men which is neither too overpowering nor too subtle and has just the right scent balance in that it is neither too manly like Old Spice nor too feminine. As far-fetched as it might sound, a little bit of this fragrance goes a long way. For me, just one pump of the spray to my neck/chin/upper chest area in the morning seems to be enough to last the entire day. There's a reason why this fragrance has been one of the top sellers, since its first introduction in 1989. Helpful Hint: If you can find it, the 6.7 fl. oz. version of this eau de toilette spray is a better value. Also, you can purchase this in a department store around Father's Day and Christmas as part of a special gift set(s) which provides much better value overall and frequently includes freebies such as a tote bag or toiletry bag containing travel sizes of the eau de toilette, hair and body wash, after shave balm, etc.

review_title: Relaxing or more brisk? A comparison between Eternities
review_text:
This is an amazing cologne!  However, I choose Eternity "Aqua" as my favorite.

I've had the luxury of trying both on my husband, and "Aqua" is so mellow.  This original Eternity is very nice, with a blend of mandarin, lavender, green botanics Midnotes  basil, geranium, sage Basenotes  woody combination of sandalwood, rosewood, amber.

It is a matter of taste, though; I like relaxing scents, and if you like brisk then you will like this better.  Aqua is more mellow.  I love them both, and please only squirt in the air and walk into it, because these are quite effective colognes.  1 spray on the skin can last 2 days.  You get your money's worth.

As far as after-effects, Calvin Klein ETERNITY "AQUA" is far more subtle, and that is how I love my men - clean, understated and relaxing. :=)

My husband doesn't want to smell like a cologne factory, and neither do I, so please do not waste this precious cologne :=)

Highly recommended!

review_title: Some people will love this cologne and others I am sure will hate ...
review_text:
First and foremost I must say that scent is truly subjective.  Some people will love this cologne and others I am sure will hate it.  I picked this up not being a particular fan of Calvin Klein or Eternity (not having anything against them either).  The bottle itself was smaller than I anticipated, but the scent itself was strong enough that I only needed a couple of sprays for the entire day.

I personally use some sort of cologne every day at work, so I don't want something that is going to overpower people.  Rather I simply want to have a fresh clean scent that will last all day and this cologne seems to do that for me.  My wife is the biggest critic of my cologne, and when I got her seal of approval I knew that this was a good product.

The cologne itself sprays well, and the scent lasts for the entire day for me.  I used between 2-3 sprays a day when using the cologne and didn't feel like the scent was overpowering later on in the day.  I think if you like this scent or this brand you will not be disappointed in the product, however, since smell is so subjective you may hate it (which I think is the reason for the reviews being so spread out).  Overall the product itself worked the way it should and left me very happy.

review_title: Decent lighter fragrance, but doesn't last long for me
review_text: Eternity is a classic fragrance of the early 1990s, when every male lawyer under the age of 50 working in Manhattan had at least 100ml in his briefcase at all times.  This is a fairly clean smelling scent with subtle spices that strikes me with notes of lemon, lavender, basil, and sandalwood.  Some days it can smell a bit soapy.  Unfortunately for me, it does not last very long on my skin and is more or less gone after a few hours.  Whether that is an issue of body chemistry--fragrances act differently on different people--or of formulation, I don't know.  It is generally subtle, not cloying, and not likely to offend anyone; I have never heard of anyone outright disliking this fragrance.

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY for Men Eau de Toilette, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_title: Classic and clean, a good masculine scent for all ages
review_text:
This comes in a lovely bottle that has a classic shape and classic styling.
The Eau De Toilette is not as strong as a perfume, and takes a bit more but is potent and lasting. 1-2 sprays provides a great scent profile for most people. An ounce will last a nice long time in normal use.  The scent itself lasts about 5 hours, but that can vary by person.

This is a woody, green, herbal fragrance that is manly and fresh without being overtly sexy. In the initial spray, basil leads but quickly fades back to being an almost undetectable middle tone that says "herbal" really more than "Basil". After the dry down, which does not take long, the mandarin is an invigorating top note, while lavender lies just underneath. The base notes of sandalwood with just a tad of vetiver give it a woodsy, earthy fragrance and deep masculinity. Its probably got other notes, these are just the ones that I can distinctly detect. Also, note that in some people, after the dry down, the notes can vary in their lead, so it might seem more floral and sweet on some, if the lavender leads the fragrance on them. For me, and the two guys in my family, the mandarin is predominant.

It's a fairly simple scent composition that's hard not to like.

I can't say whether this product at one time or another had a 3rd party supplier that was less than ethical, but at this time, it is authentic as best I can tell, when compared to a sample sheet that I have, and prior experiences with this product.

The bottle has a nice sprayer. I feel like this is a good scent for all seasons.

review_title: Not the Original...Watered down or Counter-fit version
review_text:
Not the original. I have been using this perfume since last 4 years now and previous one was bought from Macys. It was so strong and permanent in nature that you will get the same smell even after 10-12 hrs. So strong that when my wife used to wash the clothes days after, all of them will get this smell from my shirts. This one has same smell BUT it changes to different note within 5 minutes and you wont't be able to smell anything at all within 15-20 min.s. So, this seems to be a watered down version or probably a counter fit. Interesting thing here is that the bottle and the packaging are exactly similar to the one that i had before. If you are looking for quality, better buy it from Macys and if you are just looking for something cheap, no harm in trying this one.
Update 09/09/2015 - It looks like CalvinKlein itself watered down the original perfume, maybe to cut down the cost. I have desperately been trying to find the original stuff that I bought 7 years back and tried it at one Calvin Klein shop and Macys and other places but it doesn't smell same anymore. They changed and sublimed the original formula to a cheap one. So this is the original product. I will keep the review at 2 stars as I am not satisfied with the product in overall.

After searching for an great smelling after shave balm for my husband, I found Eternity by Calvin Klein.  It was not available in my local store so I began to search online.

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY for Men Eau de Toilette, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_text:
Love the smell of the cologne so I wanted to give this a try. While the smell is something approaching 'similar' to the cologne, there is something extremely off-putting about the balm. What made me truly not like this product, however, is that it felt like I was smearing a slew of synthetics all over my face and the tightness this balm left after it dried was a uniquely odd, if not uncomfortable, sensation.

After a couple of times using it and further noticing that a crust roughly the consistency of toothpaste appeared around the cap, I read the ingredients, and Lo and behold I hadn't the foggiest idea what 90% of these are:
Water, Cyclomethicone, Propylene Glycol, Fragrance, Diethylhexyl Sebacate, Hydroxyethyl Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Caprylic/Capric Triglycerides, Glycerin, Allantoin, Aluminum Starch Octenylsuccinate, Ascorbyl Palmitate, Bisabolol, Butylphenyl Methylpropional, Citronellol, Coumarin, Disodium EDTA, Galactoarabinan, Geraniol, Hexyl Cinnamal, Hydroxycitronellal, Hydroxyisohexyl 3 Cyclohexene Carboxaldehyde, Limonene, Linalool, Magnesium Aluminum Silicate, Panthenol, Phospholipids, Polysorbate 60, Retinyl Palmitate, Squalane, Tocopheryl Acetate, Triethanolamine, Xanthan Gum, Butylparaben, Ethylparaben, Isobutylparaben, Methylparaben, Phenoxyethanol, Propylparaben, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891)

^And this list actually differs a bit from the ingredients as listed on the product I received, with the above actually reading as more benign than they read on the balm I received.

After a bit of research here's what I ultimately found regarding many of the ingredients in this product:
HIGH concerns: Neurotoxicity, Endocrine disruption, Persistence and bioaccumulation, Miscellaneous, Multiple, additive exposure sources, Irritation (skin, eyes, or lungs), Contamination concerns, Occupational hazards, Biochemical or cellular level changes
Other MODERATE concerns: Organ system toxicity (non-reproductive)
Other LOW concerns: Ecotoxicology, Data gaps, Enhanced skin absorption

Needless to say, this aftershave balm is now in the garbage.

It is at the very least disappointing to pay nearly $30 for an aftershave balm that it in all likelihood harmful to one's health with sustained use.

I mean... $30. This carcinogenic goop is the best Calvin Klein can do?

Good for anyone who has decided to begin wearing a fragrance, as it's not overly complicated.  I wouldn't likely purchase this for myself, but I would wear it if someone bought it for me. review_text:
This is my favorite cologne of all of the different ones I've owned over the years.  The scent of this cologne is one of my favorite scents in the entire world.  The only downfall of this cologne is what a few others have complained of, that the potency of the scent quickly fades. but for me, this is a positive and a negative. Maybe for some obnoxious alpha males this is the desired effect, but I prefer something that smells extremely good, and you have to be near the source to enjoy the smell.  I have been complimented on this quality of the cologne at the perfect times, when someone, preferably an attractive woman is near-enough to my body to be able to smell it.

TL:DR; this cologne smells really really great, and does linger, just not at an obnoxious volume of stench.  If one is close enough to you, they will smell it and they will like it.

review_title: Lacoste (Red) Style in Play... Classy and Distinguished...
review_text:
For those of you following my reviews know that I am a fan of the aqua, citrus, and fresh scents.  Lacoste (Red) Style in Play is from that mold and I am a fan.  Of particular interest - I received this as a Christmas present - thanks Mom..!!  Obviously, there is some sentimental value in Style in Play...

I have four (4) other Lacoste fragrances, maybe more, and Style in Play is my favorite.  It opens with citrus and "fresh" notes and finishes with citrus, musk, and hints of "woodsy" notes.  It is definitely masculine and provides that "freshly showered feeling" - you guys know what I am talking about.  To reiterate, I like it and it is easy on the nose.

I have worn Style in Play once since Christmas.  While I have not received any "formal" (outside of Sweetie) compliments, it has potential.  The fragrance is that unique and appealing.  For those that like Versace Pour Home and Diesel, Only the Brave, you will enjoy this fragrance.  Style in Play has average, or slightly above average, projection/sillage with longevity of 6+ hours - a little longer on clothing (I like to spray a little on my business shirt sleeve around the cuff/wrist area).  As far as the occasion goes - I would feel comfortable wearing Style in Play during any season, time of day, or any event - great flexibility and/or versatility.

The packaging and bottle design are fantastic - definitely unique and one gets the impression Lacoste wants to compete with Ralph Lauren, Dior, Chanel, and other high end designers.  My only disappointment with the fragrance is the price/value.  Current deals has the larger bottle selling for about $50.00, which seems a little high given the fragrance has been around for a while.  Lucky Me - Mom hooked me up..!!

Final scoring for Style in Play is 4.4 stars out of 5.  If the price/value were better, perhaps my scoring would be higher.  Style in Play finishes just outside my Top 10.  Pick up your crazy heart and give it one more try...

review_text: I have used multiple colognes over the years, and I typically have about 3 or 4 in my bedroom at any given time. One day I was at my girlfriends house and needed some cologne, so her brother let me borrow this Lacoste.  I was amazed.  Aqua Di Gio is certainly the most popular fragrance for men for good reason, but that is part of its downfall.  Until I smelled this Lacoste fragrance, I had never thought anything compared to Di Gio.  I didn't want to wear the Di Gio all the time because it is so popular, but I felt bad when I wore something else because the Armani is better.  I must say this is the only other cologne I think that can compare to Armani.  It's long lasting, sweet yet spicy, and it's not cliche. product_title: Elizabeth Arden Fifth Avenue Eau de Parfum Spray
review_title: a floral that actually works fairly well for me
review_text:
I bought a set of mini bottles of different Elizabeth Arden fragrances because it is really hard for me to resist mini fragrance bottles, even if I know nothing about the fragrances, themselves.  This is a bit more floral than I typically prefer to wear, but I like it more than Red Door.

There is a LOT going on with this fragrance.  Most of the top notes are florals (linden blossom, lily of the valley, lilac, magnolia, jasmine, etc.).  I am picking out the jasmine most on my skin, though of course everyone's body chemistry is a little different.  And it is not JUST jasmine but, rather, a blend that includes jasmine as a prominent part.  There are more florals in the mid-notes (rose, carnation, violet, tuberose, and iris).  I think it is the base notes that make this work for me -- musk, sandalwood, nutmeg, vanilla, amber, and cloves.  I simply adore spicy, woody fragrances and so as the day goes on and the top notes and mid notes wear off, this becomes more and more of the type of fragrance I seek out.  The base notes really work well with the florals as time goes on.

This has what I would call a medium level of sillage and longevity.  I can smell it a few hours after applying without holding my wrist right to my nose, but I'm not getting comments on it from people across the hallway, either (which happens with high sillage fragrances).  This lasts about half a day without reapplication, which is not so far off from similar fragrances.

Please note that this is flammable so will have to travel via ground and also may not be returnable.  Also please investigate carefully and read feedback before purchase as large bottles of designer fragrance are sometimes counterfeited.

If you like florals that are a bit more complex, or really enjoy spicy, woody fragrances but want to branch out into florals, this is a good starting point.

review_text:
This is a ladylike, clean and pleasant floral scent. Smells more or less like a soap or shampoo, and is perfect for daytime wear. My husband really likes it ! It projects innocent romance and is suitable for all ages.
I have had my bottle more than 10 years and have often worn it to work .No one has ever complained, unlike certain other scents that are "too much" for the office. The large bottle has lasted a very long time with fairly frequent wear, so you really cannot go wrong. It is available elsewhere for much less, however.

product_title: Elizabeth Arden Fifth Avenue Eau de Parfum Spray
review_title: Excellent modern floral at a good price
review_text:
EA 5th Avenue is a scent that I imagine a classic beauty, like Audrey Hepburn or Elizabeth Taylor, wearing every day. To appreciate 5th Avenue, you must like modern yet classic florals that are well-blended. 5th Avenue is only that much more appealing because it's available at a good price.

Ironically, EA 5th Avenue reminds me of Elizabeth Taylor's Diamonds & Sapphires. ET Diamonds & Sapphires is beautiful but not on my skin. Thankfully, 5th Avenue is a wonderful substitute for that scent, and it's infinitely more wearable imo. Unfortunately, the scent isn't very long lasting on me ... in the 3-4 hour range.

In 5th Avenue, I detect citrus, LOV and lilac at the opening, which is a bit strong but quickly settles down. As it dries, the peach emerges a bit but the remaining notes are well-blended & none stand out to me. Thankfully, the white florals are well-behaved. I don't catch a lot of powder like others mention, but I do love powder so I might not even notice. 5th Avenue almost morphs into a skin scent. I think I would like 5th Avenue even more if the musk was more pronounced.

I'm not a flower girl but 5th Avenue is really growing on me, and it's a welcome change to the orientals I usually wear in cooler months. The positive reviews for 5th Avenue are well-deserved. I must thank the members who encouraged me to try this one. 2 thumbs up!

I also own 5th Avenue STYLE which is gorgeous & contemporary. It's a lighter but gourmand version of the original 5th Avenue.

review_title: Fallen in Love, Again and Again
review_text:
I fell in love with this perfume when it first came out (1997, I believe?). My mom had a sample and since she was already using Angel (which smells somewhat similar) she gave me the sample. I loved it so much I kept the teeny plastic bottle for years after it was empty. Eventually, my mom threw it out. Fast forward about 11 years and I saw a sign for it at a perfume store as I was heading to college. I didn't know why the name sounded so familiar but I had to check it out. Lo and behold, it was Lolita Lempicka - back in my life again! I immediately bought it and loved it...until I got bored and tried something else. Fast forward another 7 years and we're at today. I visited my parent's home and found my old bottle of the perfume. One smell brought back so many memories. I've been wearing it regularly since. I think it's safe to say that if I've loved a perfume from 7 to 25 it's probably a solid scent for me.

As for the scent itself, I am god awful at detecting perfumes. It has a light, sugary scent. This is tempered by (what I can gather from other reviews) anise. On me, it sprays gentle and lasts a moderately long amount of time. A light vanilla scent. Floral notes. See? I suck at this. But it has a sweet scent while still feeling adult-like. This isn't a Victoria's Secret or Bath & Body Work body spray. This is a sexy grown-up scent. It's pricey, and that kills me, but one bottle lasts a LONG time

I think this is the sort of smell that you either love or hate. From all the reviews I was convinced that I would love it and took a chance, which is something I normally wouldn't do. Unfortunately, I was just not a fan of it and neither were my friends. We all agreed that it smelled unique and interesting, but beyond that didn't find the scent very pleasant.

The initial smell is what really gets me. For whatever reason it reminds me of perfume mixed with vitamins. It eventually becomes a much better smell, a little powdery and sweet, however this is not enough for me to like it.

My old friend used to wear this perfume, which also may be why I'm not fond of it, since it was all over the room we shared together. I didn't know that until the perfume arrived and I smelled it. So that could also influence my feelings on it. But overall, I think it's definitely unique just not the perfume for me.

review_text:

review_text: OK, let me start by saying that I had a big prejudice against this one. All of my friends who smelled it at the store said that it smells sweet. I hate sweet smells, they give me headaches and I want to wash them off as soon as possible. But then I found this one online at a very cheap price and I thought what the hell, let me give this one a try. And by the time it arrived, I unwrapped it and the smell of the box was heavenly. I loved it even before I sprayed it on my wrist. I bought a 30 ml bottle which came with a cream which smells even better, at most combinations the body cream smells like plastic, or like they've added some drops to some low quality hand cream. But in this one, they both smell heavenly. I am a big fan of Thierry Mugler's Angel, but it's quite expensive compared to this one, and even though most people like it very much, for quite a lot people, it gives them headache, and since I'm a sufferer of headaches from sweet-smelling perfumes, I try not to use it daily, or I just use it for special occassions. This reminded me of Angel, but more affordable and more suitable for daily use. It lasts quite long, and you don't have to wash yourself with this one to smell good, a few drops do the job. If I were to describe this perfume with few words, I'd say masculine and woodsy, definitely not a sweet smell even though the bottle may trick you. I'd recommend this to anyone who likes that kind of smells, when I finish this bottle I'm definitely going to buy this again but this time the biggest bottle.

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY Eau de Parfum, 1.7 fl. oz.
review_title: A Sophia Grojsman creation that I can wear!
review_text:
Eternity is a strangely cool & innocuous floral scent that has an aromatic quality. It's like I'm in my own little, light blue perfume cloud that's perfectly suited for contemplation & thought. Eternity lasts & lasts, unlike so many fragrances today, and two or three sprays will do. I think this one is best applied as a mist walk-through.

Chemistry is everything with Eternity. I don't get the spices or cloves that others report (but I love carnation), and I adore Eternity's green & crisp opening (rarely mentioned by others). Eternity can be a tad soapy & powdery, which is fine by me. The white florals are relatively subdued, not overly sweet, and they linger ... for what almost seems like an eternity. I wish the rose was more front & center, though. Occasionally I get something a bit sharply spiced, must be the carnation, and it suits the oriental lover in me! That carnation is one to be sniffed at a distance, not close up, so application is everything with this one imo.

Thankfully, CK Eternity loves me, and I love it back. That's a compliment to us both - I usually don't like florals, CK white florals usually don't wear well on me, and I rarely can wear Sophia Grojsman creations. All bets off with CK Eternity -- I'm one lucky girl. :D

I recently cleaned out my perfume collection, and this is one scent that I decided to hang on to. Worth trying, if not owning.

review_title: strong sillage, heavily floral (but moderated a bit by amber and sandalwood)
review_text:
I got this as part of an Elizabeth Arden gift with purchase.  I realized it had been a few months and I hadn't tried it, so I am wearing it today.  I think it is OK, but not really for me.

This is HEAVILY floral.  There are some non-floral notes, but this opens with a blend of rose and carnation and there's a little jasmine and a few other floral notes that are somewhat more subtle.  My favorite notes (sandalwood, amber, and musk) are here, and I think they're keeping me from hating this, but this is just really more floral than I care to wear most of the time.  This is a complex blend that does evolve over time and I definitely like it better once the top notes have worn off.  I think I can make it work for me by layering it with something more Oriental or spicier (which tends to be my preference in fragrances anyway).

Of course everyone's body chemistry is different and perfumes will wear differently on different people.  For example, this is supposed to have honey notes and I can't detect them at all.  But other people clearly can, based on what I've read elsewhere.  One good thing is that you can almost certainly try this out in a department store before buying, to see how it will work for you, as this brand is available pretty much everywhere.

A note on sillage: This is quite a strong fragrance.  It has been several hours since I applied it and I sort of feel like I am bathed in a could of it (still).  While I do appreciate the longevity of the fragrance, the spread of it throughout the room is a little much.  It is likely that anyone who gets within a few feet of you WILL notice the scent.  So keep that in mind if you work near other people, etc.  (I have my own office, thankfully, so my coworkers haven't commented!)

On the other hand, if you like Red Door and are just looking to buy more, this should work for you.  Please note: Large bottles of designer fragrances are somewhat likely to be counterfeited.  Please check seller feedback carefully before purchasing -- if it's good, you're more likely to receive the authentic product.  Also note that this is flammable and will probably have to travel by ground, which means it will take longer to get to you and probably won't be returnable.  (I see a lot of complaints about such issues, so I figured I would remind people of this here so you can make the right purchase decision.)

product_title: Calvin Klein OBSESSION Eau de Parfum
review_text:
I have been wearing Obsession by Calvin Klein since it was first launched in 1985, the year I first arrived in California. It seems I am one of those people forever stuck in a time warp and prefer this classic instead of trying new scents. While I prefer the eau de parfum spray I have both variations. Although at first this tends to have a strong aroma, this doesn't last after being applied to your skin. I love the blend of vanilla, mandarin orange, peach and lemon that make up the scent of Obsession.

My preference is more of a racy, provocative, alluring scent instead of brimming like flowers. With my skin irritations, asthma and allergies I have no problems with spraying my body parts with Obsession. The color is quite appealing, reminding me of Spiced Rum with the brown, amber and gold tones. Obsession cologne is suitable for both day and evening wear, indoors and outdoors and those luscious intimate settings.

This is definitely a feminine scent, sweet, sexy and not too fruity or powerful.  There is a gold toned rim with the cap snapping on and pulling off most of the time with ease. Sometimes the lid does not go on just right and then the cap part becomes undone and this makes two pieces.

Once the scent has set in for awhile on my skin I detect a hint of floral with wood combination and have read on fragrance.net that Obsession has oriental spices. It really is a winning combination that has captured my interest over the years. This is a scent that is recognizable by men and women and can be worn through out the seasons.

I would not say this is a musk scent but more of a spicy tingle that needs to be only administered once a day for long lasting appeal. The appeal of Obsession seems to run from girls in their early twenties to those of us in our early forties, from conservative ladies to party animals.

Although it is a darker color than most fragrances, there is no staining on clothing, but I do not wear sweaters, whites or turtlenecks. When I do use the glass jar I have noticed frequently when standing over the sink the yellowish/brown tint left in the sink and have to rinse it off as well as my finger tips.

Obsession is a potent and romantic perfume for evening. The prices of the assorted sizes of Obsession range from forty to sixty dollars.

review_text: First off: don't confuse this product with the scintillating 1986 Bob James recording of the same name Hey, put some of this stuff while listening to the album, for some kind of mystical double-obsession-effect. But I digress... I see there's been quite a bit of commentary regarding this product being fake or genuine. Me, I have no way to tell one way or the other, so I'm reduced to answering the simple question: is it an alluring fragrance to be worn by a woman? From my decidedly masculine point of view, the answer is a qualified yes. I note that right out of the bottle, on a piece of simple paper, the scent is primarily alcoholic, severely reminiscent of my simple daily after-shave. But after the alcohol evaporates, after just a few seconds, the scented paper is giving me citrus and floral notes, with a little bit of aromatic wood. Strangely enough, I'm reminded of Paco Rabanne. I'm also reminded a bit of high-end soap. I gave this to my 19-y-o daughter, and she tried it for a week at college. She wore it out and polled her friends and while they agreed it was an acceptable scent, almost all of them noted that it seemed to be "mom" perfume. Now, I recognize some cross-pollination in here in that these kids likely have smelled this before, and the ladies they've noted wearing it most likely were moms, their own or their moms' peers. Given the price of this product, it makes sense that college students wouldn't be wearing it. So that leaves us with the unfortunate bias that high-end perfume necessarily goes to an older and more affluent customer, with the unintended effect of conditioning more youthful potential customers to the product as one for the more senior generation. So, did I like it? Me, I like Donna Karan Be Delicious and positively love Michael Kors and this perfume is really not like either, at least not to my unsophisticated scent palate. I thought it smelled good on my daughter, but I also have to admit that it does seem to be a scent for an older lady; it just wasn't "right" on the teenager. Can a scent convey the impression of worldly maturity and not youthful exuberance? Possibly, although I suspect subtly operating preconceived perspectives on this product. Bottom line: This is an expensive perfume, meaning it will attract a specific clientele. I found the scent acceptable, but it would not be my first choice for a lady close to me.

product_title: Calvin Klein OBSESSION Eau de Parfum
review_text:
This is an old name in perfume, but I hadn't tried it before.  It takes just a small spritz to last a long time and provide all the scent I want.  (PSA:  A little scent is nice, a lot is not nicer - go easy with whatever scent you want to use.  Especially if you are in an office or work area where others have no choice but to inhale your perfume.)

My first impression of Obsession is that is is a spicy, rich scent, relatively heavy but not overpowering.  It is not a light floral.  For my tastes, it is more suited to winter or special evenings out than sunny summer days.  It has a woodsy scent to it in addition to the spicy tones.  According to the product page, there are lots of different ingredients that add up to a very nice blend.  It is also supposed to be musky, but that is not strong, which is good for me.  I don't like overly musky scents.

My husband really likes this on me, and the scent lasts on my skin.  Which brings up an important point - if you have not tried the scent before, I suggest buying a small size to see how much you like it on YOU.  You can't really judge until you've put it on your skin and see how it reacts.  Also, the smaller bottles let you replace it more often so it stays fresh.  Old perfume is not a good thing.  Unless you use the same perfume daily, you'll save money in the long run at the smaller, more-expensive-per-ounce bottles.

I'm not a "signature scent" kind of gal - I like variety.  While I will wear this more during cooler weather, it earns a place in my perfume arsenal.

product_title: Calvin Klein OBSESSION Eau de Parfum
review_text: Obsession has been around since the 80's, and it smells like it too. That's not a bad thing, I rather enjoyed most of the powerhouse fragrances like this, be it for men or women. Obsession is one of those fragrances marketed for women, but men can easily wear this one too. The scent is one that sticks with you like an old friend, and it is a unique, memorable one. The longevity and strength of this doesn't seem quite the same as it was in the 80's though. I'm afraid this one seems to have seen some reformulation sometime, though I can't prove it. It just doesn't quite have the same vibe it did back then. It's still a great fragrance though.

product_title: Calvin Klein OBSESSION Eau de Parfum
review_title: A sexy, intense oriental that doesn't feel dated at all -- even after thirty years!
review_text:
I remember when Obsession first came out back in 1985.  The commercials were so scandalous for the time, and, as a high schooler, I remember smelling it for the first time shortly after it came out, and thinking that it smelled so "adult."  It's been years and years since I first wore Obsession, and so it was nostalgic to receive a new bottle of it through the Vine program.

Obsession falls into the category of oriental perfumes, and it gives off a musky scent whose main notes are Mandarin, Bergamot, Vanillin, Jasmine, Orange Blossom, Coriander, Tagette, Amber, and Oakmoss.

It goes on strong, but after about an hour, it sinks into your skin more and just gives off a soft, sultry scent.

This is also really concentrated; one squirt is enough to provide enough scent on me so as to not be overpowering.

I love scents with darker notes like Paris, Jo Malone Blue Cacao and Agave, Black Opium, and Angel, and this fits right in with those other mysterious scents.

Certain scents are just classics, and Obession is one of them.  Even after thirty years, it feels modern and sexy.

review_title: Smells so good I might slap some one when I embrace my inner Bruce Jenner
review_text: The ONLY way to truly review this product is to trot down to your local department store counter and try it out.  This is a classic scent that has been around a long time, but offers a timelessly pleasant scent; my wife loves to wear it; heck it smells so good I might slap some one when I embrace my inner Bruce Jenner.  Packaging and quality from Amazon are top notch as usual; note that buying from Amazon is much safer than "grey market" where you might wind up with a knock-off.  In summary, smells great!

product_title: Calvin Klein OBSESSION Eau de Parfum
review_text: I have had this perfume for only a few days and I can confidently say this is my favorite perfume as of now. At first, I was thinking that this is just another overpriced perfume with a designer's name on it. I remember the commercials which put a smile on my face as I sprayed it on.  The first thing that hit me was the orange blossom. I never had any perfume that had an orange fragrance that was so noticeable. I also loved the musky smell that is typically reserved for men's cologne. I smelled a sweet almost vanilla smell, bergamot, and amber. The combination of these potent ingredients makes this an amazing perfume. I have received so many compliments on it. Since you do not have to spray a lot on, I think the 1fl. oz will last me a while.  If you have never tried this perfume, you have to because it has such a broad spectrum of delicious, sweet, and spicy fragrances that will appeal to many women.

product_title: Calvin Klein OBSESSION Eau de Parfum
review_text:
This is a classic scent. It had a rich spicy scent that is not too overpowering. It smells fresh and it is perfect for an evening out.

For me, personally, this is more of an evening scent. But, you can also use it during the day.

product_title: Calvin Klein OBSESSION Eau de Parfum
review_text:
This is by no means a light, frothy scent, neither is it excessively heavy or overpowering as long as it's applied sparingly.  I find it delightfully spicy, intriguing and complex.  Because it can be assertive, I've had the most satisfactory results spraying the air and walking into the mist rather than spraying myself directly.  Even with that indirect method, the fragrance lingers all day and doesn't really fade for hours.

After reading a list of the scents (mandarin, bergamot, vanillin, jasmine, orange blossom, oakmoss, musk and amber) of which it's comprised, I was fairly sure that I would find Obsession appealing and I was certainly not disappointed.  What did surprise me, however, was how much my husband liked it.  I can't recall his ever complimenting any of the fragrances I wear, yet he made a few mentions of how much he liked this one.  So for both of us, Obsession is a keeper.

product_title: Calvin Klein OBSESSION Eau de Parfum
review_text: I was feeling nostalgic when I ordered my bottle of Calvin Klein Obsession.  I used to LOVE the scent and wanted to throw it into my perfume mix again.  I was so excited to open the package, so I sprayed it on my wrists immediately!  I took a huge whiff and was quite surprised.  It still has that incredible dreamy smell of Obsession, but it also had an alcohol and chemical smell.  At first I wondered what I was thinking when I was younger that I would wear this.  Then I read some reviews and discovered that the formula had been sold.  I understand companies try to find cheaper ways to make products so they can make more money.  However, I wonder if they took into account the amount of customers they would lose because of this change?!?!!?  How disappointing!!!!

product_title: Calvin Klein OBSESSION Eau de Parfum
review_title: Rich, Executive, Potent, and Long Lasting For Men
review_text:
I'm a big fragrance connoisseur as I have over 20 bottles in my fragrance cabinet ranging from Nautical, Versace, Lacoste, to my personal favorite, Gucci.  I'm very particular about my scents and was not a big fan of CK as I felt as though they were the JC Penny of fragrances.  However, Obsession has given me pause as I find it's rich and elegant scents to be rather complimenting.  I like to categorize my fragrances into sections such as sport, fresh, executive, etc. and I find Obsession to fall into the executive category as it feels like a mature scent without reeking of "old man" like Old English Leather.

Obsession starts out very potent and smells cheapy but, after a few minutes, mellows out and leaves a very mature scent behind that lasts for much of the day.  I work in retail during my days and I found that three sprays (arms and neck) lingers pleasantly for an entire 8-hour shift (including lunch) to the point where my fianc notices the scent when I get home from work.

While I still prefer other scents such as Nautica Voyage and Armani Code, CK's Obsession is a great addition to any fragrance connoisseur's collection as it superbly blends mature scents without coming across as old.

product_title: Calvin Klein OBSESSION Eau de Parfum
review_title: Good If You are an Obsession Fan
review_text:
Calvin Klein's Obsession may be ageless for some but it didn't have the fresh, bright scent enjoyed by my wife and daughters in their citrus floral scents.

My delivery of Calvin's Klein Obsession in every way seemed to be the geniune product. The scent is potent and long lasting, it lingers even the next day. The top notes are supposed to be mandarin and bergamot but after it dries and settles it is more of an overall floral powdery scent than anything else.

The plastic bottle cap is brown and when first removed, the spray cap came off with it and had to be reinserted on the bottle. Overall, the bottle doesn't have the same luxury and elegant feel as some other perfumes the family uses in the same price range.

If you like Obsession or very potent perfume, this will please you. If you are looking for something long lasting but brighter and more modern, this may not be the scent for you.

review_title: Basically it smells like a version of a drugstore knockoff of the old ...
review_text:
For those of you who do not know Obsession is now formulated by Coty and made in USA. Not France. I knew it had been reformulated but was desperate for a bottle also kinda curious and at this price i took a chance. The smell is really off. Especially if you have wore this for years you will notice immediately. Those new to it probably wouldn't notice. I compared it to my old bottle before the reformulation and you can definitely tell a difference. I would say the longevity is about 3-4 hours vs where my old version lasted all day. Basically it smells like a version of a drugstore knockoff of the old version with better staying power since it is EDP. However, this is the new formulation and this is just the new scent i guess. Boo.
****The telltale sign is the gold rim around the bottom of the lid.  The reformulation does not have this.  The reformulation upon the first spray is vile imo and cannot compare in any way whatsoever to the original but the dry down isn't so bad. I will be searching for the older version from now on.

review_title: How to tell if authentic. NOT authentic Obsession.
review_text:
I've been wearing this for about 20 years and right away knew something was "off" with the bottle I received (sold/shipped by Amazon). I chatted w/ customer service and they sent another bottle right away. Same thing - bad bottle - not "real" Obsession. I ordered Obsession from another online vendor that only sells perfume that I have purchased through before and finally received the real deal. Some things I noticed between my old authentic bottle (same as new authentic) Obsession vs. the imitation/fake Obsession I received through Amazon:

Differences I noticed between the real and fake bottles:

The "straw" that takes the perfume up from the bottle into the sprayer mechanism is straight on the authentic perfume and just barely reaches to the bottom of the bottle. The straw on the fake is slightly bent and longer.

The "straw" has air bubbles in the fake - not so on the real.

The label on the very bottom of the bottles are also different: fake has clear label with miniscule BLACK lettering saying something about being made in France. The real perfume bottle has a clear label with miniscule SILVER lettering saying it's made in the USA.

The lettering/font: fake has nearly identical font size and color - but when held up to the light, it is slightly transparent meaning you can see through it when directly in front of a bright light. The authentic bottle has very dark lettering that light does not pass through.

The authentic perfume will get small bubbles that QUICKLY dissipate when you shake it. The fake bottle will get bubbles too but there are many more of them and they stay around for slightly longer.

Re. smell: the fake smells "off" and doesn't smell like authentic Obsession. After you spray the fake perfume on your body the smell changes quite a bit and also dissipates much faster (half hour? hour?) as opposed to the authentic perfume which stays with me all day. Obviously this last hint is isn't very helpful to those trying the scent for the first time since they don't know what it should smell like to begin with - but those who have worn it for a long time will know the difference.

Hopefully this helps - I found it very frustrating that even after telling customer service it was a knock-off and not authentic Obsession they kept their supply and shipped another bottle from the same batch. BUT I must say their service was amazing and they did try to rectify the problem immediately. They also refunded my purchase right away too which was nice.

review_title: The fragrance that started it all!
review_text:
Calvin Klein's Obsession was one of the earliest releases in the designer fragrance craze, and it has since become a classic.  Obsession is a warm, earthy, sensual scent.  There is no floral or sweetness to it; rather, it has a musky, almost masculine quality with a bit of a vanilla note.  The scent is gently seductive--alluring enough for romance, but also subtle enough for everyday wear.  In has excellent staying power, as it lingers on the skin all day long.

Although Obession has all of the qualities I usually like in a fragrance--I definitely prefer musky, spicy scents to more floral ones--for some reason, Obsession is not one of my favorites; although I do enjoy wearing it on occasion, I actually prefer stealing some of my husband's Obession for Men to wear for myself!  Overall, however, Obsession for women is a classic fragrance that I would definitely recommend.

I came across Calvin Klein's Euphoria and absolutely fell in love with it. Since joining scentbird it is now my first fragrance on order coming next month and I cannot wait! It is bright and wakes you up when you first Spritz it but then it dries down into something very mysterious and powdery and soft. I like perfumes that have to be reapplied a couple of times a day because if they stick around too long I may get sick from them. This one is perfect and it fits the bill. I'm not saying it's going to be great for everyone who has fragrance sensitivities but for me it's a keeper!

review_text:
I had my mother try this and we both really like it on her. I would categorize it as a mixture of floral and fruit, with spice underneath. It's complex and hard to describe, as it seems to change and deepen as it begins to wear off and reacts to the wearer and body temperature. It lasts for hours but isn't overwhelming and its character is more of a daytime scent: light but not overly feminine. She has worn it the last two times I've visited with her and she has received compliments, not only from myself.

This is definitely a more feminine scent than the euphoria for Men, eau de toilette I reviewed two days ago. Comparing them directly, I classify the men's scent as somewhat unisex and the eau de parfum is definitely more floral and for women. Both are complementary and both smell great. The metal-clad bottle is attractive and the sprayer applies the perfect amount in one spritz.

review_title: Smells quite nice ... but is also quite strong.
review_text:
My wife is generally not a fan of perfumes and prefers to rely on bathing with good soap and using a quality antiperspirant/deodorant. That said, we decided to give the Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum a try and we're glad we did.

Like many perfumes, euphoria is quite strong and I don't recommend spraying the bottle directly onto your skin or clothing ... otherwise the scent is WAY too strong. This is one of those perfumes where you pretty much have to spray a mist in front of yourself and then walk through the mist so that the intensity of the perfume is reduced. That being said, this perfume smells quite good; like a mixture flowers and fruit.

My wife and I are pretty sensitive to strong perfumes and colognes and we get headaches if the scent is too strong, but the euphoria doesn't give either of us headaches as long as my wife doesn't spray the bottle directly onto herself. If you're looking for a nice, clean-smelling perfume with a scent that is reminiscent of flowers and fruit then I'd highly recommend Calvin Klein euphoria.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_title: Euphoria a nice companion (though stronger and less long-lasting) to Endless Euphoria by Calvin Klein
review_text: I will compare Euphoria to Endless Euphoria, as they are quite different and each good in its own way.  Endless Euphoria, also by Calvin Klein, is a very pleasant floral fragrance, with a light set of overtones.  It compares well to Estee Lauder Pleasures.  And it lasts most of the day.  My wife prefers the Endless to the regular Euphoria because it is lighter and lasts longer.  However, Euphoria is one that I like more.  It is also floral, but it is bolder in its overtones.  My wife says it does not seem to last as long, but I wonder if that is because its intensity diminishes not the entire fragrance itself.  I think that the Euphoria perfume compares well to Beyond Paradise.  Both of these perfumes by Calvin Klein are very good, and I don't think you can go wrong by them.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_title: I like it...wonderful fall/winter type scent
review_text:
Maybe it's me, but I seem to like different types of fragrances based on the season. I like fruity, floral-y things for spring and summer, and more spicy/musky things when it gets colder. Sort of like how I pick food! (ok, not musky food! ha ha!!)

This has some fruity top notes, like pomegranate and persimmon, so you think it might be a sweet light fruity scent, but as time goes on, the low notes start to blossom...they are more vanilla, musk and patchouli. I was sorta hoping that the fruit plus musk/vanilla might hint at the original Dior Poison (which I loved), but it isn't like that...but in the same sort of family, if that makes any sense.  So it is more of a deep luscious scent, not a light flirty one.

I do like it very much, but I think I will save it for autumn and winter. My body seems to react better to these type of scents when its cool. Some people can wear these scents in any season and they seem right. If you do buy it and maybe aren't sure if you like it, try it in a different season and see if it changes.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_title: Good general scent - very warm, spicy, fruity.  Romantic, not super sexy.  Lacks staying power though.
review_text:
To me, this is a good first date perfume.

I'm not sure it's as "sexy" as the advertising lays it out to be, but is very warm and flirty.

A bit spicy and fruity in a complex way (not like a middle school girls locker room, thank god!)...as I said, warm is the best description, like a dark restaurant with lights down low....romantic but not "let's get it on" either, haha.

I also think it's a pretty "safe" scent.  You could wear it most places and not have anyone get too overwhelmed.  It could go in the day time or shopping fairly easily or even the office.

My biggest complaint about it is that it fades very fast for me.  Only lasts maybe 4 hours on my skin. It does stay on clothes longer though...but I'm more used to perfumes that can go most of the day.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
This perfume has a divine smell. The smell lingers in the air, and those around it, can not help but to endorse its quality. One would think that 1 fl. oz is not a large amount, but the way this perfume is, a little bit goes a long way. From the moment it was opened by the most lovely member of our tribe, we could not help but  take turns trying to describe its more appealing characteristics, and all we were able to come up with was a combination of exotic fruit and a vague floral undertone, but not enough to overwhelm the overall enchanting properties of this well received Calvin Klein offering.
There are so many Perfumes to choose from, that sometimes one can not know for sure which will deliver the magic the best of the best are known for, but with Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum there is no going back to the pool of offerings. Like always, a heartfelt thanks to Amazon, for delivering this fine product right to our doorstep is in order, for its enticing properties has brought enough satisfaction to last until the next bottle is purchased. The design of the bottle is quite original, kind of like a space age container, beautifully designed. I can see where certain deserving users might frown a little bit upon it, but for others, the combination of the quality of the Perfume and the futuristic design of the container, will please more than anything else. This one is certainly a keeper! 4.5 Stars.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_title: Musky, floral scent with a weirdly uncomfortable bottle shape
review_text:
I'm not going to comment too much on the scent of this other than to say that it is both musky and floral, and it reminds me of what some of my aunts would wear back in the 80s and 90s (maybe Ciara? -- this scent immediately sprung to my mind as I sprayed this stuff in the air). It's for some, certainly, but not for me. (I actually prefer more "sporty" or crisp scents.) I sprayed some in the air in my bathroom about a half an hour before I started writing this review, as a refresher; I just walked in there and the scent is still very, very present. So, cloying, even? I suppose for those who want their presence to remain long after they themselves have left a room, Euphoria is a solid choice. Almost literally so.
 In all, though, the scent itself isn't unpleasant, and I feel like it would be wonderful on the right woman.

Now for the bottle's shape. It is not good. I have no deficiency in fine motor skills, but I actually had a pretty difficult time -- insofar as the difficulty level of spraying perfume should usually go -- gripping this bottle in order to spray it comfortably in the right direction. It's just such a *weird* shape -- long, skinny, a bit slick, even. I can see, I guess, how the designers wanted it to nestle in the palm of one's hand, but one also can't spray it very well from that position. But, perhaps I'm just not used to it, and it needs a bit of practice.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text: If you are looking for a soft floral or soft fruity sweet fragrance, this is not for you. It has a bold sophisticated floral fragrance that in my opinion that is anything but soft. I love this fragrance! It definitely has a scent which makes you feel put together, sexy, and in control. I would say it is a women's fragrance rather than a girls. I generally purchase light scented fragrances, but this one is a nice change of pace. Personally two squirts do the job for me and the scent is not overwhelmingly strong. After around 5 minutes I don't even notice it, but if I check for it, it is still present. The scent lasts well on the skin throughout the workday. Overall, a great quality fragrance!

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text: What a beautiful fragrance!! My special friend wears this perfume from Calvin Klein and she smells like an angel. Everywhere we go people constantly ask her "what are you wearing?" It really goes well with the chemistry of her skin. It is a fresh smell that has a mysterious undertone. It smells a bit citrus-y when she first puts it on, but after a few minutes it morphs into a darker, sensual smelling perfume. It's really hard to explain, but that makes it all the more interesting. I plan on buying this perfume for all the graduates on my list this June. I think it is perfect for both daytime or nighttime use. A little goes a long way so use sparingly. Euphoria by Calvin Klein is one of the most refreshing and innovative fragrances that has come on the market in recent history. Suitable for all ages. It would smell just as lovely and appropriate on a teenage girl as it would on a mature woman.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
I gave this as a gift to my wife. She is very fussy about which perfumes she likes and will wear. Bottom line, and good news for me, she loves it! The bottle is unique and elegant in itself. Presentation in perfume is important! The overall impression of the scent is floral, but not hit-you-in-the-face strong. However, it does have a full bodied range of scent as well, with mid-and low-notes that round it out. The write-up itself sounds delicious and sensual, with "exotic fruits and seductive florals" and then, deeper notes of "black orchid, liquid amber and even mahogany." For a quality perfume, the price is reasonable as well.

Recommended!

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
I tend to like fragrances in the Calvin Klein line, as I generally find them to be very high quality and long-lasting.  I was excited to have the opportunity to try a full bottle of Euphoria, a scent I had only sampled in the past but had liked very much.

Euphoria is one of my favorite CK fragrances.  It is VERY sweet, so those who don't enjoy sweeter-style perfumes may not like it.  However, I find it to be sweet not in a young or girly way but in a manner that is quite feminine and sophisticated.  The fragrance description lists Euphoria as having "exotic fruits," and I'm not sure that I get that from this scent; black orchid is also listed, which seems more likely to me (although I don't know that I've ever smelled black orchid!).  I would also agree with the "rich, creamy" part, as there is definitely a richness to Euphoria that lasts all day.  In fact, one of the things I love about Euphoria is its staying power--the fragrance remains potent for hours and hours, often still being detectable the next day!

So why only four stars?  As mentioned in my subject line, I absolute HATE the bottle--so much so that I was tempted to take off more than just one star for that!  Apparently, the bottle is "a piece of art" designed by Fabien Baron.  Yes, it is pretty to look at, but as far as using it goes, it is extremely non-functional.  First, I'm not surprised that the designer is male--does he think women have a single perfume bottle that we display as an art piece?  No, we put the bottles together in drawers, on bathroom shelves, etc.  Not only is this bottle an awkward shape and size but also it does not stand flat on its own--that's right, it ROCKS!  I could actual live with that issue if the atomizer part worked correctly.  Unfortunately, just under the spray nozzle, there is a very cheap plastic piece (I will try to add a photo of this later), I think which is supposed to hold the cap on snugly.  Well, this piece does not work properly, as it is loose and leaks.  If I try to push the cap all the way back on as designed, it makes things worse.  Very frustrating!

Again, I do love this scent and would recommend it.  I would suggest either buying the smaller (.33 oz) size, which comes in a simple, purse-sized spray bottle, on be prepared to decant the larger size if needed.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text: Well I passed this on to my wife and she has tried.  I like the smell and, unlike many scents, it does not make me sneeze.  It has a feminine floral scent that lasts a long time.  It is fairly strong - so you don't want to spray too much.  Definitely not a scent for old ladies.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
I'm not a huge perfume wearer. The most alluring thing about this perfume is the bottle, very fun but elegant. Spraying it on, it isn't too over powering, and the scent does calm down during the day--but doesn't fade completely.

I put it on with a jacket, and the scent is still on the jacket days later.

As someone who doesn't normally wear scents, this one does a pretty good job of staying pleasant to me. (I often get really annoyed with smelling perfume during the course of my day.) That being said, it isn't a scent that is revolutionary, it smells pretty similar to a lot of other things that are out there.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.

It has a very nice and very feminine presence and one feels quite enchanting wearing it. I love the look of the bottle, something quite different for a change and looks lovely and interesting on my dresser. This is one that is better worn late afternoon and into the evening unless of course you are a morning person.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
Euphoria is a suitable and fitting name for this perfume. Reminiscing hints of a floral bouquet, wind touching your face, and sunlight warming your skin on a chilly day. That's what I get when I smell this perfume.

It is very inviting and pleasant, but at the same time sexy and alluring. My wife really likes the scent and so do I. The bottle is vastly different from any bottle I have ever seen, but most perfume bottles have unique qualities to them.

I am glad to have this perfume for my wife. It only accentuates her beauty. Five stars!

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
I think this makes a better cologne that a perfume, but maybe that's just me. It had a subtle sophistication to it that begs to be discovered as you inhale the scent. I suppose that's probably part of the appeal.

It smells like grapes mixed with ecstasy. It's something you won't want to stop smelling, though you probably shouldn't spray too much of it given the cost. This is perfect for going out as your date will be drawn to the smell, but probably won't be able to discover that it's you right off the bat. Upon discovering that you're the source of the scent, I assume euphoria will ensue.

This is a very high quality scent. I like the bottle, but it's probably not necessary when you think about how good the scent is. A must buy.
