product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text: While I love refreshing scents for every day use, Euphoria is a fragrance that is distinctly for "date night" or something special. It's not too heavy, yet longlasting. It has a mature connotation- to be used by women, not "girls" or someone who prefers the sickly sweet and flowery. It's the kind of scent that heralds a woman's presence and lingers in the room after she's left. Very alluring.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
The bottle is quite unique and beautiful. It doesn't look like a traditional bottle, which I love.  I like putting it out as a bit of art on my dresser.

The scent is a bit too much for everyday wear, but it's nice for a night out. It's a pleasant blend that seems vaguely familiar. I like that it's not too sweet - I can't stand perfume that make me smell like a bouquet. This one has some musky notes, but still has a feminine feel.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text: Sure - the bottle is neat but I don't think anybody buys perfume simply for the bottle shape. I found this perfume to be really BIG. There is nothing understated in this scent so it goes on powerful and can be smelled for a long time after the initial application.  Honestly, I feel like this may be a better "sexy" scent for a man instead of a woman. There is very little "feminine" in the scent and its so powerful, I'd never wear it to work. This may be an acquired taste for the bedroom, but it won't be spending much time in mine.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_title: Long-lasting, seems to transform into a scent for a male over time
review_text:
I don't think this is a great perfume for me.  Here are some noted attributes:

Longevity:  For those that want a long-lasting perfume, this is a great option.  I applied it and the scent was very present after a shower, through the night, and into the next morning.

Scent:  After waking up with this on, my immediate thought was that my husband had a new cologne, and then I realized it was the perfume on my wrists; my husband doesn't wear cologne.  The scent evolves over time into something that seems more appropriate for a male.  The initial scent is not overly fruity nor flowery.  I didn't get an overwhelming sense of alcohol with the initial spritz.

Bottle appearance - Pretty and sleek.  At 1 ounce, this perfume should last a while.

review_text:
CK introduced Euphoria about ten years ago. It has been popular and gone through some evolution, including a version for men. This is a bright lively yet soft fragrance - and yes, very sexy. Every woman I asked to try it liked it but most thought it more suitable for younger rather than mature.

My friends and I had a laugh about the bottle, which is somewhat phallic, and we are not the only ones who noticed this. Of course CK is known for very sexy advertising, so probably no accident.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_title: Strong scent, more unisex than feminine.
review_text:
I will admit that I am fairly picky about the scents I wear and I tend to prefer for them to be subtle.  This scent is anything but subtle.  I give it high marks for being a scent that lasts - just the smallest amount hangs on all day - but that also means one must be careful in application since the scent is very powerful.

Given the marketing, I would have thought this would have had a distinctly feminine smell, but I found it to be more unisex.  It will not be in my daily rotation, but I will use it - lightly - when I think the occasion calls for it.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
Calvin Klein's Euphoria perfume is, as my title says, a mature scent. It isn't for teenagers, but it also isn't whatever category of perfumes elderly women wear either. I'm not sure how to describe that.

That said, it is attractive. There seems nothing distinct about it. While the perfume's scent is strong, it isn't unique. Whether that matters is a matter of whether you want to stand out in a crowd or smell nice. There are contexts for each, but it isn't like Fendi's or Eternity's perfume. You might, for example, wear this to an elegant professional dinner.

The bottle is an odd shape and kind of a hassle to open without spilling. I wound up holding the top and spinning the bottom. This only matters because a perfume's packaging is part of the purchase.

Ultimately, given the nature of perfume, you are best to give it a test smell somewhere. No matter where you buy it, no review will adequately explain to the average reader what it is like.

Anthony Trendl
anthonytrendl.com

review_text: I was so excited to try this perfume. The execution is elegant and seems luxurious, but the scent just doesn't do it for me. Don't get me wrong, it smells good. I knocked off a star for the smell and then another star because I can't seem to get this to linger on me like other perfumes I use. I did a spray on my wrist and my neck, like I usually do with the more mild ones. It isn't too strong so the two sprays aren't overpowering at all. review_text: I am very happy with the order !!! It is a very good perfume, and it was the best online deal..excellent price!!!

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
I didn't have any trouble with the seller. My shipment came fast and as promised. The perfume seems legit to me :) I sampled the perfume in a magazine before purchasing from here. There are very few perfumes that actually smell good with my body chemistry (most smell like a cleaner, bug spray, or pine on me), but this is definitely one that works well with me. Not sure a knock-off would react differently so either way I like what I got.

I don't like spending an arm and a leg for a perfume just because of it's brand or endorsement model/actress/celebrity... 50 is my limit and this perfume smells great so I feel I made a wise purchase. I would buy again from this seller.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text: I get compliments every time I wear the original purfume!  It was literally half the price as the department stores, but thats probablly because it was a knock off and watered down. I went to the dept store and bought a smaller size and I could tell the difference.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text: Worst buyer I ever dealt with.  I would NEVER purchase anything from this person again! I was not happy with the responses I received and the way this purchaser responded back.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text: The perfume was exactly what I had expected having had smelled it before. The package came quickly without any problems. I enjoy the scent of this perfume. It isn't extremely strong but then again, I wouldn't want it to be.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
If you shrink from bold, sexy scents, don't try Euphoria. Euphoria EDP starts slightly sweet and fruity, but not sickly, and mellows over time to a woodsy-floral scent with earthy notes. I thought I detected amber in the dry-down. The scent is seductive and appropriate for evening wear.

Perfumes tend to die on me within hours but Euphoria lasts for several hours. My fiance' could smell it on me four hours after application. He adores the scent.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text: I am a perfume junky.  Every year for Christmas, my best friend's mother will buy me a gift box of perfume, usually Clinique Happy or Clinique Happy Heart.  This year, she switched it up and bought me a gift box of Calvin Klein mini 0.5 oz perfumes.  My favorite scent in the entire box was Euphoria.  It's a light, but noticeable scent. It's sexy and confident without being overpowering.  My only gripe is that it doesn't seem to stay on for more than a few hours at a time.  Otherwise, I'd highly recommend this perfume to anyone looking for a hot scent to add to their collection.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text: I had read several reviews about this product and after smelling the tester in the stores, I felt very confident to buy. My wife always had the liking for this perfume and when i gave it to her on Valentine's Day she was very happy. She likes it very much and I would recommend this to everyone.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text: Ordered this but the company didn't ship it out in time so the perfume wasn't here in time for christmas so I got my money back. The company was nice and worked with me on the return. Got all my money back on what I paid.

product_title: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text: This is an excellent product.  I highly reccomend it.  The scent lasts all day and I can still smell it on my scarf, coat, etc.... I love it!

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text: Calvin Klein's Eternity just isn't for me.  It does have a floral smell, but it's harsh.  After wearing it for a while, I felt like taking a shower.  I kept it onto see if it would change over time.  While it did mellow out some it still wasn't appealing to me.  I know that some people have a different body chemistry, so I tried just wearing it on my clothes.  It actually was even less appealing that way.  My husband and my daughter didn't like it either.  I know that this is a beloved fragrance, but it is not for me.

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text: This was a gift for my wife. While Eternity for Men is a very musky and woody fragrance, the women's Eternity has more floral notes and none of the wood. The top notes are sage and mandarin, with a mix of muguet, white lily, marigold and narcissus. I found when my wife wears this fragrance it is not overpowering for me to be around however it did taper off to where I could barely detect it by the end of the day (if at all) so it isn't particularly long lasting.  There are so many parfum choices and I think this is a nice compromise that shouldn't offend anyone in an office environment. I think it is an attractive and classy option for someone that wants something light and pleasant.

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
It's hard to separate Eternity the scent from Eternity the image. Eternity the scent was created by Sophia Grojsman in 1988 (other scents she created: Lancome's Tresor, Estee Lauder's White Linen, Prescriptives/Clinique Calyx and YSL Paris) and is a white flower scent with a hint of green. It's lily of the valley with a bit of violet, some carnation and then white musk to give it some base. It lasts on the skin and smells unique. To me, it continues to smell clean and white, even now. I don't think it smells old fashioned or '80's'. The longer you wear it the more the white musk comes out. (Keep in mind this is NOT a dirty musk or patchouli-it's a sheer, almost crystal musk that's ripe and gives the scent staying power on the skin)
The images of it are the Herb Ritts black and white photos of Christy Turlington dressed in white and usually pictured with things that are eternal-the ocean, family. Back in the 80's there was an auction of items belonging to Edward, Duke or Windsor & Wallis Simpson, Duchess of Windsor and, for whom he gave up being King of England to marry. Calvin Klein purchased one of their wedding rings, which had the inscription For Eternity inside and hence the name of the scent-or so the PR story went. This scent was the nail in the coffin of 80s excess-the Giorgio and Poison era of big bold perfumes and deserves to be a timeless classic.

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text: The Ladies in our home, old and young alike, liked this Calvin Klein ETERNITY Eau de Parfum, 1 fl oz, very much. After wearing it they found it to be subtle in nature, while delivering a very clean and pleasing smell. This one is not overpowering, and stands out on its own, and it does have a quality of freshness that is hard to come by, without being ruined by an overly strong floral smell that sometimes detracts from the overall presence of the Parfum. The lovely ladies that we treasure so much, both agreed it could be wore day or night, and for one reason or another they felt that because of its clean, fresh nature, it belonged more to the sunshine of summer than to the thick of winter as to its inspiring properties. Must thank Amazon for delivering this very pleasing, quality Parfum to our door, which from the moment it was used brought its fair share of ahhh's, and why not?, ohh we, from our adorable duo. We had a visitor come by a little later after they applied this wonderful Parfum, and in no time compliments were passed along, for who does not love a great Parfum? With its subtle but definitely quality smell, this is a great choice for any time of the day. 4.5 Stars.

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_title: Subtle and elegant, Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Parfum is quite enticing
review_text: Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Parfum has a fascinating product description: white flowers and creamy woods. Topnotes  freesia, mandarin, sage Midnotes  muguet, white lily, marigold, narcissus Basenotes  sandalwood, patchouli, amber. Upon initial application, I can smell the floral topnotes along with just a passing hint of sage. That dissipates within a few minutes, revealing midnotes that are floral but without being either cloying or overwhelming. With the passage of 30 minutes or so, the basenotes predominate with an enticing mixture of sandalwood, amber and patchouli. The basenotes will linger, making them Eternity's signature aroma and for which it will be best remembered. Very pleasing in all respects, everyone that I introduced to Eternity Eau de Parfum enjoyed its subtle mixture of floral, wood and spice elements. A single application lasts for 3-4 hours. This is a subtle and elegant perfume.

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
I didn't use fragrance for quite a few years due to a relative who was extremely sensitive to it. After her death I never got back into the habit. When offered a bottle of Calvin Klein Eternity for review I decided "Why Not?" What I have recently learned is that I have become sensitive to fragrance myself - at least the widely distributed artificial ones.

I did try using the fragrance and did not have any adverse reactions to it. The scent was not overpowering but in fact wore off quickly. That in itself was surprising. I would expect a fragrance by a well-known company such as Calvin Klein to have more staying power.

Another thing I noticed is that the product description included natural ingredients such as freesia, mandarin,sage, sandalwood, patchouli, and amber. The ingredients listed on the actual label did not include any of those but was a mostly unpronounceable list of long chemical names such as methoxycinnamate, benzyl salicylate, butylp0henyl Methylpropional, etc. Do perfumers no longer use natural floral components that were once a vital component of fragrance?

I did read numerous reviews of this product that claimed what they received was not the true product. I don't know enough about it to know if that is what I received. I do know that after my experience with essential oils, I won't be buying any fragrance produced by Calvin Klein.

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_title: Overall good perfume with decent persistence.
review_text:
From a guy's perspective (me!):
Nice scent, not irritating or eye watering like expired Sunday church perfume on old ladies. Not obtrusive or imposing, and just right. Good balance of high tones and a nice base that carries for hours. High tones appear to have decent persistence and a modest application should last for hours. Good for all settings but avoid over application in work environments unless you are the boss.

From a gal's perspective (wife): nice, not overly strong. Probably not an everyday wear for me but certainly not a reject. Like it to be more fruity.

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_title: A little too floral for my tastes but at least it didn't trigger my allergies
review_text:
I have a sensitivity to many perfumes, especially the cheaper ones.  When I start dating a woman who wears perfume it can be an issue if I have a reaction to her favorite fragrance.  I wanted to see if this perfume would be a problem for me and, fortunately, it wasn't.

I had a close friend try it on and my first impression was that it was very floral (maybo TOO floral) in scent.  She liked it quite a bit and it didn't seem to trigger my allergies so that is a plus as many perfumes make me sneeze and later I get a headache.  I don't know if this will work for others that are allergic to some perfumes, but if you are, you might want to give this one a try.

Reviewing a perfume is like reviewing a color: you either like it or you don't like it. You're wearing the perfume, so it's your own personal preference and/or the preference of someone you want to "impress." My wife wanted to try Calvin Klein Eternity. She's not much of a perfume wearer. Her favorite scent was always Chanel No. 5. That had a sweet, flowery, almost powdery scent. Eternity seems to be more fruity--something almost tart and fresh, like lemon or another citrus.

Again, you either like the scent or you don't. The bottle came in great condition and the spray worked fine. Try the scent and judge for yourself.

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
ETERNITY by Calvin Klein is a timeless perfume. I've liked it since I was in my late teens and still like it in my mid 30's.

As I look back through the reviews, I see some comments about the bottle people received from Amazon not being genuine or not being high quality. The bottle I received is perfect, looks right, smells right, feels right...the same as I'd at my local department store. So either Amazon must have had a bad batch, or people purchased from a third party seller peddling counterfeit wares.

I only love this bottle and will be ordering more when this one runs out. I recommend that you ensure that you are purchasing directly from Amazon to avoid the risk of fraudulent product, like some of the previous reviewers seemed to experience. Also, at the time of this review the product is less expensive at Nordy's, so you may want to compare the pricing at local stores.

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_title: Pleasant and timeless, but not my preference
review_text:
When I was MUCH younger I had once loved the Eternity perfumes...especially the men's. I've been a Kenzo Amour user for sometime now and I just don't think I can part ways with it.

The scent description for eternity I feel is fairly accurate. Upfront you get those strong citrusy scents. As it mellows I tend to smell more of the lily and amber. Still they are too strong and sharp for me.

As compared to Kenzo which is definitely more vanilla with the fankincense aftersmell...sweet and musky.

Maybe it's just me getting older and not feeling the 'pep' that Eternity reminds me of when I smell it.

Simply boils down to personal taste in scent.

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_title: Formula changed after CK sold to Coty, Not the same scent anymore
review_text:
Calvin Klein Eternity was a fragrance I used quite regularly in the mid 1990's.  I was so happy to receive a sample to test for review and revisit an old friend.  Unfortunately this is not the same fragrance I remember.  The original Eternity was a distinctive sexy, clean, floral scent that is hard to forget.  This new formula is musky, masculine and made me nauseous after wearing it for a few minutes.
I had to take a shower to lose this scent and feel better.
This had me curious enough to research this further, after all maybe its just me.  Perhaps I don't remember the scent or my body chemistry has changed.
Nope, turns out this was sold to Coty in 2005 and the formula was changed.  Anyone searching for the original Eternity will need to search for vintage bottles for sale.
I'm very disappointed in the changes to the one time beautiful scent.  I can't wear this, I no longer like the scent and I certainly don't want to feel sick all day.

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text: There's nothing so deeply personal as one's signature scent.  Your body's chemistry interacts with the scents which are applied to the skin, resulting in a truly unique aromatic experience.  I've sampled perfumes which smell lovely on a sample card, but end up being completely unwearable through the recondite alchemy of personal interaction is enacted.  That being said, I tried this sample bottle of Calvin Klein's Eternity on a whim.  At first whiff, I was put off by the overly chemical composition with a spritz straight out of the bottle. However, once applied to my skin, it lost the overtly chemical smell and assumed a more natural floral scent.  In general, I don't favor perfumes with citrus notes, but this one worked for me. Overall, it's quite pleasant. The reason I've rated this so highly is its longevity.  Too often, one needs to "layer" designer scents with body lotions and then refresh periodically with rollerball applications. I was delighted to find how long this lasted without the need of a refresh.  Four hours later, although the scent was not as strong as when I had first applied it, it was still noticeably present, which is really more than I expect with designer perfumes at this point.  I don't wear a lot of perfume in general, so this size will last me years.  Very pleased with this product!

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_title: Not as long-lasting or intriguing as other Calvin Klein fragrances
review_text:
I love most Calvin Klein fragrances!  I find the entire line to be unique and appealing, and I also like that these are some of the most long-lasting scents that I own.  I had tried a sample of Eternity some time ago.  I recalled thinking that it was okay but not much else, so I was interested in giving it a further trial.

I find the actual scent of Eternity hard to describe.  It is supposed to be a floral fragrance, and while I do find it to be fairly sweet, I don't find it to be particularly flowery.  I admit that I am not an expert on detecting fragrance notes, but I am not sure that I pick up on the top notes of freesia or Mandarin, and the underlying notes of sandalwood, patchouli, and amber were even more elusive for me.  At best, I wound describe Eternity as a sweet, fake floral scent--not bad, but not the most appealing fragrance I own.

The other disappointment about Eternity was that it did not have the same staying power as the other Calvin Klein scents I have tried.  Hours later, when my other CK fragrances would still be going strong, Eternity was still present--but it had dried down to a much weaker version.  The only saving grace was that this made the scent a bit more subtle and less sweet.  Still, this is definitely not one of my favorite fragrances in a selection of some excellent choices from Calvin Klein, and so it is not one that I personally would re-purchase.

product_title: Calvin Klein ETERNITY Eau de Parfum, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
It is a fact that 10% of all perfumes sold are fakes. That's why this product has so many negative reviews. Fakes are easily sold over the Internet by unreputable sellers. Stick with Amazon directly and you should be fine. Although the price is exactly the same as the store that was featured in "Miracle on 34th Street" I don't have to go to the store and I don't have to pay to get it shipped to my home. I win.

As a man I'm not crazy about any perfumes but there are some I like a lot more then others. Eternity is on the good list. That one that smells like vanilla cookies fresh out of the oven is my favorite but it does lack some sophisticatio. Eternity is light and simple. Very pleasant scent that does not trigger my asthma.  My wife loves it and to me that's all that really matters. If she ain't happy, I ain't happy.

Highly recommended

review_title: Review: John Varvatos Eau de Toilette  Executive Summary: Solid scent, nicely appointed, doesn't fade quickly
review_text:
I have three things I look for in a cologne or Eau de toilette: Clean, nice scent, a scent that lasts for a while and (superficial me) a nice looking bottle.  You can see me holding the bottle in the picture I've attached.

Today, I had the privilege of reviewing John Varvatosis' Eau de Toilette spray.  I'm an Eau de Toilette kind of guy, I wear either that or cologne everyday and when I find a scent that I like, I'm pretty loyal.  Back in the day, the scents had name (Earl Grey, Joop, Number 6, Polo,) now they have NAMES, as in Ralph Lauren, Calvin Klein and, now, John Varvatos.

I'm not sure if one naming system is better than any others.  They weren't ever very descriptive of their contents, now were they expected to be.  English Leather didn't smell particularly English or particularly Leatherlike.

Officially, from the product description, the scent is that of a "mix of tamarind leaves, herbs and dates, with spice, woods, leather and vanilla."  I can't sense very many of those (does anyone know the scent of tamarind leaves enough to recognize it?).  The official smell index: "Top: West Indian tamarind tea leaves, medjool date fruit, and Mediterranean herbs. Mid: coriander seed templar, clary sage flower, and Indian ajwain. Bottom: eaglewood, black leather, auramber, balsams, and vanilla.  I think I caught some of the vanilla, some of the dates.  Everything else is lost to me in the melange of scent from the bottle. What is an auramber anyhow?

Since I wear cologne or Eau de toilette everyday, I'm particular about the brands that I like.  For years, I've been a Joop man.  Now I'm happy to change it up.  The Varvatos scent is clean and lovely and it goes on easily, stays on.  I put it on several hours ago and I can still smell it. It is not overwhelming.  I asked my wife for thoughts and she said it smelled great.

And the bottle looks great as well!

All in all, a winner!  I like it, will likely wear it for as long as it will last.  The test though is that as of right now, I'll buy more when the present bottle is emptied!

review_text:
I'm not that great at dissecting a fragrance into components -- high and low notes, etc.  I will say, though, that the overall effect is very pleasant and also very masculine.  I have heard that olfactory experiences have the most strongly rooted memories and can conjure up feelings and impressions based on those things, even if you aren't sure where they are coming from. With that in mind, for me, this fragrance makes me think of things like "grown up", "strength", and "suave" -- all good attributes for any guy to have.

In my opinion, the atomizer (the part that actually sprays) produces the right size of droplets and the pump gives just about the right amount for 1 full spritz.  I like to wear only a very light scent, so a single spritz in the air and then walk through the "cloud" is all I need.  At that rate, this bottle is likely to last a very long time.  Like, well over a year, I would guess.

It's hard to tell how long a scent lasts on one's self because the longer you wear it, the more your nose ignores it.  After about 3 hours, I didn't smell it anymore, but when I got home from work (8+ hrs after application), my wife could still get a trace of it when she "looked" for it.  For me, that's just about right.

product_title: John Varvatos Eau de Toilette Spray, 4.2 fl. Oz. mens cologne
review_text:
I really like this fragrance. It's relatively muted and I feel that it leaves a rich aroma. Kind of interesting that some reviews comment on the longevity of the product. Understand that this product is a Eau de Toilette. Eau de Toilette sprays are 5-15% and last typically for about 3 hours. A perfume is 15-20% and can last for 5-8 hours, so know what you're buying and how long you want your fragrance to last.

The bottle itself has a nice black leather wrap. The spritz is not a huge blast, which I've found to be an issue in some sprayer bottles. You will not be overpowered with one shot. I typically spray into the air and walk into the spritz so it's not too much. Do this in my undershirt, mainly aiming for the base of the neck and chest area. This allows products to combine with your natural pheromones, producing a unique scent which is only you. A dab under your ears is great when your date is leaning in close to you. If you have dry skin, you can use a bit more since your skin absorbs more of the product.

I'll just say that I like the scent, colognes smell differently on everyone for the reason I mentioned above. So it's not much point getting too much into the layers of the product which the manufacturer has already laid out.

review_text:
Purchased directly from Amazon and not a reseller.
I have purchased this item before from a major department store and know what it smells like and how long it lasts.
This product box was wrapped in cellophane and sealed with a strip of Scotch tape!
Opened it and tested it and it was heavy with the smell of alcohol. Spritzed on my wrist until dripping
and it smelled very weak and less than 5 minutes later the fragrance almost completely disappeared.
Was leary of getting a fake and that is why I purchased from Amazon presuming they would have better control of the product.
Thought at the very least that I could return it if there was a problem.
Turns out that Amazon won't even let me return the item or even complain to them about it when I tried to return it online.
$40 down the toilet.
If you purchase online and even from Amazon it seems there is a very good chance of getting a fake and you have zero recourse.
Just also want to add that when you get the authentic John Varvatos it is a very nice cologne. This one and Armani Code are my favorites and get the most favorable comments from the opposite sex.

Update
Even though the option to return is unavailable online, I contacted Amazon customer service directly and they promptly issued me a refund for this product without any hassle.
Thumbs up to Amazon and that's why they get most of my money. :)

product_title: John Varvatos Eau de Toilette Spray, 4.2 fl. Oz. mens cologne
review_text:
Varvatos eponymous cologne.

This is one of my very few "go-to" colognes. It is not a "hard" fragrance that screams for attention, but rather a subtle blend of leather, vanilla, and a touch of warm herbs.

Wearing this is like carrying an atmosphere of relaxed warmth around you.

This is a fragrance for the manly man who's already taken. It won't draw attention from anyone more than 6-inches away, but once your girl is right up next to you, this will keep her there practically indefinitely.

Unlike some colognes this is clothing-safe, and any over-spray onto clothes won't cause staining.

I generally find that a couple of sprays on each wrist will dry down nicely within 20 minutes and then last for anywhere from 5-8 hours.

Final verdict: if you're looking for a fragrance that'll get you noticed by strangers, look elsewhere. But if you're looking for a fragrance that'll make your one-and-only want to snuggle up with you on the couch while you read some leatherbound classic, look no further.

review_title: Makes me want to do certain naughty things to my boyfriend
review_text:
I purchased this for my boyfriend from here because this vendor has a great competitive price than elsewhere.
This review is coming from a FEMALE, so it will be more objective.
What does it smell like to me? It smells like a handsome man wearing a tuxedo, holding the door open for me with one hand, lifting a 50 pound weight with the other while he compliments my appearance and tells me I have a great personality. It smells like a dream, like the inside of a new car or new shoes, like the scent of a pillow after a hard day of work. like hot chocolate on a cold winter day, like the relief you feel from drinking water after being dehydrated. I associate this John Varvatos cologne with my boyfriend. It's his signature scent and it suits him so well. This instantly comforts me if I catch a whiff of it at a department store or on someone else. It's a perfectly balanced smell...not too overbearing but not too subtle. Rather it emanates just enough to give him an attractive, alluring and sensuous smell that I LOVE. I'm not sure why others say it doesn't last long. I'm able to detect it the whole day when my guy wears it. Of course the smell fades out a bit at the end of the day, and you need to get close enough to still smell it, but that's the POINT. Varvatos knows what he's doing, by the end of the day you should be getting close with your woman if you know what I mean ;)
I wouldnt recommend this because I don't want everyone smelling as good as my boyfriend, but it's the best cologne out there.

review_title: Big bottle and chicks dig it
review_text:
I started using Chrome about 10 years ago as a gift from my now ex-wife. A recent ex-GF got me the travel/sample tubes of this since you can't get this bottle through airport security. So clearly this is important to women.

I get lots of comments like "Now that's how a man should smell!" and "What brand of cologne is that; I need to get some for my husband?" and even the more creepy "You smell really good!". No coworker has ever had a bad reaction.

I see a lot of asthma/COPD and frail elderly patients in my practice. I spray this on heavily in the morning because its fragrance is a little on the "light" side. I have never once had a patient react or even mention the cologne. Often they tell me that visits with other practitioners and nurses have been almost intolerable due to their reaction to the perfume and cologne. Really, in healthcare, we're not even supposed to be using products like this but I have now tested it over many years now.

I almost don't want to recommend this. Not many guys use it and I'd like to keep it that way as long as the company doesn't go out of business!

review_title: People Follow Me Around to Smell It!
review_text: I've looked for THE perfume for me, all my life--I've worn others for a long time (White Shoulders,Chanel#5), but I just could not capture that "I'll wear it forever" scent for me. There were many I liked...but none that made me go "THAT'S IT!!" When I read a description of this scent on a book about perfume, it sounded exactly like the scent I'd been searching for--and the extremely star-stingy authors gave it a 5 out of 5! That did it for me. I ordered it. And it was the beginning of a love affair--I will never, ever, until I die, wear any other scent. It fits all my criteria, which are numerous: it has to be subtle (I'm a teacher, I cannot wear heavy scents), it has to last a long time with a delicious "dry-down", it has to be sweet but with a hint of oriental so it isn't TOO sweet, and it could not be too expensive. And Tocade fit them all, to perfection. In the years I've been wearing it, I have had men follow me and ask what scent I am wearing at least a dozen times, if not more. Women do too. I've been asked so many times I've just printed all the info on 3x5 cards, and I hand them out. Once there was an older gent in the grocery store who was following my every footstep--I finally turned around and said "are you wondering what scent I'm wearing?" His jaw dropped, he was so shocked--but he said YES, he wanted his wife to wear that scent, but he couldn't get up the courage to stop me! I smiled and handed him a card. :-) Now for the other side--there's a lady who works near me and is allergic to all perfumes...and she isn't shy about asking you not to wear it! She was talking to me one day and said it was really hard on her, because some people wouldn't stop wearing fragrances (actually I wouldn't either), and she turned to me and said "Susan, you always smell so good but I know you don't wear perfume, because I never feel sneezy when you're around." (LOL!!!) So it seems to have super-powers, too. Love this stuff.

product_title: Rochas Tocade Eau de Toilette, 3.3 fl. oz.
review_text:
I've been so tempted to buy this here. What's not to love? The spaceship bottle is awesome and the price is right. Thankfully, I managed to find a sample first.

Tocade surprised me. Some people say Tocade is dated, and I have to agree, at least at the opening.

Complex? Not to me - just too much going on to make out any structure, theme or notes. It's a muddled, sweet mess on me, probably due to the deadly mix of jasmine, LOV and freesia, which I infrequently wear well. Yah, I catch the amber-vanilla base, but there's too much going on otherwise in this cloying, sweet, white floral.

Rose? Orchid? Orris? Magnolia? Really?

As it dries, Tocade is almost hysterically sweet and on the edge of cloying. Tocade seems to be the mother to Roucel's other over-the-top sweeties, like Lolita Lempicka's L & Coral and Dunhill Desire for Woman. Of these, I can tolerate Dunhill Desire. Hardly a ringing endorsement. Yet, I'm growing quite fond of Roucel's other affordable masterpieces - Oro & L'Instant.

I've been tempted by good prices on the spaceship bottle, and I'm so glad I didn't blind buy this one. I don't like this. Not. At. All.

Try it before you buy it.

review_title: Intriguing scent with unique notes of vanilla and other aromas
review_text:
This is an intriguing fragrance.  Upon application, there are several different notes.  There was definitely a powdery aspect to the scent, but a sophisticated powder--warm, with almost an oriental quality, perhaps due to the "amber" listed in the description.  The description also notes that this fragrance is supposed to have an "overdose" of vanilla--there is a subtle air of vanilla, but I certainly did not find this to be dominant.

Still, I liked this scent and was interested to see how it developed on my skin.  Unfortunately, it became more subtle rather than more complex.  Although I liked the fragrance, as time wore on, I could barely detect it on my skin.  It was certainly a pleasant, soft fragrance, but quite light.

In the end, I found that this fragrance offered a subtle--if refined--scent of powder and light vanilla.  As noted, it's quite pleasant, although perhaps not worth the price tag.  Overall, I rate this product 3 1/2 stars.

review_title: Warm & inviting with notes of Amber and vanilla
review_text:
A really nice scent, with the Amber on top but with the floral lightly in the background. This has a much nicer smell than most of the other Amber based perfumes that I've smelled. It could be really overwhelming if you sprayed a lot on but sprayed lightly - it's lovely, and kind of a warm scent.

 It comes in a generously sized bottle so you can enjoy the fragrance for awhile.

My SO liked it, and I liked it on her.

product_title: Rochas Tocade Eau de Toilette, 3.3 fl. oz.
review_text: First thought: rich, floral, heady..in your face to start with.  Relax, it mellows and you're able to be aware of the different parts.  I can kind of pick out the vanilla and magnolia.  It becomes more subtle but still really is a night time fragrance.that can be smelled on your skin hours later.  It reminds me of Shalimar..in the sense that you wouldn't put that on to go to work but it's intensity is perfect for nights.  Rochas is a well known perfume maker in Paris and this is a generously sized bottle for the price..enjoy!

product_title: Rochas Tocade Eau de Toilette, 3.3 fl. oz.
review_text: When I read the description of this perfume, I thought it sounded so yummy.  It isn't.  The only thing the description got right was that it smelled of amber.  I was excited when I opened the box and pulled out this beautiful bottle, filled with a perfume the color of honey.  I opened the lid, took a sniff, and WOW it smelled just awful!  Still, I thought, it may smell better on.  It didn't.  It reeks.  It smelled so bad I had to jump in the shower and throw my clothes in the washer to get that smell away from my nose and to avoid offending other noses.

product_title: Rochas Tocade Eau de Toilette, 3.3 fl. oz.
review_title: A delicate scent that is not overpowering
review_text:
It is hard to review a perfume since the scent changes from person to person. I had not tried Toscade before and found it to have a delicate flowery fragrance. Very light tones of amber and mostly a talcum powdery scent. At first spray, it seemed a very strong scent but that faded quickly. I could still smell faint tones on my skin a few hours later but it did not seem to have the lasting scent of some of my other perfumes. Where flowery scents are concerned, I prefer Gardenia or Jasmine tones and this perfume does not have those. So it will not be a favorite for me.
Otherwise, it is a fine delicate perfume that is not overpowering or sickly.

product_title: Rochas Tocade Eau de Toilette, 3.3 fl. oz.
review_title: I Guess "It Smells Good" Isn't Enough? ;-)
review_text:
I'm really impressed with other's reviewer's knowledge of the industry, and the scents they were able to detect.  Vanilla was definitely the top note with something else my large nose could not detect.  Then an after-current of something definitely floral.  After that I'm lost.  But that's when I detected...maturity?  .Maybe something my mom wore fifty years ago.  Obviously one's body imparts different scents but on my wife I enjoyed the scent, as did she.  We aligned on the  scents.  Basically it had a pleasant, alluring scent.

The main reason I gave it a five is because of something very, very subjective...I feel it is a scent for adults only.  Not your teenaged niece or your 25-year old girlfriend.  It's a very sophisticated scent.  For a special night out.  Celebrations.  More formal events.  Not for Friday night for pizza and beer.  Obviously just an opinion.  But my wife does like it very much.  It is quite potent, as it should be as an eau de toilette.  Do the "spray and walk" as I've watched her do.

The bottle?  I'm torn between mid-century and modern.  Again pointing back to more formal time of Heywood-Wakefield furniture at a "Mad Men" dinner party where the women arrived in white gloves.

Okay, I'll stop now.  I need to go throw a football around

product_title: Rochas Tocade Eau de Toilette, 3.3 fl. oz.
review_title: Smells like Valentine's Day, Deliciously Romantic
review_text:
This scent reminds me of a beautifully decorated heart shaped box of chocolates on Valentine's Day. With a vase of flowers sitting nearby. When I first sprayed some on, it reminded me of the scent of white chocolate or the sweet, creamy fillings inside a box of dark chocolates. And that is mixed with a soft, feminine, powdery scent. And then there is a slight nod of romantic flowers, which I am guessing must be the magnolia.

This perfume is very soft and very romantic.

product_title: Rochas Tocade Eau de Toilette, 3.3 fl. oz.
review_title: Lasts All Day Rose and Vanilla
review_text:
Tocade is a EDT from Rochas, a perfume house founded in France in the 1920s-but this scent came out in 1994. To me this is a heady mix of rose and vanilla and amber -it lasts for ages and ages and the rose doesn't smell dusty or old. (Yes, I know rose can scare some people). It also has notes of magnolia but really, what you smell are rose, vanilla and amber. I read the composition and maybe there are other green scents-I've read Lily of the valley mentioned-but I don't smell it.
I was impressed by the HUGE lasting power of this EDT. It's the kind of scent when someone snuggles your neck you smell good-it doens't shout in an elevator. The kind that's unique enough that when your ex smells it again you're all they can think of (or the reverse!)
What I find amusing is that I had bottles of Calypso Amber and Calypso Rose and had  been creating something similar for myself by mixing those two before I found Tocade.
I'm not an evening or day scent person-as I said this scent whispers and doesn't shout but some people prefer vanilla/amber for evening scents. It seems more a Fall/Winter/Spring scent than a summer scent. But really, it's such a personal scent that I think it transcends time or season specific use.

The scent was created my Maurice Roucel -DKNY Be Delicious, Gucci Envy, Lolita Lempika and some Bond No9 and Frederic Malle scents are also his creations.

product_title: Rochas Tocade Eau de Toilette, 3.3 fl. oz.
review_title: A rich, warm scent . Not flowery... it could almost be a unisex fragrance
review_text:
This  rich scent reminds me of an elegant, formal  winter evening affair; not a everyday scent.  Don't over use it, just spray the air and step through it to catch the scent, so it is not over-powering.  It is not flowery, it actually could be a unisex fragrance.  In my opinion, this is a mature scent for women over 30.

Highly recommend for elegant, romantic evenings.

product_title: Rochas Tocade Eau de Toilette, 3.3 fl. oz.
review_title: A little too powdery for me
review_text: I prefer to make my own custom scents from oils, but I was curious about this perfume. The bottle is pretty and the spray function works fine. The scent is definitely a safe choice as far as being able to wear it at work or family functions. Not offensive or overpowering. There is nothing wrong with it, it's just too basic for me. The scent is more reminiscent of vanilla and powder than amber and sandalwood. If you are thinking of buying this, shop around. there are better prices on it elsewhere.

product_title: Rochas Tocade Eau de Toilette, 3.3 fl. oz.
review_text:
Rochas updated this fragrance in 2013; based on the 1994 fragrance.  It is deep and rich & not too complicated - a beautiful gourmand without the sickly sweetness of many of the gourmands of today.  A well made fragrance that takes a couple hours to really develop on your skin - give it time.

It starts out a rich vanilla with a powdery iris holding it together.  It is not sugar sweet but unctuous like an aged whisky.  There is a rose, magnolia & jamine with cedar and patchouli undertones.  The cedar/patchouli is brightened with the lemony bergamot.  I think some men could wear this since it's not a super fem scent.  This is a gourmand for people who don't often like gourmand - like me.  It doesn't have frooty tooty, cloying sweetness.  It is elegant & delicious smelling.  VERY vanilla but not as VANILLA as it used to be.

The sillage is quite heavy so use with caution.  This lasts 12+ hours on my skin.  At the end I get mostly delicious, dark vanilla notes.  A perfect winter fragrance.

A bit of trivia:  Rochas is now owned by Procter & Gamble (2003).

review_title: Burberry for women; bought buy a clueless husband.
review_text: I mostly went by the reviews, and noticed some of them saying it was a light floral.  My wife typically picks that type of perfume so that was a lot of help.  She really like it, and I was impressed by the elegant vial it was in.  Thanks for all the reviews, that was a big help.

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text: I had previously tested this in my local chemist and hadnt really liked it.  But my boyfriend bought me it for Christmas and now I have absoloutely adore it.  But since it's in such a small bottle save it for special occasions.  I would reccomend this to anyone.

product_title: Hugo Boss ENERGISE Eau de Toilette, 4.2 Fl Oz
review_title: I received a fake perfume, there's something wrong!
review_text:
I have been buying this perfume since 2006 through amazon.com (Ships from and sold by Amazon.com), whenever I run out of it I just order another 4.2 ounces bottle. I had always received a good product UNTIL my last purchase on June 19th 2010. - The product arrived and everything seemed fine so I didn't even test it, I still had some left of the previous bottle so I just placed the new bottle next to the other one in my bathroom.

On July 17th (almost a month later) I finally tried the new bottle and the product DOES NOT smell the same, it's a VERY watered down knockoff or something, I don't know how to describe this but there is something wrong with the scent, it is not the regular scent, it smells more like alcohol with some similar perfume than the original Hugo Energise scent that I know very well.

I thought that I was going crazy so I asked around family members and friends and they confirmed that both bottles don't smell the same. - This is not the only thing I have bought from amazon.com but it is the first time that I have had any trouble with a purchase, I will try not to buy anything else here ever again.

I would try to return it, but I don't live in the USA, I have my purchases sent to an address that I have in the USA and they reship things to my address in my country, so returning the product would be a bit expensive for me.

Enrique Singh

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text:
I'm not much of a scent guy. I don't wear cologne, like unscented body products, and heavy, cloying perfumes on my wife and/or daughter bum me out. However, the ladies in my life like to wear something occasionally (particularly my daughter), so we've been locked in heated battle for years. Not any more though.

I picked up this scent in the hope that the description provided by Burberry would prove to be accurate (honestly, if you want a description of the scent, read theirs; I'm more of a "I like it or I don't guy"), and it did.

And not only was the scent lovely, it wasn't overwhelming at all. It is the first commercially available scent that I've not only been able to tolerate, but have thought was really quite nice.

It's potent though, so it's easy to overdo it. The old "spray it in the air and walk through it" trick is definitely the way to go with this guy, which is actually really great news because it means this bottle will last until sometime in 2264.

All in all, a great scent that makes everyone here happy. Can't ask for more than that!

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text: This is a pleasant scent. It only takes one spray, so be careful. The scent is soft, not harsh. It stays on my skin all day, but does not take over a room as some scents do. I have allergies but this perfume did not trigger them, after using it I didn't get any tightness in my chest. It has been thirty years since I wore perfume, and now I found one I am able to use! I wish it wasn't a spray though.

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_title: Light, a little sweet, a little floral
review_text: I don't have a signature scent, so I'm not loyal to this or that perfume.  This scent is light, a little floral, a little sweet, but not cloying, dense or overwhelming.  It won't knock you out, but you will notice it.  It doesn't have any hint of muskiness.  I suppose the name is intended to signify casual, and it does achieve that.  You could wear it for any occasion, but it doesn't feel like a special occasion scent.

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text:
Another fine perfume by Burberry, my wife says it smells "seductive" and I find it refreshing, clear, and complex and rewarding in the scents that drift up from it in layers --fruitiness, sandalwood, etc. Another plus is that it lingers on the skin for a long time. This is a decided winner.

I received this sample for free in exchange of my honest opinion.

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_title: Light, florally and easy on the nose!
review_text: I simply love everything Burberry and this Weekend for Women Eau de Parfum (3.3 oz) doesn't disappoint one bit.  The bottle is beautiful, yet simple.  The fragrance is very pleasing to me and I've received so many compliments every time I wear it.  Fragrance has a very light floral scent and will smell differently on everyone but overall it isn't strong.  Be sure to go easy on the spray - a little goes a long way.  I personally feel like this is a perfume I will wear day and night, running errands or out on a date! I did stop by Nordstrom to sample the fragrance before I actually received it from AMAZON.com and the lady at the counter told me they didn't carry it because it was being discontinued.  I didn't verify that news so I'm not sure she's correct.  Would be a shame because I really like it.

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_title: Unique bottle, soft scent; very nice
review_text: My first impression was visual:  the bottle is interesting and beautiful - and it will never tip over on your dresser!  I seldom use scent of any kind because it can be overpowering to me, so I applied this very sparingly.  I liked the soft floral scents (peach & hyacinth?) with just a note of something tangy.  I could catch the scent all day long, but I am sensitive to odors so the scent may not last as long for others.

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_title: Takes You From Morning To Night
review_text:
I am not the sort of person who retains scent well. Typical of what is said of me is 'wow, you smell great. What are you using?' The answer is typically soap and water or a light cologne or perfume.  Burberry Weekend is a lovely scent. It is on the fruity side, but quite honestly it seems a bit different depending on the user. When I received this I put this to a better test since I had two friends visiting. It was slightly different on each of us. We all liked it, thought it was pleasant, and yet it seemed just a bit different. We all thought this had fruity overtones with a little floral added to the mix, but it was more distinct on the other two ladies. In my case it was gentle and not nearly as distinctive. It was perfect for me because it was not even remotely cloying yet stayed with me. It did not elicit sneezing from my husband, and he actually liked the scent which he thought was 'Michigan fruit orchard' meets 'citrus grove'. Have to concur that this is a bright, sunny scent that is refreshing and clean.
Since scent is hard to define or predict, all I can tell you is that this is great for everyday use. Clean, crisp, warm, and inviting my test subjects all agree that this is a lovely scent that can go from office and evening and is fresh without being remotely irritating.

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text: I gave Burberry to my sister for her birthday, and she loves it!  She prefers a lighter, slightly citrus scent, and says this is now one of her favorites!

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_title: A very fresh, light scent.  No strong, cloying odor to it.  Should be a safe gift item as it isn't overpowering but is pleasant
review_text:
I am no perfume expert by any means and rarely purchase any.  There are some perfumes that you can smell and right away your head starts to throb a bit from the odor.  I was worried this might be one, but my first smell test of it showed that I didn't have to worry about that.  It was very light and airy smelling...at first.  I put some on my neck and wrists and forced my husband to sniff it and he approved.  I then got in my car to drive, with windows up, and soon it became a much stronger smell and a little thicker in scent.  I worried my workmates would get put off by it, but that proved not to be a problem.  I really didn't even smell it much later on during the day, and alas, no one commented on it.  I guess the lesson learned was to put on a bit less and do a more indirect spraying of the mist when putting it on.

To me this seems like a pretty safe bet of a perfume purchase.  It might not be someones favorite, but I don't think many people will hate it because it does come off as light and fresh smelling.  The bottle is by no means eye catching, but I for one am appreciative of its wide base.  Tall skinny bottles just get knocked over too easily, and don't get me started on cats and knocking stuff over.

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text:
A delightfully light scent that reminds me very much of one of my all-time favorite scents: Fragonard Soleil Eau d' Parfum, which has proven to be tough to find at times. The scent is not heavy and one I can easily enjoy wearing daily due to its subtleties. It appeals to my mother who is in her 70's and my daughter who is in her teens, making me think it may also be a scent that would work for all ages of women who like a light, not overly floral scent.

While I would feel comfortable wearing this in any season, Weekend for Women reminds me a bit of spring or summer more than fall or winter; which I associate with musk and sandalwood scents.

The product description:

"Weekend for Women is a feminine fragrance with a contemporary, refreshing, citrusy tone. A sheer fragrance with top notes of tangerine, tree sap and reseda plant. Delicate floral heart notes of wild rose, peach blossom, iris and hyacinth, invigorated by a subtle splash of nectarine. The low notes of cedar wood and sandalwood add depth for a relaxed and fresh scent."

I really like this one, and look forward to wearing it often. Highly recommend it!

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text:
Even though Burberry Weekend has been on the market for nearly 20 years, this is the first time I've worn it. The bottle is clear glass, with a low center of gravity, minimal printing and an imprinted silver cap. It doesn't grab your eye, but looks attractive sitting on the dresser. There's a lot going on within this fragrance - floral, powdery, woodsy, and citrus. The later is almost overpowering when first dispensed. It goes on strong, so spray lightly.  I did learn the hard way never to spray this in a small, confined area.  It's a likeable fragrance - a bit on the boring side, even for a classic type scent. The best way I can describe it is, a mature scent.

Perfume tastes vary, as do how they interact with each individual person's chemistry and while I think it's a nice perfume (for this type of scent), it isn't something I would purchase for myself. It would make a nice gift.

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text:
It's hard to write a review for something so subject to personal tastes. I will start by saying that the bottle is unique and has a sprayer. Not particularly beautiful, but not bad. The scent, however, for me started out "OK" and as the day wore on it got more and more cloying until I couldn't wait to wash it off. I'm not a perfume expert, so I don't know the proper terms, but it's way too sweet-smelling to me. I was expecting something more light and citrus-y but it's sweet and obtrusive. I suspect office mates would not appreciate it.

You, on the other hand, may love it, though. You really can't tell without sniffing a sample.

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text: My wife liked the smell of this perfume a lot. I like it as well. It is fresh but subdued enough that it isn't obstrusive.

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_title: Spray lightly...to me this has a fresh, floral scent which lasted about 6 hrs. Update: I receive compliments each time I wear it
review_text:
UPDATE  11/7/16: I receive compliments every time I wear this.  Many people write down the name to purchase it later.  It's become my favorite.  My other favorites,  Emporio Armani &  Trsor,  do not have the same fragrance as Burberry Weekend.

*******************
Original review:
Warning...spray lightly. You can always spray more if desired. When I first tried this, I sprayed too much.  It was strong & gave me a  mild headache.

I know that fragrance can smell completely different on one person than another.
BURBERRY Weekend has a fresh, floral scent on me.
After about 3 hours, the floral scent had a bit of spice to it; later, as the scent was wearing off, it became a light, powdery, floral scent.
After about 6 hours, very little scent remained.

I don't usually spray fragrance on my clothing, but decided to give it a try the next time I used BURBERRY Weekend.
Result:  I decided I like this fragrance better if I spray it on my clothes rather than on my skin. It's a bit softer on my clothing, but still smells mostly floral with a touch of freshness.

UPDATE: I sprayed it lightly on my wrist today, & had better results. No mild headache & no strong fragrance, but  a soft,  powdery, floral fragrance remained for about 6 or 7 hours.

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_title: A seductive scent.  Its pretty much heroin.
review_text:
The Burberry Weekend for Women is an intoxicating scent.  As I man, this is the kind of scent that drives me wild.  It's soft, yet sophisticated;  elegant, yet sexy; and oh-so glamorous.  In fact, I'd say it's pretty much liquid heroin.  It holds magic power in it's beautiful, little bottle.  (In all seriousness, It's a beautiful bottle and package.)

Others have mentioned that the scent isn't long-lasting or that it's possibly a knock-off.  I can't attest to either issue.  All I know is that it seems amazing.  I would love to spend a night out with a woman wearing this scent.  In fact, I would rank this one up there with my all-time favorite, Amarige de Givenchy.

TL;DR - smells great.  Buy it.

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text:
Burberry Weekend is a classic women's scent on the market since 1997. It was formulated for Burberry by Nathalie Lorson, a well known perfumer who has created more than 70 formulations for various brands. Burberry is an old line British firm and on the conservative side, and this is a traditional fragrance, not too exotic or otherworldly. "Weekend" is not for teenagers either; it's a scent for a grown woman, perhaps a professional woman. It is a fresh scent and can be worn every day, with a bit of tangerine on top, wild rose in the middle and a layer of musk and sandalwood on the bottom. It's sexy in a digified way.

I gave this to a woman friend and she loves it. Not cheap but a classic and a safe bet as a gift.

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_title: Got some compliments while wearing it
review_text:
It's hard to give an objective review of a perfume; every person has different likes and dislikes when it comes to fragrances.
What I can say is this is a delicate, not overpowering fragrance with citrus and floral notes.
My wife was asked on two seperate occasions what she was wearing and that the frangrance was very nice.
She normally likes Gabriela Sabatini but finds this one to be good for more than just casual wear and liked by almost everyone who notices it.
I would recommend it.

product_title: BURBERRY Weekend Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text: It is a favourite perfume in our family, nothing more needs to be said. It hits all the right notes and is used by two generations in our family :-)

review_title: As many have described before, this scent is a ...
review_text:
As many have described before, this scent is a fabric softener with a touch of raspberry. It is a definite people pleaser. You will not find anyone who finds this scent offensive. I really only perceive the raspberry note (faintly) when I spray it on clothes. It is undetectable to my nose when sprayed on my skin.

In terms of performance, it is decent but not nearly the strength it was rumored to be in regards to silage and projection. I spray much more than usual to try to project a bit more (4 sprays). It projects for around 1-2 hrs though no more than arms length from me. After that, it gets much closer to the skin. However it stays close to the skin but not quite a skin scent for a very long time (another 6hrs). Then skin scent for another several hours. So in total, it lasts for over 10hrs.

Ive heard fragrance reviewers say that although they aren't particularly keen on the smell, they continue to wear it because its a compliment getter. I could see this being true. Though, no compliments thus far (though I really never get compliments on fragrances).

product_title: Hugo Boss DEEP RED Eau de Parfum, 3 Fl Oz
review_text:
Introduced in 2001, Hugo Deep Red by Hugo Boss has been called "The Little Black Dress" of fragrances. "Little black dress" is an expression used to define an evening or cocktail dress, cut simply and often quite short. It is usually seductive. Many women have one in the recesses of their closet. This is the dress that usually hugs curves you never knew you had. One that looks as if it was made for your body and your body only. One that makes you feel sexy the second you put it on. Yep!!! That's what I feel like when I wear Hugo Deep Red. It is most definitely the scent I choose for evening wear...especially special evenings.

This rich, complex scent has green, sensuous elements combined with notes of sandalwood, ginger flower, blood orange, woods and spices into a mature combination that gives it a spicy, oriental and very feminine character. Important - it lasts a long time, so a little spray goes a long way!

I have been wearing this scent for a long time and have been complimented on it. Highly recommended for the woman who loves feeling sensual.

review_title: Smells like a lot of different fragrances, but it's not a mess.
review_text:
I do agree with other reviewers that this does smell like dryer sheet but it is not the synthetic and cheap kind of smell. It has a creaminess/powdery blanket over it. Imagine the powdery vibe of Dior Homme and the creaminess of Allure Homme Sport Eau Extreme blanketed on top of the dryer sheets smell, however the powdery and creaminess only last momentarily and it is is very subtle. It also has the aromatic vibe from Armani Code in the first 10 minutes.

After the intital 10-15 minutes it starts to smell darker, like a Dior Homme but much sweeter and without the Iris notes. The Dryer sheet smell becomes much more dense and dark.

In the drydown, it becomes even more mature. In the realms of Acqua Di Gio Profumo, dryer sheet smell stay in the background and you start to smell the raspberry. The raspberry is very dense but not too sweet. Kind of like the gooey filling inside the raspberry chocolate cake. The scent is still fresh. However it is almost like you sprayed Acqua di Gio Profumo on top of the raspberry smell. Therefore, it has that dark, dense, sweet but still fresh smell.

It is a pleasing scent, not overwhelmingly sweet. Could be worn in the daytime or at night. Sillage and longevity is great. However, I think this scent is not a very formal scent. Because it is a sweet scent it may not be on the reserved side. Very well blended however. Could be great for layering?

If there are any downsides, it would be that I can see Abercrombie selling something like this seeing as Fierce is very similar to Legend. It is leaning towards the metro-sexual/modern. I would definitely try it out for buying because the sweetness is not for everybody.

product_title: MONTBLANC Individuel Eau de Toilette, 2.5 fl. oz.
review_text:
If you search around online for inexpensive, versatile fragrances, you're sure to come across Mont Blanc Individuel. When describing the scent, every review compares it to Creed' s Original Santal - which is around $250 for a bottle this size. I've never smelled Creed' s fragrance, so I took a leap of faith and bought this without having an idea of what to expect.

I typically ware fresh aquatic type scents. So to me this was a little bit more "perfumey" then what I'm used to, but that's not a bad thing. Once it settles into the dry down, it's kind of a similar smell to dryer sheets - fresh, clean, bright, airy, with some hints of floral. That may sound a little weird, but it's really inviting and pleasant. It still manages to be masculine, modern, and sophisticated.

It lasts close to 8 hours for me, and has moderate projection. So this performs really well.

Since its very fresh and clean, this can really be used for any occasion, or season. Because of its sophisticated feel, this could even work for formal occasions. Wherever you ware it, you're bound to get a ton of compliments.

review_text:
If you read this, you undoubtedly know that any description of a fragrance is highly subjective, and that peoples skins differ in response to any given fragrance.

Superlatives escape me as I try to write about this fragrance. On application the first note I smell is a sweet pineapple, which gives way to floral notes, then it slips almost unnoticed into the usual woody base notes. It usually lasts 6-8 hours on my skin, and I enjoy the scent no matter where it happens to be during its life cycle.

Mont Blanc Individuel has been on the market since 2003, so I guess Im not the only one who likes it! There is one regret about my having purchased this fragrance: I regret that I did not know about it sooner.

I can recommend Mont Blanc Individuel to anyone who is new to fragrances and may not necessarily know where to start. It is priced so that almost anyone can afford to buy it; I got mine for less than $30 from Amazon.

product_title: MONTBLANC Individuel Eau de Toilette, 2.5 fl. oz.
review_title: Great Fragrance, However, Not a Replacement For Original Santal
review_text:
I would like to speak about the comparison between Mont Blanc Individuel and Original Santal. I am a huge fan of Original Santal. It's just a wonderful fragrance. I like Mont Blanc Individuel as well! However, these are two separate fragrances, and I would not recommend Mont Blanc Individuel as a "replacement" for Original Santal at all. Likewise, Mont Blanc Individuel also serves its purpose.

The opening of Mont Blanc Individuel smells exactly like Original Santal after Original Santal has dried down for about 3 minutes. There's no doubt about it. Sure, the Creed smells more fresh and natural, but unless you are VERY familiar with Original Santal, you would not be able to tell the difference. This smell stays similar to Original Santal for about an hour. Then things start to change.

Mont Blanc Individuel changes drastically from smelling like Original Santal to smelling like laundry fresh out of the dryer. Is that bad? Absolutely not! But Original Santal has an intoxicating smell that has more to it than the "dryer sheet" smell. Individuel, after about an hour, is pure dryer sheets. Original Santal has more spice. I would even say that after three hours of wearing Mont Blanc Individuel, you can't even compare the two fragrances. If I didn't smell Individuel's opening, I wouldn't have even thought the two fragrances were even remotely similar.

I'm not just repeating other people's comparisons of dryer sheets -- no, this really smells like dryer sheets! Like I said, that's not a bad thing. This is an excellent, fresh smelling fragrance. The best part of fragrance is in its first hour.

I would also say that Mont Blanc Individuel is more masculine and Original Santal is more unisex. I would love to smell Original Santal on a woman. Unfortunately, my girlfriend doesn't like to wear it.

Don't go believing all these people who say a certain fragrance smells exactly like another. They don't. They may share some similarities, but the DNA is totally different from fragrance to fragrance.

My advice to anyone considering one of these two fragrances is this: If you are looking for a blind buy, and price is not an issue, go with Original Santal. If you have the opportunity to test Mont Blanc Individuel, go for it. If you find you love the opening a lot more than the drydown, go with Original Santal. The entire drydown of Original Santal is the opening of Mont Blanc Individuel. If you are strapped for cash and just want to smell good, go with Individuel. If you have Original Santal, I do recommend buying Mont Blanc Individuel, because it is a different fragrance, contrary to what others will tell you.

Mont Blanc Individuel is a great fragrance on its own. It does not replace Original Santal by any means, but the two fragrances are different. Original Santal is a masterpiece for Creed. Mont Blanc Individuel is very close to being a designer masterpiece on its own. The longevity is outstanding. It projects well without being offensive. And to top it all off, it just smells fresh!

Longevity: 10+ hours
Projection: About 3 feet
Smell: 7/10
Overall: 8/10

Mont Blanc Individuel is a great value, is highly versatile and can be worn at any time of the year. I highly recommend adding this fragrance to your collection.

----Side Note----

I purchased this product directly from Amazon and I can confirm I received an authentic, quality product. Buy with confidence.

review_title: Mount Blanc... Not just a pen maker/designer... Great cologne..!!
review_text:
Wow..!!  That is my first impression of Mount Blanc's Individuel.  I later purchased Mount Blanc's Cool Presence and Star Walker, but less impressed with those.  I first noticed the bottle and clean sleek design with the Mount Blanc logo on top of the cap.  Easy on the eyes and a classy design.  The fragrance comes out clean, fresh, and smooth - I detect hints of fruit and (call me crazy - maybe cinnamon).

As noted in other reviews, I generally consider the following areas:  price/value, appeal/smell, "wow factor" (compliments), longevity, uniqueness, best time of year worn or occasion, and easy on the nose (and bottle on the eyes).

To date, I have not received compliments, but when solicited for feedback, it has been well from women.  It scores well with longevity - I splashed it on this morning prior to work including a couple of squirts on my undershirt (t-shirt under business shirt).  Now some 12 hours, the fragrance is still (barely) detectable on my wrist, but very prevalent on my t-shirt.  Individuel is definitely unique - perhaps closely compared to a toned-down (original) Joop - and is easy on the nose.  We have already commented on the crispness/fondness of the bottle.  It is now fall and the scent seems to blend well with this time of year, but I do believe that it would fit with all seasons and all occasions.

Bottom line guys - for the price/value, Individuel should be added to your collection.  I give it 4.6 stars out of 5.  Try something new - you may like it...

review_text: "Femme", French for "woman" -- and is this ever a woman's perfume!  A mixed floral bouquet with a surprize:  notes of ripe, luscious plum and expensive leather. review_title: Strikes a balance between old & new fruity chypres
review_text:
Oh, poor Femme Rochas. It's much maligned for being reformulated (in 1989), and it's under-appreciated for being wearable (today).

This reformulated version strikes me as a nice balance between older style fruity chypres and more modern ones. It's also knock-down, drag-out, 10-times better than the reformulated Mitsouko which sells for much more than Femme's discounted price.

I appreciate Femme for what it is, and I could careless what it was. It's beautiful, it's wearable, it's comfortable, it's gorgeous.

review_text: I found this perfume years ago in France and until recently have been unable to find it in the US. Light enough for a casual dinner, sophisticated enough for an elegant evening out.  A truly great find.

product_title: Lacoste Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
review_text:
The market for scents is wide and varied; despite this, the Lacoste Pour Homme has become my de facto favorite for the following reasons:

OBJECTIVELY

1.  While its initial strength diminishes after half an hour, the scent will linger for the whole of a day, perhaps so that someone leaning in for an embrace or standing beside you on an elevator might catch it and remark upon it.

2.  Of all the colognes it appears to be the only one that hasn't made my skin or nose itch.  Your mileage may vary.  One spray to the hollow of your throat is enough if you keep your shirt collar slightly ajar.

3.  It is a 'warm' scent, reminiscent of Hugo Boss #6 -- woodsy and lavender-ish -- but not as cloying.  Muted, sweet, more natural than chemical.

SUBJECTIVELY

If the scent had a personality it would be something of a professional, comfortably distinguished, emotionally stable, and possibly a whiskey enthusiast.  It is not fast-paced nor cutthroat; it will open doors for women, enjoy the excursions into wilderness, and on Sunday evenings, you might find it sitting by the fireplace with fine literature.  It is a good-natured and kind-hearted scent.

DISCLAIMER:  When I wear it, I am filled with gentlemanly aspirations.  Which is interesting because much of my time on earth has been spent on the genial pursuit of idiocy.

I know that after it leaves the seller that they are not responsible for what mother nature does. So I've learned a lesson today, never buy cologne over the internet during summer. And.. my opinion on this product is... Its watered down. For sure. You can tell from the moment you spray the bottle. The way it comes out of the water, and the feel of the cologne on your skin. It is watered down for sure. But, I didn't return the product, and here's my reason. I'm guessing this is probably the tester version, or if not, they watered it down, and considering this product is really cheap (an actual bottle would cost around 40 i'm guessing) I think this is a decent deal... I did consider returning the stuff but i was too lazy to do so.

So, if you're looking for the original stuff that smells strong and good, and that lasts for 8 hours. DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT. You will be disappointed for sure. If you're looking for something lighter.. and don't mind the smell going away in 3-4 hours, I guess you could go with this bottle. You could try out the smell too. Its a bit different, the top note is barely noticeable. But the middle and last notes are,, similar to the nondiluted versions i guess....

Anyways, hope this review was of a bit help to you.

And to those people who are thinking, hey, I bought this and it wasn't that bad! Well, you product was probably watered down less, or you haven't used the original one before. Cuz this bugger lasts for ages! and has a strong musk smell to it.

In conclusion, I probably wouldn't buy the product again. I would personally pay a bit more to get the real stuff.
