product_title: Juicy Couture Women's Perfume
review_text:
I have always thought the decanter holding the precious liquid was pretty but I was unprepared how gorgeous and mesmerizing this scent was going to be. From the moment I rubbed the tester from a magazine my nose was in love. Five minutes later I ordered a big bottle off the internet and it arrived a few days ago, and I still cannot part with the scent. I even spray it on to go to bed, the sheer fact how warm and softly scented my sheets are in the morning makes it hard to get up to work. This scent melts into the skin, the musky crme brulee base is topped with juicy crimson watermelon, glowing mandarin, apples, fresh aquatic hyacinth, royal smelling lily and precious woods that give it a soft and spun like quality to the scent. I often find myself inhaling the aroma through the day, catching whiffs of my warm body and they escape up and away.

This fragrance is truly delectable with a softly scented melange of fruit and musky vanillas that really smells delicious and not like a fruit cake that so often is the result of perfumers going on a sugar coated overload. The scent is almost an aphrodisiac, a meteor shower raining down the inky sky with fluorescent flavors. This is my favorite new fragrance along with Estee Lauder's Beyond Paradise and I wear it from morning after my shower until the stars spear the sky and I lull myself to sleep. It's breathtakingly beautiful and so fragrant that my nose might never get over it, no wonder this perfume is so hard to find!
Notes: Watermelon, Mandarin, Pink Passion Fruit, Marigold, Green Apple, Water Hyacinth, Crushed Leaves, Tuberose Absolute, Wild Rose, Princess Lily, Tuberose, Caramel Creme Brulee, Vanilla, Precious Woods, Patchouli.

- Kasia S.

review_text:
Have used this scent for several years, before then I was not really a perfume girl. I actually fell in love with this from smelling one of those "Smells Like..."  cheap perfume replicas in a local clothing store. I loved the scent so much I tracked down the genuine perfume here and on ebay & have continually purchased ever since!

Scent is very feminine/sensual with a floral vibe. I continue buying this after TEN YEARS because I still get daily compliments on it including random strangers asking me to write the name of the perfume down for them so they can find it.

On a side note, I've noticed a couple of reviews of ladies complaining that it must be fake because it doesn't last for several hours....
When I initially searched the internet looking for this I did some reading on the attributes of the scent itself. One detail I noticed listed in both professional and personal reviews was that the scent tends to fade quicker than other perfumes. I agree and have experienced for myself over YEARS that for me it lasts approximately 3-4 hours. For me personally, this does not affect my love of this scent and I just reapply if I'm going out in the evening. My point being, don't expect this perfume to last all day unless you're a very heavy perfume wearer.

review_title: My wife loved this on first smell
review_text:
I bought this perfume for my wife for a Christmas present and she absolutely loves it. I was worried that she may not like the smell, as it was listed for a more mature audience, but she fell in love almost as soon as she opened it and sprayed it on.

The scent is rather floral and fresh smelling, but it definitely does not remind one of a young person's perfume. There is no over-the-top flower smells that inundate the wearer and smeller, and there is no wild after scent that leaves headaches or misery. The perfume just seems to have that all-inclusive smell that brings you in and makes you love it.

I would actually recommend this perfume to women of all ages. It may not be what some younger ladies are looking for with its more mature scent, but it definitely will not make you think you are wearing your grandmother's good-smelling nectar water. This is just good fun for all ages and noses.

review_text:
I have been wearing this fragrance off and on for at least 8 years.  It isn't easy to find in stores, so I am happy that Amazon carries it.  I never let myself run out of Femme. The bottle itself is rounded and compact and easy to travel with.  In fact, I frequently throw a bottle in my purse and it has never broken.

I am not a fan of flowery or sweet fragrances, but I also can't wear heavy, musky, sultry scents.  Femme is a crisp, clean, feminine parfum that can be worn year round.  The fragrance is not overwhelming, but lingers for hours.  The scent is very concentrated, so only a few spritzes will carry me through the day.

I get so many compliments from strangers on it and even after all these years, my significant other compliments me each and every time I spritz it on!

 For comparison, I also frequently wear original Chanel Allure (sweeter scent) Gucci Bamboo and Gucci Guilty (muskier scent) and I would say this is most like the Bamboo.

review_text: Love this fragrance. Sadly, the company sent me an expired product. I figured it out by looking at the bottle's expiration date, then had to deal with their inept return process. product_title: Jean Patou Joy Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text:
Wonderful classic, like old artwork. Complex, deep, multi-faceted. Quite mature, in good sense, not like those bubble-gum-fruity fragrance which are so fashionable now, this is old school perfumery at its best, very much set in French perfumery tradition.

Elegant and sooo sophisticated, probably not recommended as a blind purchase gift based on the fragrance's fame, for a very young woman, (blind purchases not a good idea)  but a real perfumista will be delighted to have such classic in her collection. This fragrance is a legend, but also a rather aquired taste.

Opens with accords of civet and nuances of roses, than jasmine takes over, I am simplyfing it here, it is like a symphony, but you get the idea, complexity, depth, white floral. This review is for fragrance only, not seller services, as I usually don't buy fragrances on internet.

product_title: L'Occitane Cherry Blossom Eau de Toilette, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_text:
Oh, the Cherry Blossom perfume..I found this accidentally at Paris airport last spring and couldn't part with it. I have used it throughout the summer and didn't tire of it (which is rare for me), in fact I am buying another soon since I only have a few drops left.
The bottle is also beautiful to look at which is important since I like to leave it on my dresser.
The scent is a light floral with fresh notes and a delicate fruity accent, only a bit sweet unlike other florals that give you a headache. Very pretty and light, it also lingers for a few hours, but you'll need to carry this with you and use it if you want the scent throughout the whole day, or layer it with other body products from this line (like the body butter). I think Cherry Blossom would suit both a young girl or a mature woman for all occasions.

Update:
This year I bought another bottle of the Cherry Blossom perfume because I ran out of my first one, but I wish I didn't because I just found out that L'Occitane tests on animals or pays for a company who tests for them, therefore they are not curelty free anymore! I am deeply disappointed and won't be purchasing anymore products from them!

product_title: L'Occitane Cherry Blossom Eau de Toilette, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_text:
Love, love this cherry blossom edt. I almost cried when I dropped my first bottle. I had it for several years and used it sparingly, so I guess I got good use out of it. I purchased another bottle from drugstore.com for an excellent price and lowest around with their free shipping. I am so happy with this fragrance. It makes me feel happy when I spray it. It's light but long lasting and smells like fresh florals with a hint of fruitiness. I'm not huge on florals, but really like this one. My husband and friends all love it and always tell me "Mmmmm, you smell good" when I wear it. I also have the solid parfum, hand lotion and body lotion. I won't repurchase either of the lotions, however. They are too watery in my opinion and do no good for my skin that is prone to dryness.

Note: As with all fragrances, keep this out of the heat and sunlight. It will develop particles inside probably due to the inside of the metal cap rusting. If kept in room temperature or cooler, this is not a problem.

product_title: L'Occitane Cherry Blossom Eau de Toilette, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_title: Light, sweet, fresh, single-note floral.  Very pretty but doesn't last long.
review_text:
There is nothing complex about L'Occitane's Cherry Blossom Eau de Toilette; no top notes, middle notes or dry down. It goes on as a very light, sweet, fresh floral.

This is perfect for hot summer days when you may want a bit of fragrance, but you don't want to overpower the room.

It would also be a good choice for a younger girl who wants some perfume but isn't ready to walk around reeking of Coco or Dolce & Gabbana.

Not a strong scent to begin with, as it dries it simply becomes less intense.  This is not a long lasting fragrance. If you want more, you may have to spring for the other products in this line and layer the fragrance with the matching bath gel and lotion.

As with most fragrances made in France, this has a very pretty scent.  Too bad it doesn't last longer.  3 1/2 stars.

review_text: I discovered this perfume because I was into martial arts and that involves up close and personal contact with both men and women.  It also means you sweat.. A lot! It is a great feeling to know that when you do, your scent is a positive one and not a negative one.. Again, if you have a sensitive nose to strong odor, this light and fresh perfume is for you... It does NOT announce your presence before you enter a room, nor does it leave a calling card of scent after you have left!!  It's presence is known, to you, and to those closest to you..  And, that is how it should be!  Truly the BEST product for women who are active, and when used with the spa shower soap, shampoo etc.. well the smell is so elegant, you think you are in a European spa all the time.. ALL of the spa products are great as well...

review_title: Tantalizing and teasing, indeed -- in the top 5 of the world for myself.
review_text:
This is amazing stuff. it's probably a bit more than sandalwood alone as it is a perfume and not an essential oil. That said, i never tire of this. Off the official description "Woody, spicy and enduring, Indian Sandalwood is a classic, utterly masculine fragrance. Across time, countries and empires, sandalwood's rich aroma has tantalised and teased. With the addition of spicy notes of cypress, zesty bergamot and vetiver with a hint of fine lavender accords, it does so with a pinch more panache.:

I would amend that as it strikes me as not entirely masculine, au contraire, no. But you will find nothing like this at any department store women' or men's perfume counter. I would second that woody, spicy with a bit of floral. Great scent, man or woman, actually.
------
Later...I recently have experienced what is claimed to be pure sandalwood and it was very raw and unrefined as when compared with this scent, which I have already described as most delightful stuff.
'Crabtree & Evelyn Sandalwood' - Cologne. I should add if I did not yet mention, I have the one minus the  'Indian' Sandalwood name/newer version. ...But I do plan on getting that as soon as needed without reserves about its goodness.

product_title: Calvin Klein intense euphoria for Men Eau de Toilette, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_text:
That's how I describe this scent. It's more along this brand's line of "Obsession" rather than the CK product line (more fresh and clean smelling). The top note of Euphoria is definitely sweet (as in the sweetness of myrrh rather than floral) that tones down considerably to a warm, smoky, spicy scent. My husband ordinarily likes more green based fragrances like vetiver but this modern, sexy, and sophisticated scent has won him over. The silage is good, it lasts well on him but this seems to be the case with most colognes. The sweetness might be the only aspect of this cologne that might put someone off but it does disappear after about 20 min and it has settled down and mixed with his body chemistry.

I envision this cologne being perfect for evening wear and Fall/Winter, maybe a bit too spicy for Summer and he agrees, I guess it depends upon your taste. He prefers a "shower smell" for the office. If you like a more "incense" type of scent vs green or woodsy, you'll probably enjoy this one but I honestly feel it's better to try it before blind buying. This is a huge bottle (very elegant for gift giving) which should last him a long time. There are lots of reviews from cologne "experts" (like Basenotes) that can answer any in depth questions about it's composition of essential oils if you're interested, I popped by there before selecting this fragrance (he's picky!). I can't really answer those questions personally, unfortunately! Highly recommended.

product_title: Calvin Klein intense euphoria for Men Eau de Toilette, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_title: Spicy, oriental and woody fragrance, lasts a long time. Recommended for Fall/Winter.
review_text:
Calvin Klein Euphoria for Men Liquid Gold EDP is a modern version of a spicy and woody oriental fragrance. It was launched in 2014 but initially sold mostly in Middle Eastern/South Asian markets, as it does have notes that are more popular in those markets. If you'd just asked me to sniff the perfume and guess the house, I would have never guessed CK as they're known for more summery, lighter, citrusy fragrances. This is pretty intense - harking back to Obsession days.

This is an extremely spicy and masculine perfume, that has a strong presence and is on the opposite end of the lighter, citrusy, acqua fragrances like Acqua di Gio. At first whiff it can seem overpowering but it becomes subtler after a while. Top notes are black pepper giving it the spice, a middle note of saffron and a base note of sandalwood, it seems linear but it does have longevity. It lasted quite long on me, I applied it to my wrists, and I still got a faint whiff a few hours later.

I would recommend this perfume for older men, it's certainly not a perfume for teens or even twenty somethings unless they can pull it off. Although I like more fresh scents on men, I quite liked this one, and I can't wait to gift it!

review_text:
This reminds me of some scents I used in the 80s.  Calvin Klein did not disappoint with this smell either.  The best test I could come up with was to let my wife smell it on me.  She said it was really nice and took it from me.  She used some on herself and was happy as well.  It really is something that both men and women could use if they wanted to as it is a pretty neutral smell.  I could see anyone using it.

You get a lot for the money.  The bottle is big and it will last a while.  No doubts there.

I put one squirt on my arm and the smell was still going strong.  It wasn't overpowering and at least on me left a decent scent.  Everyone really needs to try a cologne first because each smell reacts differently with each person.  I would personally try it out somewhere and make sure you like it.  This is true with all perfumes and colognes.  I don't know what other people have talked about with the smell not being strong.  It might come down to a bad product or something but my bottle, at least, is good.

All in all I like this smell.  It will go into my rotation and I will use it sparingly as I do.

product_title: BURBERRY Brit Sheer Eau De Toilette, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text: I was asked to review this product. May I begin by saying that since the middle of the 1980's I have been a devoted Giorgio Fan. I happened upon a sample in a magazine and drove 70 miles to go to Rodeo Drive to their store to pick it up since the only way you could purchase it was by mail. EVERYONE knows this is my signature fragrance. Never, in a million years, did I think I would ever find another one I loved as much. But I have!! This Burberry Brit Sheer is absolutely beautiful! Such a clean, fresh floral scent. Since receiving this I have actually been stopped 3 times to be asked what fragrance I was wearing. One of my requirements for a floral fragrance is that it not be too "rosey" smelling and the scent must last. This is a must!! When I think about a flower that would be associated with all the high and low notes of this combination my mind goes to Peony. I think because it is such a feminine flower.  When I retired for the night and put my face into the pillow I could still smell the lovely scent on my skin. We use our senses for so many things and the gift of our sense of smell is a powerful one. I can say, without reservation, that I will be using this again and again. My beloved Giorgio is now replaced. Gals, if you love a fragrance that makes you feel girly, this is for you. I am not that knowledgeable about how to describe a fragrance other than I like it or I do not. THIS is a winner!

product_title: BURBERRY Brit Sheer Eau De Toilette, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text: I LOVE this beautiful scent! It's very light, great for every day wear.  I was a little hesitant to try this since I'd tried Marc Jacobs' Daisy and it really did not blend well with my chemistry and a different reviewer had mentioned that Brit is similar to Daisy. For some reason, Brit really works for me.  I don't wear perfume often and when I do, it varies from Elizabeth and James Nirvana Black to Philosphy's Amazing Grace.  The latter was my go-to ordinary occasion perfume.  However, I will now incorporate Brit into my rotation as it's truly delightful and not remotely overpowering. It also seems to last for at least half a day without a touch up, which I consider a bonus as well.

product_title: BURBERRY Brit Sheer Eau De Toilette, 1 Fl. oz.
review_title: A feminine version of Burberry's Brit
review_text: My girlfriend has been a fan of Burberry's Brit for many years now.  She's pretty loyal to the scent, but was curious to try out Burberry Brit Sheer.  We both first thought the scent too sweet, but the sweetness wears off during the day and leaves a refreshing floral scent. It's not overpowering, which is a plus for both of us.  The scent reminds her a little bit of Estee Lauder's Pleasures, with an additional warm woodsy scent.  She still finds Burberry Brit more unique and refreshing, but if you're looking for a more feminine alternative, Burberry Brit Sheer is your answer.

review_title: Lovely light fragrance that isn't overpowering.
review_text:
I'm not a huge wearer of fragrance. The last time I bought perfume was way back when Cherry Vanilla was popular about 15 years ago and I still have some left. And it smells just as good today as it did the day I bought it. I am very sensitive to fragrances. Especially cloyingly sweet or musky fragrances. If I am near someone wearing a strong musky fragrance, I have to move away or I will get nausea and a headache. I really hate when you can smell someone whi is a good 10 feet away from you and they smell like they have not showered byt instead layered perfume on them layer over layer over layer. Yuck. Not all fragrances bother me, though. I like light citrusy scents. And a light floral scent as long as it isn't too heavy.

I decided to try this because it is Eau de Toilette, which is usually lighter than Eau de Parfum, so I thought I'd give it a shot. I'm glad I did.

This Burberry Brit Sheer has a light floral fragrance that isn't at all overpowering and I find that I can wear it without any ill effects. The scent is floral, yet fruity, but not cloyingly sweet or musky. I very much enjoy the fragrance and wore it to my allergy doctor appointment today and was complimented on it.

As I said, I rarely have occasion to wear fragrance, so this bottle should last me another 15 years or so. It's a very nice fragrance and I'm glad I decided to try it.

product_title: BURBERRY Brit Sheer Eau De Toilette, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text: This is a beautiful citrus-y, summery scent; very light and youthful. I really love this. It goes on light and bright, and has good staying power. I think as the afternoon wore on it mellowed into a slightly more mature scent, but nothing heavy or overly sexy. It reminds me of the Colors by Benneton scent, but a little brighter.  The bottle is classy and stable, and my one caveat was that it arrived to me from Amazon with a dented box. It was obviously just tossed in a cardboard box where it had room to slide around and get dented. Since perfume is often given as a gift, I thought I would bring that up, since it doesn't look as great for gift-giving as it would if you bought it from a brick-and-mortar store where it would presumably be more carefully handled. Still, a lovely scent and great product. I would wear this and give it as a gift.

review_title: bottle is hard to handle; scent is great
review_text: Very light and crisp fragrance that lasts a long time. My only complaint is about the bottle itself. It's a thick, angular, glass bottle that awkward to hold with one hand while pressing the atomizer. I almost dropped it twice trying to apply the cologne. Maybe in making the women's fragrance bottle mimic the man's they didn't take into account that ladies have smaller hands? I'm not petite by any means, but I find the bottle hard to handle. I end up using two hands to apply it. Awkward, but it works. The bottom line is it smells great and unlike many cheaper fragrances that seem to shift smell over the course of a day, this one remains true to it's original scent.

product_title: BURBERRY Brit Sheer Eau De Toilette, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text:
I am not a big fan of perfumes or body sprays as sometimes, they can be overpowering and I can get nasty headaches from smelling it. My husband is not a fan of fragrances at all, especially anything that has a cinnamon scent to it. This Burberry, which I have never smelled before, is really nice. I like the pleasant scent. It lingers but not too strongly. It definitely has a feminine smell to it ... light, pleasant and floral. (Even better, my husband did not sneeze when I sprayed it on and neither of us got a headache from it.)

I don't normally buy perfume this expensive, but the 3.3 fl oz bottle is a lot bigger than I expected, so for this price, it will last a really long time. It is perfect for the every day usage as well. It will make a wonderful gift for the special lady in your life. It's not "too old" like a lot of perfumes are and yet, it's not too young either. It's a right scent for women of all ages.

It is packaged very well too. The box that it came in is very nice. The bottle is a lovely shade of pink. It definitely looks like it's a "sheer" perfume and honestly, I cannot find anything wrong with this perfume. It is now my favorite in my small collection of fine fragrances.

product_title: BURBERRY Brit Sheer Eau De Toilette, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text:
I have never been a big fan of my wife or others wearing perfume because it was usually too strong. I also was not that fond of the scents that were too sweet and floral. I remember that while I was teaching, a certain perfume was being used by quite a few high school girls as well as my wife for a time. After a short time the scent would change. It took on the scent of stale beer. Needless to say I mentioned to my wife who then threw it out. I always got a chuckle when I smelled stale beer in my classroom as a student walked by.
I decided to order the Burberry Brit Sheer since my wife likes to wear perfume and I figured she could try it. I have found that it is a scent that I actually like. It is not just an overpowering floral scent, but has the fragrance of citrus as well as floral. This was an interesting scent for a wearable fragrance. No scent of stale beer.

Now, because this is not a returnable product and It is just sitting on the counter without use.. Amazon was wonderful enough to refund my account for this purchase.
Just a little hint, before you buy a certain perfume, it does help to try it out in a store first, so you do not spend money on something that ends up being overpowering. Everyone smells different with the skin oils and what smells nice on 1 person may not smell the same on you.
Lesson Learned...

I'm not a fan of woody perfumes, but I also love to try new things--even when I think I won't like them.  I'm glad I tried CLEAN White Woods because I really love this fragrance.

CLEAN White Woods is a lovely fresh scent that isn't overpowering.  It's only lightly woodsy, which is why I like it so much.

White Woods has this fragrance profile:

review_text:
When I was offered a chance to review this product on amazon.com, the name looked familiar.  I asked my wife if she would like to try it in exchange for her opinion.

Here is what she had to say:

My husband knows that I like the "Clean Fragrance" brand. The company's philosophy is inspired by a simple concept to make the most of every moment and to fill each day with lifes perfect pleasures.

I have allergies and fragrances often cause me to have watery eyes, sneezing and if highly fragrant, I can have wheezing.  A whiff of Estee Lauderes Youth Dew or Yves Saint Laurents Opium can illicit all of the above and more.

When Tom  was offered a chance to review this product, I was happy that he asked me if I was willing  to try the fragrance "Warm Cotton" because of my prior delightful experiences with "Shower Fresh."

The Warm Cotton Clean Eau de Parfum has a light scent. It reminds me of cotton clothes when they have been dried outside on the clothes line in the sun. At the first spray it is a bit strong but quickly dissipates and you are left with a soft citrus light musk scent that stays with you through the day."

Enjoy!

I like the light fragrance this product leaves on my wife and recommend it as a Christmas gift or as one for any special occasion in appreciation for the woman you love.

product_title: CLEAN Eau de Parfum Spray
review_title: Really like this, nice and clean scent
review_text:
I'll admit, when I first sprayed this I wasn't expecting to overly like it. It didn't smell bad, but rather like some rather strong Febreeze, a scent that isn't bad on clothing and furniture, but not really something I'd necessarily wear as a perfume. It was also a little stronger than what I normally wear, as scents tend to be amplified on my body. I'm like a miniature incense burner with some perfumes, and not in a good way. I'd only sprayed a little mist on each wrist, about what I'd normally put on with all but a very few scents, so this initially concerned me.

I was pleasantly surprised when about a half hour later the scent actually mellowed out into a pleasant fresh laundry scent that is neither overpowering nor overwhelmingly reminds me of Febreeze. It's very basic and clean, so it's a scent that I would feel comfortable wearing in most environments without fear of it knocking someone in the face. Now when I say that it mellowed, don't take this to mean that the scent disappears. It's still very much present and I can smell it on my wrists. It's definitely something I enjoy smelling and something I'd actually use quite a bit for everyday use at work and home. It's definitely not something I'd wear during a fancy event, but then I suppose that might also depend on the person. It's not the best cotton scent I've ever smelled and I'd have to reserve that 5 star rating for a now retired cotton scent from Bath & Body Works from years back. They have a similar scent, but it's not really the same.

However it's definitely good enough to where I'd recommend it if you like cotton scents or want something nice and basic. If you're worried about your body chemistry, I'd say that you can use this relatively free of worry. Everyone is different, but I usually do not do well with perfumes and it smelled fine on myself.

product_title: CLEAN Eau de Parfum Spray
review_title: I smell like I've been "tarred" in Tide liquid and "feathered" with Surf powder
review_text: This smells very much like Tide Clean Breeze with a hint of Surf powder crystals (when Surf smelled a bit fruitier than it does now). There are definite citrus notes - the first spray actually is similar to Lemon Pledge (a chemical lemon smell), but fortunately that note dissipates very quickly. It basically makes you smell like you dumped too much detergent in the washer and then skipped the rinse cycle. To me, it is less like the mellow,clean smell of clothes out of the dryer and more like the pungent, direct smell of pure liquid detergent right out of the cap. Like other Clean fragrances, it is not an offensive smell, but it is perhaps a bit too much like straight detergent. Wish it had more complexity. I do give the fragrance high marks for lasting power - I smelled like I bathed (but didn't rinse) in Tide Clean Breeze all day long.

review_text: Usually if I dislike a perfume, it's due to a certain floral heaviness: overpowering notes of musk and/or heavy flowers, such as gardenia, jasmine, etc.  In the case of DZING!, I dislike the perfume not for floral heaviness but for its heavy opening of musky semi-sweetness that dries down into the distinct scent of damp leather. product_title: Secret Obsession By Calvin Klein For Women. Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 Ounces
review_text:
SO leaves an abstract gourmand impression without being a gourmand. SO is very much like a vanilla coca-cola or a rootbeer float. More specifically, to me it's an A&W ROOTBEER FLOAT. Yes, root beer & vanilla ice cream in all it's fizzy, frothy glory from top to bottom. SO isn't about the notes & progression, it's about the impression it leaves. A gourmand without being a gourmand. Brilliant!

SO is very American & very well-done. I pledge my love. It's the oriental vanilla that I'm adopting for Fall.

SO is misunderstood, and the thumbs-down reviews are not reflective of the fragrance. Rather, I think the thumb-downs are reflective of the disconnect between the fragrance and its advertising. SO is not sex-in-a-bottle and there is nothing come-hither about it. SO is a jeans & sweater weather perfume, perfect for baking cookies or attending football games. SO is young & up-beat but I think women in the middle would be most attracted to it.

Word of warning. SO's white florals are just on the edge of cloying for me, perhaps more so in heat. I have the same problem with florals in SO's otherwise likable (but not as good) sister, CK Obsession Night Woman, which is unwearable in warm weather. SO is another one of the CK's with hard-to-wear florals.

The downside? Lasting power. Otherwise, SO would be SO perfect. I love SO but am so underwhelmed by the longevity. I've resorted to use SO in my scent bug, rather than on me. That may sound strange, but I love it this way!

However, not everybody is going to appreciate it. You have to be really fond of amber, sandalwood, and patchouli to like CK Secret Obsession.

It's also very different from the original Obsession which reminds me of Channel no 5, or the original Miss Dior. What I mean to say is, I love Original Obsession too, but this one is gorgeous in a very different way.

I fell in love with Yves Saint Laurent's Paris Roses enchantees when I was fifteen. It was my first rose perfume: crisp and airy and romantic- not too sweet, not stale or rotten, and NOT your grandmother's rose. I was lonely, it was summertime, and I was in Paris. But I had love, bottled in a precious cut glass bottle. It all ended of course,  and I mourned the day I squeezed the last drops of that loveliness from its bottle. The perfume lingered on my scarves and sweaters long after, taunting me.

So I have hunted in vain to fill its void in my life, and have settled on L'occitane's Rose 4 Reines for now. It is a different kind of rose, not laced with cool misty garden air and old books and wet bark, but it is fresh smelling and it doesn't pickle on my skin. It's affordable, and comforting, and its only two drawbacks are its packaging which resembles complimentary hotel shampoo and its tendency to fade off quickly. It leaves behind a warm feminine smell though.

product_title: L'Occitane Rose 4 Reines Eau de Toilette, 2.5 fl. oz.
review_text:
This fragrance is a homage to four French queens, historical persons. All natural fragrance, but quite long lasting. Atars of Bulgarian, Turkish, Maroccan and French rose de Mai. The French one, grown in the Grasse area, is the crispiest of all, the others are sweeter, Bulgarian rose is a kind of standard to which rose fragrances are measured :kind of true rose fragrance, Turkish is more red-rose scent, Maroccan is more heavy and almond-like. (Usually Bulgarian and Grasse are of better quality due to the favorable climate and soil conditions). All are combined to make rose fragrance which is pleasantly delicate and old fashioned. I use it also for spraying bed linens, works nice, needed is just a little bit, the fragrance can be strong on linens. As the fragrance contains natural oils, and spraying to closely can leave some spots, just some little bit of mist is fine. Like vintage fragrances starts kind of sharp and needs some time to settle down into proper smell, which is amazing.

Opening accords (head notes) maybe not too pleasant, but this is also the case with fragrances formulated in earleir days: they get often better after some time, not very impresive on sprtiz on the paper strip, give this one a littel time to develop, and you will be rewarded.

L'Occitane is company which uses only natural resources, mostly form plants grown in Southern France. If you prefer more crisp,  less sweet rose fragrance, I recommend Rose de Mai by L'Occitane, is is less nostalgic and more crispy modern than this one.

product_title: John Varvatos Vintage Eau de Toilette Spray, 2.5 fl. Oz. mens cologne
review_text:
This is one of those cologne's that is close to being super solid, but just didn't quite hit the spot for me. When it first hits, it's really strong, with a bit too much sweet and spicy. The first half hour or so, it really reminds me of an overpowering spiced rum drink. It's not a bad thing, per se, just not my personal preference.

From there, it fades, and for me it really hits its best notes a couple hours into wearing it. The sweet and spiced notes soften a bit more, and some of the more musky undertones come out. It smoothes out even better on warmer days when it's not under a couple layers of clothing

The only other negative is that once it hits that sweet spot, it fades pretty quickly. By the end of the day, it's pretty much nonexistent. It only takes a little at the start, and then a bit of a refresh if you're heading back out at night, and I'll definitely come back to it as an alternate for summer wearing when I'm looking for something slightly different.

product_title: John Varvatos Vintage Eau de Toilette Spray, 2.5 fl. Oz. mens cologne
review_text:
I'm not much of a cologne connoisseur. Aftershaves and perfumes are a rather personal choice for men and women... and all a part of the great game of interpersonal relationships, whether it's to attract a mate or just exude an air of sophistication and class. A lot of what goes into a product of this type is the brand's elegance of presentation. In that regard, John Varvatos Vintage is set. With it's bottle and snakeskin label, it all but screams "manliness." The scent matches it, being earthy and spicy and exactly the kind of masculine cologne you'd expect.

Worth the cost? That's up to you. I'm no expert on the market, so while I do recognize the initial sticker shock, know that the bottle should last the better part of a six months to a year if you're putting it to daily use after a shave, and what your paying for is both brand, image, and quality of ingredients.

review_title: Reminds me of an old leather jacket thats been through a lot.
review_text: John Varvatos Vintage is a sophisticated, woodsy, masculine scent that reminds me of an old leather jacket thats been through a lot. It has a bit of earthiness with citrus accents. Vintage is not entirely unfamiliar though, it is reminiscent of a scent that I had in the past, though I just cant place it, maybe an earthier Ralph Laurens Polo perhaps? The scent lingers nicely for a few hours after applying, without being too strong. Vintage is a scent I would wear in the fall and winter, it just has those qualities with a little bit of spiciness its a little bit heavier than I like to wear in the hotter summer months. As with any scent, I recommend going to a retail store and testing it first before buying online. I think John Varvatos got the idea from this scent by finding one of Joey Ramones old leather jackets stuck somewhere in his New York shop, which used to be the old CBGBs.

product_title: John Varvatos Vintage Eau de Toilette Spray, 2.5 fl. Oz. mens cologne
review_text:
I REALLY like this scent.  Or combination of scents.  It's a little bit sweet, a little leather and spice, and a refreshing change from most other male fragrances.

When you put this on your first whiff is of alcohol.  That vanishes, of course, and what is left is a nicely leveled fragrance. By which I mean that it doesn't change from what it is when you spray it on to something more flowery later.  It smelled good after 60 seconds and stayed smelling good for hours.

Which brings up the stench-factor.  I hate scents that are knock-you-out strong.  I'm scent sensitive so I and the family need to use perfumes and such in moderation.  This is very nice. Lasts well without having to douse yourself.

RECOMMEND.  If you are looking for a new male fragrance this is one to definitely try.  I loved the scent and my husband and the teens did too.  (Teengirl is borrowing it.)

review_title: Dark, Earthy, and Sweet Vintage Lives Up To Its Name.
review_text: Ever since Paul Sabastian discontinued it's Cigar Aficionado fragrance I've hoped something similar would pop up.  For me Vintage is it.  This will be my second bottle and that is my highest recommendation since trying the latest and greatest is always tempting.  My opinion is no matter what is "in" at the moment I can always count on Vintage.  It's darkly complex with some sweetness, more of a winter cologne yet so good I wear it all year.  Sweet and earthy done right in a men's fragrance (i.e. not unisex).  I can't imagine any man that wouldn't feel good wearing this...especially when one will be getting that fantastic female reinforcement (get ready for compliments).

product_title: John Varvatos Vintage Eau de Toilette Spray, 2.5 fl. Oz. mens cologne
review_text:
There are a couple of bases to hit towards when it comes to thinking about this product.

The first is the scent itself.  Now to be clear I'm not a cologne/perfumy kind of person.  On occasion though, I've been known to partake.  This scent is interesting without being overbearing, noteworthy without being cloying.  It smells "soft" to me, and by that I mean that men's fragrances sometimes tend to have a kind of bite to them.  This is just a nice scent that if applied appropriately won't overpower.  The ad copy says all the notes that one may pick up, like quince and tobacco, to which I say "yeah, whatever."  I don't smell any of that.  What I smell is this, and it isn't objectionable.  Moreover, in a double blind study I found myself 42.37% more appealing to the ladies.  So I got that going for me.

What I do not like is the delivery device.  The push button on the spray is, well, let's just say it's easy to be overly assertive with this packaging.  The button stuck on me a couple of times and resulted in an overapplication as I pushed too hard on it.  The bottle shape is OK to hold, which is to say it's not a weird awkward shape.  I just wish the nozzle weren't so enthusiastic sometimes about spraying me down.

I certainly seem to be spending a lot of time thinking about this.

Anyway, the product in and of itself is quite nice and I think it's a good scent.  Its masculine without being in your face.  I like it.

product_title: Lolita Lempicka Si Lolita Eau de Parfum Spray, 1 Fl Oz
review_text:
I didn't really hesitate to purchase this perfume as I currently wear the original Lolita Lempicka eau de toilette and love it.  When I first sprayed it on my wrist I smelled the peppercorn immediately and the fragrance seemed a little sharp to me.  It has a few notes similar to the original Lolita but it is definitely it's own fragrance.  It mellowed out into something more sweet, yet at the same time very spicy.  It's hard to define but I almost pick out something different every time I sniff my wrist, sometimes spicier, sometimes sweet and creamier.  I think this is a much sexier fragrance than the original Lolita.

It's a great fall scent and I'm very excited to wear it when going out - I've only worn this at work and I feel like my skin smells different at work for some reason.

So far I'm impressed with the staying power, it's lasting but not overwhelming.  I'm a huge fan of Lolita perfumes, I cannot say how excited I was when I first discovered them.  I've never smelled anything like the original Lolita and I do not like most of the mainstream perfumes, they all seem to smell the same, either too strong or too sickly sweet.  These are complex scents with a lot of depth yet they are fine for a younger woman in my opinion, they do not date you I think.  For reference, I am in my 20s and I am not a fan of most "mature" fragrances.

product_title: Lolita Lempicka Si Lolita Eau de Parfum Spray, 1 Fl Oz
review_text:
This perfume has a wonderful spicy, warm scent. It's not too sweet, which is something I have to watch out for, and it's not fruity, dessert-y, or soapy, which is definitely hard to find these days.

Other reviewers have mentioned that it's not like other Lolita Lempicka fragrances, which is true: it seems to be missing the licorice and vanilla notes that may draw in a lot of Lolita Lempicka fans. I personally find this scent more grown-up (but not "mature" or matronly) than other LL perfumes, but there's no reason that one can't like both.

I wear it year round as a break from Lovely by SJP (which I keep for spring and summer), and I always get compliments on it. I think it's perfect for women who want to smell feminine or romantic while still being unique and not sickly sweet.

Finally, a tip for any fragrance that you like in the bottle, but find that you don't like it on your skin: try spraying it on your hair or clothes to keep it from reacting with your skin chemistry and changing the scent. Some might find that this and other perfumes change drastically from bottle to skin (and some may find no difference at all!)

review_title: Just so-so, wonder if it's the real deal tho-
review_text: Purchased ON Amazon, but seller was someone else.  While a product DID come, I am not all too sure it is a real, genuine Burberry product.  Why, well, the 'code' that is hot stamped into the plastic/rubber on the bottle bottom was purposely defaced, to the point of you can't recognize it.  A similar 'code' on the outside box was also defaced to unreadable.  While the box did have the clear overwrap, there are easy ways to re-wrap and make it look original - so I am not at all sure the bottle contain OEM stuff.  Cannot seem to find anyone to provide actual, verifiable proof of why this was done, if they are re-filled, mfg rejects, knock-offs or what, but why would the mfg go to the lengths of completely making those mfg codes unreadable if they weren't trying to hide something.  So, basically, while the price IS certainly less that you'd get it for in high-end dept stores, you may just want to hold off on this one.  I asked someone who I really liked the scent they had on one day what it was, and they specifically said THIS.  Not sure if they lied or were mistaken, or if this might be a totally bogus remake, but what came in this suspicious bottle smelled nothing like the scent on the person I asked.  Live & learn I guess.

review_text:
I ordered a few colognes form Amazon & Macys. I have been using this in the summer, with other colognes such as Bleu De Chanel, Prada Luna Rossa Extreme, Dolce & Gabanna The One...

At first, this was my least favorite. It smelled okay to me. It is a bit cucumberish.. and I thought it didn't last or projected as I couldn't smell it in an hour from application. I even thought I got a knock off or a bad bottle...

Boy was I wrong!

This is a summer/day scent. I apply it before I go out in the morning because I wanted to give it a chance. Also, my other fragrances are more suited for night use. I went to Publix, and a woman approached me and said you smell good. That was not that impressive because I just sprayed it before I left, and Publix was only two miles away.

Then one time I applied it while I was at home, went out, back home.. after three hours.. I couldn't smell it. product_title: Jack Black JB Eau de Parfum, 3.4 oz.
review_text:
This cologne is sitting on the counter at my hair salon in Nashville, TN, Trim Classic Barber & Legendary Beauty.

I am very picky, but found this curiously...contagious.

I touched my finger to the nozzle to get just a hint of the scent and walked away, to return to my seat while my family member was a getting hair cut. I kept finding myself returning to the scent on my fingertip. I was intrigued.

I went back to the counter and sprayed a small amount on my wrist...walked away.

I know exactly what this reminds me of, and I am quite sure about it because I returned to the register to inquire if they were selling any and, to my dismay, discovered that they were sold out. The scents that I smell are:

1). the "air" and "water" in Aveda's Shampure shampoo. Though, Shampure contains phenoxyethanol, which is a highly toxic ingredient which damages your central and peripheral nervous system and is foolishly and deceivingly used as a preservative in most shampoos and conditioners, lotions, creams, you name it.
I stopped using Shampure when I found out about phenoxyethanol from my doctor.
But here is that amazing, clean and fresh scent! Yeah!
2). lemon - I usually hate colognes with lemon. But I like it with these other scents blended into it.
3). leather - hubba hubba
4). maybe a hint of smoke..in a subtle and sultry way

I am hooked and have to buy it..and I'm a girl. This may be for men but I am so going to wear it. Personally, I think it is too feminine for men. If you like Romance for men on your man, then you may definitely think that Jack Black can be worn on a woman instead of a man. I haven't tried to spray it on a guy; but I love it on my skin and I'm not into unisex colognes.

This is the next cologne I'll buy for myself.
Others I love & own: Angel, Cartier, Romance, Light Blue - all for women.
Jack Black is nothing like them. Like I typed, I've never liked a scent with lemon in it.

Maybe I'm just difficult, but I've found that I dislike 99% of all scents out there.  Most colognes either come across too clean, or too spicy, or too musky.  I like a touch of sweetness, laced with a clean cut professional undertone, and pulled together with class and manly distinction.  Is this cologne all of those things?? Maybe.. All I know, is that when I smell it, I feel like I could go on a fancy date, or head to the bar for a game. product_title: Jack Black JB Eau de Parfum, 3.4 oz.
review_text:
I've been using Jack Black cologne for some time now and loved it.  The latest bottle I purchased had a distinctly different scent than prior versions.  The new scent is very faint, and sweeter than the prior style.

I was disappointed and wanted to return it.  Apparently, neither Amazon nor the vendor, Jericho Pharmacy, will accept the return.

Amazon states:
"For safety reasons, items that are classified as hazardous materials or use flammable liquids or gases cannot be returned to Amazon.com. Customers should dispose of hazardous materials according to Local, State and Federal regulations. Customers should contact their local government or local waste company for directions on how to dispose of Household Hazardous Waste."

Jericho states:
"To qualify for returns, products must be in original condition. All returns will be examined and no refund will be issued for opened/tested products.
I would recommend you contact Jack Black directly as they may be able to help you."

Perhaps both of these policies are defendable, but the bottom line is that I'm out $70 for a product I thought I knew, unless I can get a resolution from Jack Black.

Bottom line:
Be careful, the scent has changed.  And I recommend avoiding purchases of "flammable liquids" from Amazon or any product you have to open to evaluate from Jericho.

product_title: Jack Black JB Eau de Parfum, 3.4 oz.
review_text:
Jack Blacks Signature is an excellent designer fragrance.  For those who are fans of Terre dHermes, I note many similarities in the note structure to include the blend of citrus, patchouli, and pepper.  While I thoroughly enjoy the fragrance, there are performance challenges  lasting about 4 hours on me and somewhat longer on my clothing.  Black Signature only lingers in close proximity.  Even considering these challenges, this fragrance is really good and deserves to be sampled.  I don't think you will be disappointed.  Black is flexible enough to be worn by any age group (leaning more toward a 30+ crowd), to any event, and regardless of season.  Further, given the modest projection, this fragrance is definitely a safe wear in the office or in close quarters.  I would be remiss if I did not point out the presentation of the large bottle  well packaged cylinder box that contains the fine-crafted square bottle.  Nicely done, Mr. Black.

All said, my final tally for Jack Blacks Signature fragrance is 4.0 stars out of 5 stars.  If the performance was better, this may sneak in to my Top 10.  Black Signature smells great and considered a best kept secret.  I highly recommend adding to your collection.

Enjoy your day and happy fragrance hunting..

This product is like the Avon line of fragrances it smells wonderful immediately after application, but falls off before you can leave the house. It does not stay with you. I don't know how many times I have been asked by my family; "did you stop wearing cologne?" By the way I have applied Jimmy Choo to all pulse points, over well hydrated skin, and it still fails to last. I don't spray ANY cologne on my clothes because of staining. Jimmy Choo maybe a little pricy but do not be fooled by the price because it is not a quality cologne in my opinion. I guess I could baptize myself in the cologne but that is a waste; let me clarify I spray multiple shots of Jimmy Choo and still it will not last.

review_text: I just bought this over break and it's my new favorite! I don't like fruity sweet perfumes but this is the perfect balance! It has a floral tone that is a bit strong right after spraying, but in a few minutes it mellows out to a clean and fresh scent that is really sexy. I love that this is not overpowering and obnoxious, but strong enough so that it lingers around you so people catch a whiff of it when they come near.  This has the best staying power I have ever owned. I tested this perfume before purchasing and two days later, even after two showers and exercise I could still smell it on my wrist. By then I was sold and immediately bought it. I was a pretty loyal Burberry fan before because they do a good job of making clean not overly sweet fragrances and I still love Burberry sport! But I bought Flash because Burberry touch was not lasting more than a few hours on me! So if you like Burberry scents you should give this one a try! I recommend you test it first though as fragrances smell differently depending on your skin chemistry.

It's the perfect light fragrance for everyday wear, and not overwhelmingly floral/grandma-aromatic like some of the other C&E scents. It's versatile and appropriate for any age. Many negative reviews are based on the expectation of a totally different product line, Lily of the Valley. I'm sure I would be disappointed too, but without that bias, I think it's a great scent. My only gripe is that is isn't very long lasting, so I keep the solid perfume version in my bag to reapply.

product_title: Crabtree & Evelyn Eau de Toilette, Rosewater, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_title: "You smell like roses..." so I have been told!
review_text:
I have been searching for rose fragrance for a long time.  I have to say Crabtree & Evelyn Rosewater is the best by far.  It's elegant, subtle, faint (but I know it's there) with just a hint of sweet.  For the quality it is a reasonably priced product. I love that this is blended with peony, another favorite flower of mine:)

I read that some of you claim that after 30 minutes of applying this eau de toilette the scent is gone.  I thought the same thing until I met with a friend for drinks (10 hours later I sprayed it on).  She leaned in, took a whiff, then ask me if I was wearing rose oil.  I have received more compliments from people that don't wear perfume/eau de toilette normally (or at all) so that is saying something!
If it helps, I spray 1 pump behind my neck, 1 pump on my cleavage, and 1 more on my wrist.  I read from some magazines that perfume/eau de toilette stays on longer on your pressure points and skin than on your clothes.

***Figure out how many sprays you need.  One spray too many can ruin the delicate scent of roses...

product_title: LACOSTE L.12.12 Blanc Pour Lui Eau de Toilette
review_text: I have many different brands of colognes, and among them, white musk scent was always my favorite. Like any other human sense related products, colognes are very personal because of ones preferences, but I found new favorite. I am not a big fan of strong scent or cologne and this one is not punchy. This white polo scent is very familiar and famous, yet not too strong at first, but it lasts longer than others I have tried. The scent is somewhat gentle for me, and I like it that way with longer lasting endurance. Imitations often have similar scent at a low price, but only last an hour or so. This one is from Amazon and for sure an authentic Lacoste, and the pure scent lasts pretty much all day and night freshly.

product_title: LACOSTE L.12.12 Blanc Pour Lui Eau de Toilette
review_title: I love this and have a couple of similar faves to help you decide if you want to try it...
review_text:
I originally snapped this up for my husband, as I was fond of the listed notes, the grapefruit in particular is a favorite. But our teenager is in a phase of wanting to smell nice so I let him have first dibs and I have to say that I'm glad I let him have it. While I like it and my teen does, I don't think my husband would care for it as much.

You definitely get the tuberose notes and this fragrance which gives it a really warm overall feel. It's very bright and clean at first but as the grapefruit burns off I find it's a bit sensual and I'd even dare say it's almost unisex. I tried it on myself and though I wouldn't wear it, I found it was a flattering scent even on me. (Ladies if you love sneaking a spritz of your guys' scent this is a great one).

If you like Ralph Lauren's Romance or Jean Paul Gautier Le Male I would definitely check out Lacoste Ea de Lacosta. I think this is a terrific choice for men in their late 20's and into the late 30's, it's very grown-up and established feeling but not so mature that it feels like a dad cologne.

review_text: I've worn more than my fair share of different colognes over the last 25 years - with Drakkar Noir and Armani's Acqua Di Gio as longtime favorites. product_title: LACOSTE L.12.12 Blanc Pour Lui Eau de Toilette
review_text:
I always see those candles and airsprays that say "Fresh Linen," and I could never figure out what they meant. My linens NEVER smelled like the stuff that was labeled with that moniker. Whose linens were they TALKING about???
  Now, thanks to Lacoste, I figured it out.
  THIS is the scent of "Fresh Linen."
  It's the kind of cologne I can picture some guy at a preppy college spritzing on, after a Lacrosse game. It reeks of pretentious athleticism and fresh-pressed polo shirts, of those white candles in Grandma's bathroom and the waft of deodorizer in Aunt Tilly's guest room.
  My eyes watered, as though I had just been blasted full force by a Fresh Linen-powdered pimp glove. I begged my fiance to wash it off. He tried... Heaven knows, he tried... but the SMELL WOULDN'T GO AWAY!!
  I guess, for those who LIKE the scent, that's a good thing. One tiny little spritz lasted through a shower, a change of clothes, a scrubbing at the sink... NOTHING was removing it. The next morning, our sheets smelled like Fresh Linen (for the first time!).Our laundry hamper smelled like Fresh Linen. Our BATHROOM smelled like Fresh Linen. Even our VAN smelled like Fresh Linen, from where I took the bottle (wrapped in a plastic bag, buried in clothes, and inside a heavy duty trash bag) to the local Goodwill store.
  Now I know where "Fresh Linen" scent comes from.
  I won't even ask about "Sunshine-Scented."

review_title: Very good, but not one of my all-time favorites
review_text:
I love Lacoste fragrances for the most part. I have Lacoste for men, Essentials, Blanc, Blue, Green, Rouge and Noir. Of the L.12.12 scents, this is my second favorite. The red is my personal favorite, but cologne is such a hard thing to recommend to someone since everybody has such unique tastes. In terms of the age I feel this would be appropriate for, maybe 20-35. Here are some of my favorites so you can kind of gauge my personal taste:

1. Burberry Touch
2. Acqua Digio
3. Kenneth Cole Black
4. Bvlgari Aqua
5. Versace Pour Homme
6. Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue
7. Dolce & Gabbana The One
8. Chanel Bleu
9. Vince Camuto
10. Lacoste for Men

The citrus scent that you initally get wears off quickly and it transforms into this very soft, but masculine smell that I have received some compliments on. It is very fresh, strong and lasts for the better part of the entire day. For the price, I feel this line of fragrances is a good value. I would recommend to anyone who likes any of the scents I listed above (though it isn't necessarily similar to any one of those).

review_text: Let me first start by saying I'm into Fragrances and I've learned that price is often not indicative of likeability of smell. The two reasons I find this to be the case is that opinions are in the eye  of the beholder (we don't all like the same smells)  and an individuals body chemistry sometimes just doesn't work with a particular cologne.  I have found this out the hard way loving a scent someone else was wearing but once on my skin I was repulsed by it, which invariably gives you a headache or if your like me you want to take a shower as soon as possible to get it off of you.  For this reason I recommended testing any scent you are considering and walk around an hour to determine how it works for you.  More specifically I won't go through all the notes as some others have done and the cologne has been reviewed on YouTube multiple times but I will tell you this scent is by far my biggest compliment getter from the ladies.  To get unsolicited comments in my world is rare ( I've never gotten one for Pure Malt) but this cologne gets them all the time.  Even guys ask what I'm wearing and you know men don't often ask that kind of question but its happened numerous times.  The only negative I have to say about the scent is it doesn't last long periods and as part of that its projection fades rapidly throughout the day/evening.  Some of that is becoming nose blind but not entirely, I know this because if I get a hug later in the evening I am invariably told how good it smells and asked what scent it is, so as far as bang for your buck and in need of a summer scent give this a try I'm afraid in the winter the scent is not as applicable and would fade even faster.

review_text: My first Tommy Bahama cologne experience came with the purchase of Set sail Martinique, which I loved immediately. I had to try St. Barts as well and had yet another religious experience the moment it arrived at my doorstep. St. Barts is one of the most exotic, unique, and pleasant fragrances that I've ever come across!  The fresh lime opening is authentic and zesty and slowly fades into a boozy tequila lime middle, backed by sea salt and soft musk. It is best suited for hot, muggy days with a breeze. I was initially skeptical about longevity abd silage being an EDC instead of an EDT but let's be honest, a lighter fragrance is perfect for hot summer days and nights. Nobody wants to smell the guy doused in Polo original when it's 100 degrees out with 90% humidity! Both my wife and I love the Tommy Bahama line of fragrances and she is very hard to please when it comes to my cologne. I can honestly say that I've received more compliments on TB'S than any other fragrances in my collection, most of which include the likes of Ralph Lauren, Dolce & Gabanna, Nautica, Hugo Boss, and John Varvatos. So to say Tommy Bahama is a steal for the quality and uniqueness is an understatement!

product_title: Rochas Eau de Rochas Fraîche Eau de Toilette
review_text:
This is a difficult product for me to review, given that perfume is a very personal thing. I thought I would enjoy this given the description (top notes of bergamot and fresh water, middle notes of white flowers and liatris, and base notes of musk and oak moss), but it really didn't work well for me. I guess I was hoping for a more delicate blend of notes, but this really hits you over the head and is *very* strong. It smells like a very strong florally bug spray, which is not the scent I was looking for.

I also found the bottle to be a bit cheap looking. The top knob is even made of plastic and not glass, and the whole thing has a very drugstore perfume look about it. Just thought I would mention is since I know some people like to display bottles on a vanity table. I don't, but that's because I don't have a vanity to tempt me! :)

However, I will give some stars to this perfume because even though it's not my personal preference, it will be for some, and they should rest assured that this has a lot of sillage and lasting power. Also, the price point is pretty decent for the size. Bottom line - it's not for me, but I know there are people out there who would enjoy it!

I received this through Amazon Vine, but I try extremely hard to write my review as if I had paid the full purchase price, for I believe that is only fair for those who read and rely on reviews.

product_title: Rochas Eau de Rochas Fraîche Eau de Toilette
review_text:
Let's start with the appearance of this fragrance. The box is pretty enough, and the bottle is gorgeous. It's 4-1/2 inches tall, with an icy, jewel-like quality. The eau de toilette inside is very faintly tinted violet. There's a tiny satin bow tied around its neck. A really fetching bottle, in my opinion, and one that would look beautiful on anyone's vanity.

Now on to the scent. I saw some reviewers describing it as a "grandma" scent. I don't know what anyone else's grandma smells like, but I got a completely different impression. I would describe it as very young, very fresh, very early-Summer. The scent makes me think of the month of May in a beach town with a sea breeze and llilacs faintly scenting the air. The top note is sharp & citrusy. Once the fragrance has dried and settled, what's left is sweet; not cloying, but girlish. It's lightly floral, ever so slightly powdery, distantly spicy, somewhat aquatic. Its name, "Fresh," suits it perfectly.

This is a very sweet and endearing, unsophisticated fragrance. So much so that I feel it's too young for me. Since Rochas is a Parisian house, I'll use the French terms: Rochas Fraiche is a scent for an "ingenue," and I'm a woman "d'une certaine age." Basically, I'm too mature for this bubbly concoction. Thinking of a 20th anniversary gift for your beloved wife? Skip this and get a sensuous, womanly classic -- say, almost anything by Chanel. Buying a first "real" perfume for a teenage girl or college graduate? Someone full of optimism, ready to take on the world but not ready to be too seductive? This is perfect.

product_title: Rochas Eau de Rochas Fraîche Eau de Toilette
review_text:
*I* don't like it; let me be clear. Two stars means *I* don't like it, not that it's *not* a good product. One or two reviewers commented on "freshness" and it's fresh (at least mine is). Additionally, I wouldn't call it a "Grandmother" perfume. I could definitely see how some people could go there, but it's really too sharp, and too clean to be a "grandmother" perfume. I tend to gravitate towards sharp, edgy, slightly masculine (or unisex) scents. This is not that. The oak moss and fresh water I thought would do it for me (love oak moss), but really the base smells like equal parts White Flower/Liatris and Musk. The fresh water notes give it that clean somewhat sharp scent and the bergamot and oak moss are largely lost on me (particularly the bergamot). I would imagine that this would be suitable for a mature woman (meaning 40+) that wants to project an air of maturity and refinement (classic/reserved) who may like edgier flowery scents (not just a floral bouquet).

If you're into the edgier scent...that has similar notes, but is much younger you may wish to try Tokyo Milk's "Age of Aquarius" - Begamot, Iceland Moss, White Orchid, and Willow Bark. Very delicious, very edgy...but TM perfumes tend to fade on the quicker side.

Mont Blanc may not get the same publicity as mainstream companies like Calvin Klein and Ralph Lauren, but their fragrances are every bit as good.

review_text:
Considering my self a novice in the cologne arena, I will say that Mont Blanc Legend is an overall decent scent. Awesome for close encounters. When I smell this, I think date night or a cuddle on the couch/ bed room encounter occasion. I can only speak for my skin and body chemistry; if you are looking for a scent that will last and project, this may not be what you are looking for. My rating for this scent is as follows:

Projection: 6/10 (Being Modest but great for a close encounter/ date night)
Longevity: 7/10 (Out the shower application, 4-5 hours max)
Versatility: 7/10 (Can be a work, play, event, etc. but has projection issues in my opinion. Would suggest for date night/ close encounter)
Dry Down: 9/10 (GREAT dry down!!!)
Overall Rating: 7/10 (I would classify this cologne as an "after hours" scent. Definitely great for date nights, close encounters, and snuggles)

*Guys, if you want to go the extra mile or make an "imprint" on a lass, spray a bit on a card or her pillow. One spray is all you need...

If you're looking for a pleasant, inoffensive scent (i.e., something for the office), however, this may be the cologne for you. This is a fruity, woody scent that smells clean. The best way to describe this cologne in a single word is clean. The primary note in this cologne is pineapple, and it is present throughout the life of the cologne. After about an hour or so it becomes a bit more "woody," but the pineapple note is still present.

I wear this cologne on a daily basis, which is in itself an impressive feat. I usually grow tired of a fragrance after a few weeks of using it, but this has been my go-to daily cologne for the past year. This cologne is so "generic" and clean that it really doesn't get stale, even after months and months of using it. It's kind of like soap in the fact that you may smell it the first few times that you use it, but after a while of using it you don't really smell anything at all...even though those around you definitely still smell it! I can definitely recommend this if you are simply looking for a cologne that will make you smell clean and make you feel pretty.

It should be noted that this cologne can be bought for MUCH cheaper on other reputable websites, as I bought a 5oz. bottle for a bit under $40 shipped. This cologne used to be reasonably priced on Amazon, but prices have risen ludicrously as of late for reasons unknown to me.

review_title: Genuine. Great price. Make sure the seller you buy from is Amazon.com I wouldn't trust any other sellers.
review_text:
Personally the only seller that I trust on this site for legit items is Amazon. Sure if it's a computer and fulfilled by Amazon for a 3rd party, I wouldn't say it isn't legit. However, colognes, shoes, sunglasses, etc. are prone to being counterfeit.

With that being said, I absolutely love this fragrance. I smelled a sample in ESPN the magazine and immediately wanted to buy it. I've only used one main cologne the past 15 or so years and that's Acqua di Gio. I guess I became stale to the smell since virtually everyone has been using that cologne for the past few years. I am very particular about colognes and fragrances. Usually I stick with whatever scent of deodorant, shampoo, etc. for the long haul. I don't like it overbearingly strong. My wife's perfume cannot have a strong scent or I won't go near her. I hate the old lady (sorry old ladies) smell of the super strong stuff. I just can't stand it. My wife has a nice, clean scented perfume and I have a nice, clean scented cologne.

After I smelled the sample in the magazine I went to Ulta to make sure it smelled the same, and it did. However I left there when the bottle was 70 or 80 bucks for the 3.3 oz. Went on amazon, saw it for 35 and instantly bought it. I don't regret it. I love it.

Don't go based on these reviews. Of course I think it's a 5 star product, but we may have opposite tastes. Go to your local perfume store, pick out a scent, leave and buy it from Amazon since it's most likely going to be a lot cheaper.

The only negative thing I have to say is the silver top came off during transit. Didn't hurt it. I just wish it were more secure.

product_title: MONTBLANC Legend Eau de Toilette 3.3 fl.oz.
review_title: Attractive, masculine "Sport" Scent. A little goes a long way.
review_text:
A nice cologne "pour homme".  Smells like a more mature version of Abercrombie's "Fierce", which a number of older men are wearing these days, though sadly most of them wear too much of it.
I'm a 24 year old female obsessed with perfumes and cologne, so once I found this one in my local Sephora I fell in love and had to have it, for almost $80 though I was less than enthused. bought it on amazon for a much more reasonable price. From what I can tell it's the exact same scent and has the same staying power as the sample I have of Legend from Sephora, so if it's a knockoff like one reviewer said, then it's the best knockoff i've ever seen and would buy it again in a heart beat.
Even though I'm a girl I've worn this countless times and been told I smell amazing by men and women. The men I've known who wore this in the right amount (i.e. only enough that it lingered in the air close to them instead of smelling up the entire room they entered) had me wanting to get close to them, a few of them I honestly felt like hugging for hours just so I could enjoy their scent.
I like Legend on men and women so I consider it unisex, even though it is a distinctly masculine "sport" scent- much in the vein of some of  Lacoste, Polo, and YSL's more young-male centered scents.

Men: Pair this with a sharp suit or business-casual shirt and slacks ensemble and I promise you that your attractiveness level will shoot up (for additional points: master a foreign accent and stand up straight, discuss the need for women's rights/equality and tell young women that they seem very wise and mature for their age, it seems to be even more persuasive than staring at their chests).
As for women: Do we even have to try? haha- mist this in the air and walk through it, catch the scent throughout the day and feel that rush in your blood stream that your first crush or new infatuation causes within you whenever you see or think of him/her.

review_text:
There have been many comparisons of Mont Blanc Legend to A&F Fierce, as brash as the the latter is in contrast to the smooth development of MBL. This fragrance lives on the skirts of the barbershop fougere camp, no question. It reminds me of a toned-down Truefitt and Hill's Grafton lightly overlaid with the subtle powder of Armani Code. It is suited for both office and evening wear. MB Legend has moderate sillage and staying power, even if it is a bit linear in the drydown. However, it need make no apology and can hold its own with any masculine designer fragrance.

Mont Blanc Legend is a solid choice in an age of unisex fragrances. Recommended.

review_title: Probably one of the best scents out there
review_text:
I've sampled a lot of different colognes, and I get nothing but compliments on this one - It's not soapy, it doesn't have any of the "baby powder" smell that I hate, it's not overly strong like Polo - it smells.. classy.

There's really only one reason for a four-star vs. a five-star rating: Compared to some other colognes, like Polo, this doesn't quite have the "staying power". It doesn't sit real heavy, nor does it seem to last all day and night. For this reason, if you are used to wearing something that everybody can smell coming all day, you would probably be disappointed. This is a more subtle scent, and won't announce your presence when you enter a room - even with several sprays in the a.m., it really won't last all day, unless you get close. It doesn't completely disappear, but she'll have to get into your personal space to smell it - which isn't a bad thing.

Some guys might feel like, since this isn't one of the cheaper colognes out there, that if it doesn't stink up the room, they're not getting a good value. Personally, I think it's a great value (if you don't pay $72/bottle MSRP) and lasts a very long time. My first bottle in this 3.3 oz size lasted 8 months. Not too shabby. Plus, I'm not into stinking up the room.

If you're looking for a really great scent that isn't fruity, isn't musky, isn't soapy, and has no baby powder odor, this is an excellent choice. As always, try before you buy. Hit up the cologne counter at a local store and try it out - everybody's taste is different. Just be advised that this is not a heavy or long-lasting cologne. If you're going out at night, you'll need to hit it again.

review_title: Amazing, masculine all year long scent
review_text:
I suggest before purchasing any fragrance to try it out in store to see how the fragrance reacts to your personal body chemistry. Also, when buying cologne online, check the sellers rating to insure your getting the freshest product from the designer.

Onto my review of Mont Blanc! This amazing fragrance took me by surprise as it just arrived in store. The scent is aromatic, little fresh and sweet but not overwhelming.  The composition opens with fresh aromatic tones of bergamot, lavender, pineapple leaf and exotic verbena (Litsea Cubeba). The heart emphasizes oakmoss note (evernyl molecule) merged with geranium, coumarin, apple, rose, and Pomarosa molecule (notes of dried fruit). The base contains sandalwood, tonka and evernyl.

This mixture produces an amazing scent that has proven to last all day and gain the compliments of strangers. Fragrances I normally wear include Armani Code, Armani Aqua Di Gio, Bvlgari Aqva Marine, YSL L'Homme or La Nuit de L'HOMME, Bvlgari Man and Channel Bleu. Just in case your wondering my taste in fragrance because I personally added Mont Blanc to my shelves.

product_title: Kenneth Cole Reaction Connected Eau De Toilette Spray for Men, 4.2 Ounce
review_text:
Colognes are a hard thing to reviews, because every aspect could be a plus or minus for someone else.

Smell: Spring/summer scent for sure. Definitely sweet and fruity, but not feminine, there's some woody notes as well.  I don't know why Kenneth Cole calls this a "Woody Spicy" fragrance, I only get spice when I'm trying to find it, so I might even be imagining it.  Consider this "Fruity Woody."  I find it pretty addicting, even after a month I'm still smelling myself when no one is looking.

Sillage/Projection: Not much, honestly someone would have to be next to you to really notice it.  This is a plus for me since I wear fragrance for myself, I feel like wearing a pungent fragrance is like listening to your music loudly on a plane, it's bad taste.

Longevity: Also not much, maybe 3 hours, this is where I take a star away, I just wish it was more, at least it's cheap enough and the bottle is big enough to reapply if you wanted.

Overall I think it's worth it if you're like me, but if you prefer stronger scents then definitely look elsewhere.

review_text:
Love at first smell!

I can't believe I'm the first to review this on Amazon. I've passed over this fragrance and not even given it a chance many times.  I'm a 30 something woman and my husband (40's) sniffed this one out at Ulta and sprayed some on paper for me. Instantly, we both thought this smelled so good! Fruity and floral. I thought I smelled a hint of vanilla but it's not on the list. It smells youthful and will be good for a variety of ages without smelling teenagery. I really like it and don't think I'll tire of it quickly. Kinda pricey, but it's worth it to finally find a fragrance that doesn't turn my stomach with too sweet or too heavy notes. Perfectly balanced fragrance that doesn't give me a headache. I didn't really like Euphoria because it was too floral for my tastes, but FE is just right.

From the CK website: Sensual. alluring. modern. a younger interpretation of the iconic euphoria fragrance, forbidden euphoria evokes a modern, fresh sexiness with a mysterious twist. forbidden euphoria is a seductive blend of exotic fruits, addictive floralcy and sophisticated musks.
top notes: sparkling mandarin, passion fruit and touches of iced raspberry
mid notes: a hypnotic bouquet of tiger orchid and jasmine
base notes: addictive patchouli with sophisticated musks and cashmere woods

product_title: Calvin Klein One Shock for Him Men Eau De Toilette Spray, 3.4 Ounce
review_title: Put a Shock in your Day..!!
review_text: Definitely a must purchase... Ck Shock is definitely unique and I am glad I purchased (there are some purchases I leave with the feeling, "why did I buy this cologne?").  It provides opening notes of musk and pepper and settles into a chocolate tobacco mix.  That may not sound appealing to some, but it is not to be discounted.  The "wow factor" is above average with some compliments from the ladies and the longevity is above average - lasting, albeit barely, a whole work day.  In addition to the usual spray areas (neck and wrists), I have started spraying a couple of dashes on my undershirt - during the day, with certain movements, I will get a whiff of the fragrance.  Shock lasts the day and is refreshing - kind of like Red Bull or 5-hour energy for the nose..!!  The buy is fantastic at just slighly over $30 and at the time of this review, free shipping is a bonus.  The bottle is "cooly" (if I may coin that word) designed and a great conversation piece.  I would have no problem wearing Shock anytime of year or any occasion, although I would bet most would prefer to wear in summer and/or perhaps early fall.  Go for it.  4.3 stars out of 5.  Enthusiasm moves the world...
