It put me in mind of Coco Chanel (which I can't wear). It is a strong lingering fragrance. Even after having it on awhile it didn't change greatly. That's not to say this is not a very nice, quality fragrance. Like other perfumes/EDT's, it's very individual. My niece tried it and wasn't crazy about it; my sister tried it and on her it was good. In fairness, I'm giving it 4 stars--on other folks it might well be a 5 star "I love it" scent.

product_title: Laura Biagiotti Essenza Di Roma Eau de Toilette for Women, 0.84 fl. oz.
review_title: Starts out as a crisp scent which changes to a long lasting powdery scent with a hint of vanilla
review_text:
Because of body chemistry, the same fragrance can smell differently on different people. When three of my family members test the same fragrance, it smells differently on each of us. Two of us tested Laura Biagiotti Essenza Di Roma Eau de Toilette, and no, surprise here, it smelled differently on each of us. However on each of us, the fragrance changed to a powdery scent within a half hour or less of applying it. And, to add more confusion to my review, I like this fragrance, my daughter-in-law doesn't.

Most of my favorite fragrances are the ones that change to a powdery scent...and I love some vanilla added too. I think Essenza di Roma is strong when first sprayed; I  spray it sparingly now; a little goes a long way. Each time I've worn it, it changed to a powdery scent rather quickly...within 10 minutes or so. As the day wears on, the powdery scent becomes softer & softer. The long lasting fragrance doesn't diminish, but becomes softer.
I don't like the fragrance when it's first sprayed, but love the powdery scent that becomes softer as the hours pass.

The main fragrance accords are: woody, citrus, vanilla, sweet, powdery.

From Amazon's product description:  "This scent captures the essence of femininity built around a core of woodsy notes that form the base. Layers of vanilla and almond continue the theme of warmth, while mandarin orange and cyclamen round out the top."

The frosted bottle, with soft gold cap is elegant looking & designed to look like a Roman pillar. The top of the attractive lid is slightly angled.

I like Essenza di Roma and will use it often.

review_text:
I would think it is quite a challenge to order perfume on-line unless you are familiar with the scent.  The sense of smell is such a selective thing so one person's rose can be another person's skunk Cabbage. And a perfume can smell entirely different, on different people, when it combines with a person's individual chemistry so all I can give you is my personal opinion.

Laura Biagiotti Essenza Di Roma Eau de Toilette for Women is in a very attractive bottle with a gold-tone top and spray dispenser.  This is an eau de toilette which isn't as long lasting as a perfume and it is cheaper than a perfume, of course.

This is a "gourmand" scent.  Or a "foodie" scent. It has almond, vanilla,mandarin orange and slight floral undertone.  The only scent I can think of, which is similar, is Jessica Simpson's "`Sweet  treats".  I consider this a daytime scent, light and fresh.

They say:
 "benefits....  A soft and elegant fragrance capturing eternal values and celebrating true emotions "

I'm not sure what that means but it smells sort of good anyway.

review_text:
I find reviews of anything involving smell and sound to always be a curious thing.  As the son of a musician, music reviews baffle me: "a thumping beat that belies a gritty sound" -- what? That sounds like food to me.  So I'll do my best to convey what this smells like as someone who is not an expert in describing smells.

The first thing I noticed is that the smell is not that strong.  This is important to me -- I know enough men who drench themselves in the stuff and I'm always concerned that I'm spraying too much, so I only do a few spritzes. That's sufficient without being overwhelming, which I consider to be a good thing.

The second is that the smell is musky.  I'm not sure what "British" smells like, but this is definitely a male cologne.  I have no idea what "artemisia" smells like, or how you can tell a mandarin tree is "sun-drenched" from a smell, but the cedarwood and "woody aroma" definitely come through.

I have had a few people positively comment that I smelled good, but the most important critic -- my wife -- likes it, so it gets five stars from me!

My son, who was modeling it, agreed. He smelled like fresh laundry, like he had just been through the dryer cycle and was ready to wear. It was a very subtle scent that increased in potency over the next little bit, I assume as his body warmed the cologne. From there, there's a touch of musk, just a hint of earthiness.

Whatever went into it and whatever notes it has, it's a good smell, lingering but not overwhelming (when judiciously applied, of course).

I will note that I am perfume sensitive and some scents trigger my allergies. Some do not. This one did. I won't ding it for my confused immune system, though. It does what it's meant to do. Just don't wear too much.

review_title: Classic soft scent, with floral and citrus top notes.
review_text: Burberry Touch is a classic scent.  It has been around for over a decade.  I would generally consider this to be more of a daytime fragrance for use in temperate weather, when it is not particularly hot or cold, say in the upper-60sF to low-70sF. It has mixed overtones of spicy and fruity notes.  The opening notes are citrus and floral, the primary mid notes are spice (nutmeg) and cedar, and the low notes are musky (tonka beans) and woody (vetiver).  The floral overtones soften the scent and the citrus overtones give it some sweetness that may not be for everyone but I would consider it to be a fairly good scent overall.

review_text:
The title of my review reflects the three words that come to mind when I smell Burberry for Men.  Likewise that is the aura that's projected when wearing this fragrance.  The three basic notes I get when I smell Burberry for Men are a spicy, slightly fruity top; a woody heart, and a warm, sweet, vanilla base.  Those notes are well balanced to lead to a very rich, strong fragrance that projects well.

I would recommend this fragrance for the more mature crowd, it's warm spiciness may be a bit out of place on a younger wearer.  Likewise this is also not a very casual scent.  It can be casual, but it walks the line.  I wouldn't wear this while in shorts and a t-shirt, or to work.  It's just a bit too powerful and warm.  Burberry for Men is best suited for non-business formal events like a wedding; or going out for a night on the town; or going out to run errands dressed nicely.  A great cold weather fragrance.

The cologne is very potent.  One spray is usually all I do.  It lasts quite a long time, smells consistent through its course, and has superior projection.  The bottle is nice, the sprayer and cap are solid, and the juice is a wonderful colour.  Overall a great fragrance.

1 year later, I ordered a 100 ml and I don't know if the bottle I purchased was bad or they had reformulated it that year or it was the fact that I purchased it in the US, it didn't smell anything like what it had smelled before. It is not bad, but definitely not what I was awed at.

I am still a novice at picking up the notes, so I'll leave that to the experts. It's definitely a day time cologne and do not expect a massive sillage or longevity. It lasted about 1 hr on my skin but a little over 3 hrs on my shirts.

Would I buy it again? If I can get what I had smelled first, 200%. I'd actually buy a bottle more and keep it in stock, just in case I never find it again. But with what I have, may be not. There are better colognes out there that I haven't tried.

review_title: A bit of spice, but not overwhelming
review_text:
My husband doesn't wear cologne except on the very rare occasion, and then generally not very much of it. When he does wear it, I tend to like the scent on him while we're in the house, but as soon as we get into the enclosed space of the car, it becomes overwhelming and gives me a headache. I don't know if it's because he generally uses a cheaper product or because of the particular scent of this cologne, but I've found that I'm not bothered by the Burberry Eau de Toilette at all.

The scent reminds me of the spicy notes in Polo (or even Old Spice), but without being overwhelming or stinking. As with any scent, body chemistry plays a big role in how the scent works on people, and I find that I really like how this scent interacts with my husbands body chemistry. It's clean, spicy, and kinda sexy, too.

product_title: Burberry Men's Classic Eau de Toilette Spray, 1.7 fl. oz.
review_text:
The manufacturers use a lot of fancy language to describe all the layers of this scent. For me it all adds up to a delightful complexity including sweet and spicy, powerful but not overwhelming. I love the way it smells on a man, so guys, this is the one to spritz on for those special occasions. It doesn't take much to get the effect, so you can make this bottle last a long time.

As a woman, I'm not generally fond of a lot of popular men's colognes and aftershaves. Some of them are too potent and make me sneeze, and a lot of them just smell to me like overwhelming men's deodorant you would put on after a trip to the gym. This classic Burberry scent strikes just the right note, noticeable yet subtle. Definitely worth the price if you're looking for a more sophisticated men's fragrance.

product_title: Burberry Men's Classic Eau de Toilette Spray, 1.7 fl. oz.
review_text:
Burberry's cologne for men is a classic, masculine aroma that exudes several qualities at once. First aroma impressions bring to mind a sense of confidence, a degree of warmth and layers of complexity. The base woodsy notes of Cedar and Sandalwood are the first elements to reveal itself followed by citrus/lavender and finishes out with a lingering glow of Amber. It's really a classy, timeless scent that complements equally well whether suited up to impress or in casual attire of chinos and a polo for a leisurely afternoon of rest and relaxation.

Note: Keep your spritzes light as the fragrance comes on strong, particularly during the first 30 minutes of application. A couple of hours later and that initial spray becomes a pleasant, lingering accent note to accompany you through the remainder of your day and/or night.

review_text:

For everyone else, I like a nice uncomplicated smell.  Fresh, clean, just out from the shower, is the perfect scent.  Then they always mess it up by getting all sweaty  nice, sometimes, but mostly, not.

It is hard to convince a teenager he should not smell like a womens magazine, especially when all his friends seems to be dipping their heads in one.

I showed him how I put scent on and invited him to try it.  I send a tiny spritz in the air in front of me and let it dissipate a little and then step into it. He didn't like that, not at all.  Apparently he prefers to spray it all over himself so he, too, can announce himself, five minutes before he walks into a room.

product_title: Burberry Men's Classic Eau de Toilette Spray, 1.7 fl. oz.
review_text: Like its Burberry namesake, this eponymous scent exudes classic-contemporary British style. Sitting somewhere between the fruity high notes of Apothia's Velvet Rope and the woody lows of Tommy Bahama's For Him, Burberry manages to take the rich floral and tropical exotica and ground them in a masculine bergamot-sandalwood blend that eschews musk in favor of deep richness. And like a perfect Burberry plaid, it blends those ideas into an impeccable pattern that is as classic as it is fashionable. It's the gentlemen's cologne, the one that makes me want to put on my best suit and roll out in my Rolls. Or, you know, my Ford... I may not be able to afford the car, but I can afford the cologne. Well worth the money.

product_title: Burberry Men's Classic Eau de Toilette Spray, 1.7 fl. oz.
review_title: A warm scent that lasts throughout the day
review_text: I've long been a fan of Burberry products and this product doesn't disappoint. The best thing that I like about Burberry products is that it doesn't take much to give you a scent that lasts throughout the day - my husband uses two spritzes and when he comes home, he still smells wonderful. The description of this says: "The scent features bright top notes of bergamot, combined with the summer scents of lavender and mint. Heart notes of moss, geranium and sandalwood add depth and vitality. Warm notes of amber, cedar wood and tonka smooth the base. " Now I don't get all these different scents when I smell this cologne, but I do get wood and vanilla that combines in such a warm and pleasant way. My husband loves this cologne, and I do too. Highly recommended.

product_title: Burberry Men's Classic Eau de Toilette Spray, 1.7 fl. oz.
review_text:
I vacillated between 2 and 3 stars for this review.

After reconsidering back and forth, 2 stars is the way our personal assessment of this mens Eau de Toilette goes.  We didn't like it and would not purchase it.  This fragrance was for our review for the Amazon Vine Program.

As a woman, I have enjoyed and repeated purchase of Burberry Brit for women. Every time I wear this fragrance, I am sure to get compliments.

Anticipating the same for the Burberry for men, we were excited to try this Eau De Toilette.

Our impressions:
When first spritzed it has a nice fragrancelightly assertive and crisp.  However, this scent faded quite quickly.  I kept inquiring if my husband had it on.

My husband then applied an extra spritz or two.  It again faded quickly.

I tried it myselfsame outcome.

It also seems to fade to a very light non-memorable scent.

From all I have read about personal scentsit is just that.

Chemistries are unique.  Hence, varying impressions ensue.

For us, not a winner, but for some others, it could be a wonderful.

product_title: Burberry Men's Classic Eau de Toilette Spray, 1.7 fl. oz.
review_title: Clean and Warm Scent That Doesn't Overpower
review_text:
Ha! I used my husband as my test dummy on this product and I was the sniffer. A short and light spritz on my hand told the story. The dominant scent was bergamot with a slight mix of lavender and mint. Loved the touch of mint! It was ever so slightly fragrant without being overpowering. The rest created a woodsy feel and complemented the slight fragrance. I thought it was masculine and sexy. Subtle yet still out there. Very nice.
Being forewarned that a little went a long way, my husband applied this judiciously. What can I say? He always smells nice, but this upped the ante from my point of view. This scent lasted for at least eight hours. It reminded me of the way the woods smell in early fall as in 'fresh and invigorating'. I also picked up on a touch of vanilla. Just so nice.
I'm not always crazy about scent for men or women, but this is so pleasant and subtle that it is hard to imagine this not being a great choice for any man.

product_title: Burberry Men's Classic Eau de Toilette Spray, 1.7 fl. oz.
review_text:
My husband likes scent which is good, because I like it too. It's pretty potent when he first sprays it on and he only uses a single spritz. At first I thought it might be too overwhelming but after about 10 minutes it calms down to a nice level. This is definitely a manly scent, not one of those that I would borrow. The scents that I pick out the most are the woodsy, sandalwood and cedar. The lavender and mint are more subtle. Overall it has a warm and sophisticated fragrance, not one of the teen variety colognes. I think this is targeted more to the businessman or mature personality.

The bottle is elegant, very simple and understated. It comes in a wine colored box and would make a nice gift.

product_title: Burberry Men's Classic Eau de Toilette Spray, 1.7 fl. oz.
review_text:
I wear cologne pretty much daily, unless I'm bumming around the house in a t-shirt.  My usual favorite brands are Armani for men, Escada, and Marc Jacobs.  I've not tried or smelled Burberry before.

I enjoy the scent of this product a lot.  It's light and fresh.  Masculine without being overpowering or overly musky.  Seems to have citrus and sandalwood undertones.  I think it's the sort of cologne that makes a nice impression.

As a man, nothing is more of a buzzkill than meeting a pretty lady who is wearing horrible perfume.  I once had a date with an attractive blonde who's eau de toilette actually smelled like a dirty toilet!  Well, more like Black Flag bug spray actually.  But I'd guess that an overpowering or nasty cologne can also kill it for a guy too.

That shouldn't be an issue with Burberry for Men.  I like it a lot.

product_title: Burberry Men's Classic Eau de Toilette Spray, 1.7 fl. oz.
review_text:
Burberry is not a brand I have used in the past so I was not sure I would like this.  I own some Burberry menswear - I just didn't know they made cologne until I saw this.

The official notes say "A fresh and energetic fragrance with top notes of bergamot, lavender, fresh mint and thyme.
Heart notes of moss, geranium and sandalwood give depth and vitality to the scent. Solar notes of amber and cedar wood add a warm and woody aroma."

I agree with all of that.  Here's my take on it:

A complex, sweet, yet woodsy scent with touches of lavender, cooling mint and grassy herbs atop a base of vanilla.  This product is relatively long lasting yet not overpowering.  Having said that, a single spray/spritz is really enough.

I like the scent enough that I would purchase it again.

product_title: Burberry Men's Classic Eau de Toilette Spray, 1.7 fl. oz.
review_title: I am not exaggerating when I say this is my new favorite scent
review_text:
With D&G 'The one' and Calvin Klein's 'Euphoria' being my favorite fragrances, I decided to go ahead and try 'Burberry' for men. I was a little hesitant at first, but then again, the brand is a guarantee of quality, right? Indeed it is.

At first I did not like the size of the bottle (too small compared to the others mentioned) but then, after using it for a while I realized there was a reason behind that: the fragrance is quite strong, in a good sense,  a couple sprays should suffice for it to stay with you all day long. It is strong in the sense that it lasts, but it is a subtle fragrance, fresh with a sweet base.

I am not exaggerating when I say this is my new favorite scent.

product_title: Burberry Men's Classic Eau de Toilette Spray, 1.7 fl. oz.
review_text:
This is another nice fragrance for men from Burberry. I don't know the technical differences in whether cologne smells like wood, smells sweet or has vanilla.  I judge cologne on two things: How I like the fragrance and how others like it on me.  I did get numerous compliments on this one but I found others liked it more on me, than I liked it myself.  But that's just a personal preference on scent.  It is strong, but I don't find it any stronger than the usual designer fragrances. One spray will do, and it will last throughout the day.

Burberry London is one of my favorite three colognes I currently wear.  Considering the good feedback I received from others, I'll rotate this into the line-up occasionally.

review_text: PERFECT!  I was browsing at scents for men, and OMG I came across Touch! I don't like most modern men's colognes; they usually have that super strong "macho" smell like someone just dunked himself in a pool of cologne that makes you want to run 'cause he's anything but "manly" because he stinks so bad and you can smell him a million miles away.  TOUCH is different!  It's more subtle with a dry powdery scent.  So hard to describe, but I NEVER get sick of it, and it lasts on my husband all day.  I swear... there are very few fragrances that I could smell all day.  This one is soft, not overly-stated yet manly!  I would wear it with no problem, however, ha.ha.  It's a smell that exudes confidence and style.  No woman will find this offensive.  It is very attractive, unlike those other super-strong smells that some men like to hind behind like AXE and the like.

The woody aroma of vetiver and the soft musk of tonka beans..." Nonsense. It smells like a mix of baby powder with a hint of sandalwood, & is entirely too effeminate for a man's fragrance. That said, they clearly used quality sources of scent, because I have always been extremely sensitive/allergic to "industrial grade" scents found everywhere & incorporated into almost everything from anti-perspirant to shaving cream & everything in between, and even in expensive, supposedly "high end" perfumes. Unlike those other products, this at least doesn't send me into a tizzy of eye-watering, nose-itching, borderline asthmatic paroxysms of discomfort. I just wish it didn't make me smell like some hottie's best gay gal-pal: the last thing I want is automatic billeting in the "friend zone!" Another reviewer stated that the product has been reformulated repeatedly, and that the latest versions were unsatisfactory, so I imagine that's what I rec'd., instead of the early versions that led to the rave reviews that convinced me to take the plunge on buying this online w/o prior testing. C'est la vie. Just an object lesson to read the critical reviews as well as the most popular ones on Amazon!

product_title: MONTBLANC Legend Intense Eau de Toilette, 3.3 fl. oz.
review_text: Fragrances are something you really have to try out in person. You can read all you want about top notes, middle notes, and bottom, but I never found text descriptions to be useful, and even if they were, fragrances react uniquely with your personal skin chemistry. The way it smells on you is different than the way it smells on someone else. And you can't just spray the fragrance on a tester strip. You have to apply it your skin. With that having been said, let's get down to talking about this MONTBLANC EDT. Both the bottle design and scent are very similar to Guilty By Gucci EDT spray for Men, 3 Ounce. If you like Guilty, you may find this comparable. The spiciness is a bit like Lancome La Vie Est Belle L'Eau de Parfum Spray, 3.4 Ounce (a woman's fragrance). With a name like Intense, you'd expect this to be, well, intense. It's not. The scent is very milquetoast. It's pleasant, but very subtle and short-lived. I applied a "stream" of it my forearm about 15 minutes ago and cannot smell it anymore. My arm is about 2 ft from my nose as I sit typing. I said "stream" because the nozzle design is terrible. It does not spray out as a mist. It comes out as a stream of liquid. This is probably an intentional decision -- it makes you use more of the product, and therefore, you will deplete the bottle quicker. You'll also need to use a lot more of it to get the same coverage effect compared to other EDTs with a higher concentration of essential oils. I work in the beauty industry and I'm around fragrances all day (but on the web technology side), for what that's worth. Higher quality fragrances have a higher concentration of "essential oils". I suspect that percentage is very low here, given the very short scent lifetime. Contrast this with Issey Miyake L'eau D'issey 4.2 Ounce Edt Spray, which I think is a much better buy and performance ratio, ounce for ounce. One spritz and I smell nice ALL DAY. It's understated, but long lasting. My wife loves it and every time I come home from work, she remarks on how much she loves that scent. Lastly, I love the bottle design, but don't like how short the cap is. If you put this in a gym bag or luggage, it'll easy come uncapped. Overall, it's a good, clean, if short-lived, scent. If you're thinking about buying it, I highly recommend you go to someplace like Sephora to try it out in person first. And while you're there, try out the other 2 men's fragrances I mentioned. Buy it online at another store though. You can find this fragrance for almost 1/3 the price on a popular site.

product_title: BURBERRY Brit Eau De Toilette for Him, 3.3 Fl. oz.
review_title: Something special... spicy and yet mellow.
review_text:
This cologne is very spicy and is perhaps one of my favorites next to Burberry Fragrance for men. Whereas Burberry Fragrance was fruity, Brit is slightly different in that the scent is more floral and certainly more spicy (and yet not as heavy or as complex as London).

For something as spicy I'm quite surprised with how light this one comes across (in comparison with London which was just a little too heavy for me). I have to agree with other reviewers and say that it's still by far very masculine indeed. Vanilla is immediately noticed, as well as more fruity undertones which only increase as time passes ("juicy green mandarin," perhaps but you need to be a poet to sense it... again, admittedly sweet). Warning, this product is not nearly as citrus/lemon/orange the Burberry Fragrance; instead it follows in London's footsteps and provides spiciness in yet a more minimal way.

Can be worn in a similar fashion, either for formal affairs or casual ones, though I'd gather it is selected most often for casual ones (I did find a similarity between this and Chanel's Allure, and yet I find Allure much more pungent... I love Allure, but if you want something a little more mellow for the night, this is your product).

Sweet, spicy, deep and complex Brit marks itself as my second favorite from the Burberry line - sharing the spot right on top with the Burberry Fragrance! Can be worn daily without becoming tiring, a feature which I think it holds over Burberry Fragrance whose citrus-sweet Fragrance may become an annoyance.

product_title: BURBERRY Brit Eau De Toilette for Him, 3.3 Fl. oz.
review_text: After trying Burberry's Brit for men, I have a few things to say about it.  You better like smelling like a baby, since all I could smell was the overtones of baby oil and a light, powdery note as well.  I've heard people rave about the ginger note, smoked vanilla, and really, really wish that I could see through all the BS, but I believe, at the end of the day, that Brit isn't delivering anything new.  Yes, it isn't as spicy as I usually prefer, and I was open to something new, but Brit reminds me of a few colognes I've experienced in the past.  It has an understated presence like Grey Flannel.  It's one you'll be able to smell, not overpowering, and a rather developed scent.  Not that Grey Flannel was a fave, either, just a comparison.  The initial note will have you believing that Brit is much more spicy than it ends up.  Truth is, after it dries down, the "surprise" factor is lost, and it has some of the irritating notes I've come to dislike in other underdeveloped scents like Joop, and >gasp< Curve.  It may be a newer direction for Burberry, and one that's not so stuffy, but I would rather purchase a unique scent instead of one that is a cross between too many uncertain notes.

review_title: Buy with confidence FROM Amazon LLC.
review_text: This is my first time buying fragrances from Amazon.  And with that being said, buy the fragrances FROM Amazon LLC. I was hesitant at first because I had read some reviews regarding people receiving inauthentic fragrance or having fragrances diluted with alcohol.  This product arrived in its original box, factory sealed, in typical Amazon packaging to protect from the turbulence of shipping. So as long as you purchase DIRECTLY from Amazon and not a third party seller you will be satisfied.  In some reviews I read some have speculated and cried product fraud because they are cheaper than department stores.  Everything on Amazon is cheaper than retail, but my guess is the fragrances are overstock from the previous year, hence the surplus and knock down of price per ounce. However fragrance, especially EDT, has a shelf life of 3-5 years.  So as long as you use it in a reasonable time frame and keep the fragrance in a cool, dark environment, it will have the longevity and maintain the pungency one is looking for.  As for the fragrance, I love this one, personal favorite.  All Burberry fragrances are unique and have a particular signature. This one at first breaks into its opening notes with a bit of a powdery aroma, which can give off a bit of a feminine vibe, however, allow it to settle a bit and it will produce subtle woodsy, aromatic notes.  It is not overbearing and does not produce a dominating presence.  However fragrance should never be worn to drown peoples' olfactory, and we all know that guy.  In addition, women LOVE this scent.  I have received more compliments with this fragrance than many others, which baffles me because it is so popular. It can be worn during the day but I find it is best appreciated in the evening during the fall/winter seasons.  But bottom line, buy with confidence FROM Amazon.

product_title: BURBERRY Brit Eau De Toilette for Him, 3.3 Fl. oz.
review_text:
I bought this cologne on shear whim having heard a long, exaggerated story from a female coworker. Basically, without out all the girly 'woo' about it, my coworker said she was out with her husband to a holiday play and the man sitting next to her had the "most attractive" smell about him and that by the end of the play, she caught herself practically leaning completely on this "amazing smelling guy." Then she went on to gab about the rest of the night and got all fluffy and excited again when she got to the part about how her and her husband ran into that same guy from the play at a nearby bar. With the courage of alcohol (I guess), she flirt-terogated him to find out what cologne he was wearing... none other than, you guessed it, Burberry Brit.
Now... the review should end here, right? Sounds amazing, just seeing this girl get all worked up about it...WRONG...

So I bought into her story all the same and had made up my mind, I was going to buy this magical potion that makes even married women pretty much ditch their husbands right in front of them. No true reason to have something with this potential power, being married myself, I just enjoyed the concept of it I guess. So I ditched my go to cologne Acqua di Gio, with many success stories under it's belt in my bachelor days (even dated a girl once that called it "sure f***" ...classy lady), I suited up and sprayed down my new attention getter...
My first target...the wife of course... I couldn't wait to have her extra fluffy and roused (to put it kindly). Within seconds of walking in our home, my wife starts sniffing the air like a birddog and looks at me with a bitter beer face and says to me, "Bluck! Where have you been today, playing Bingo at an old folks home?" .... Ok... she was pregnant at the time, maybe it was her hormonal imbalance or something to that effect, this stuff doesn't smell like an old man to me.
Test target two... sprayed the tiniest bit on me and headed to the Hospital where I was doing a clinical rotation in the ER for school, hoping I would get a few reassuring compliments from some of the younger (or older) nurses working there... wrong again. Not an hour into the shift, the only good looking nurse there approached me and said that one of the patients had just complained about my cologne and that I should try and wash some of it off. The culprit, a 79 y/o lady that has COPD from smoking, of all things. A little confused I asked the nurse, "Is it really that strong?" Half giggling, she answered, "It's not that it's strong so much as it's kinda soapy and, well, odd I guess..." (guess she was trying to tell me off easy). Then later that night she was laughing about the irony of the whole thing, pointing out that people usually complain about the smell of a Hospital, not the cologne that staff members wear in a Hospital...

To cut this long story short, I can't wear this cologne even if I wanted to. review_title: Very Powerful and Smells Nothing Like Fresh Laundry
review_text: This is a very handy little product, though I do not like the fragrance.  First of all, having a roller small enough to fit in one's makeup case is clever and convenient.  As to the frangrance itself, I've never worn this before and Ulta no longer sells it, and Sephora is too far away from where I live for me to make the trip.  I dabbed a tiny bit on one wrist and a tiny bit on my neck, and the smell was so powerful it made me think the manufacturer was somehow in error!  After several hours, the scent never settled into anything smeling remotely like laundry.  It wasn't even pleasant.  I was looking for something light and "clean."  I guess I'll stick wiih Bath & Body Works "White Citrus" and Calgon's "Perfect Bliss."  After wasting $20, I'll rethink the trip to Sephora if I want to try anything traditional department stores don't carry.

review_text:
You know, reviewing eau de toilette is not an easy task. It's one of those things you generally really need to smell for yourself to decide if you like it.

Helpful, I know.

I could just say that if you like this Burberry Brit Rhythm smell, then you should buy it, and if you don't like this smell, then... you probably shouldn't buy it.

No, still not helpful.

I'll say this (trying to be helpful, truly) that it's a very pleasant smell. Some people tell me they can smell the cardamom, but I just give them a blank stare. I'm a guy, I admit it, so blank stares come often when it comes to describing odors. It's a very inoffensive smell in terms of the Annoying Everyone Around You scale, though. It's certainly classy, - but don't overspray it. Even one press on the snazzy-looking bottle can be enough, and the smell does stay with you for several hours.

Overall, I've really enjoyed using Brit Rhythm (and being British, it feels just slightly better - for no tangible reason of course). It works for a casual event, or for business use. And unless you go completely crazy with it, the 3oz bottle will last an extremely long time.

5 out of 5 stars. Highly recommended (...for me. For you? Who knows...? Chances are good you'll like it, though, given other reviews here...).

review_text: My 18 year old son loves this fragrance. He puts it on each morning and it lasts all day through his classes without being obnoxious.  He especially likes it because he's the only guy in his circle of friends who wears it, so it is really distinctive.  I did have my husband (late 30's) try this cologne as well, and it didn't smell "right" on him.  I don't know if it is because of his body chemistry (likely) or because it does seem to be a "young" fragrance, and while my husband isn't old, he isn't quite the "clubbing" age either.  Regardless, this has been a hit with my son and I will buy him more when this runs out.

review_title: A youthful but masculine fragrance for men
review_text:
This isn't scent for any man, but it does have a nice appeal on the right person. I picked this up not knowing if I'd give it to my hubby or my son. It wasn't a match for my hubby as light woods and citrus scents are better suited for him, but for me son it was a perfect match.

When buying scents online, it is best to first go and learn which scents and notes are best suited to your skin, then you can look for those undertones when purchasing online. However, sometimes it is fun to try something different.

To me this has a youthful yet masculine scent. The patchouli note is a hard one to match to the right man, however if you are able to wear it...wow. The black leather note is what give this a rebel, youthful touch and why it was perfect for my son.

product_title: BURBERRY Brit Rhythm Men Eau De Toilette, 3 Fl. oz.
review_text: My husband rarely wears a fragrance, but I kind of liked when he used to have a little something on when we had a night out, so we gave the Burberry Brit Rhythm a try.  I don't know what exactly makes this a young or edgy fragrance, I think it is just a nice smell.  I read what it was supposed to smell like and really couldn't say it smelled like one note overtook the rest or that it had a strong scent of one particular thing.  It smelled a little like wood/cedar to me and I thought it was a nice blend.  It was not too heavy-handed on the fragrance and tended to stay on when he wore it.  Overall, I think it is nice and would love to have him wear it occasionally.  He thought it smelled good, though it didn't seem like a real "wow" factor for him.  Nice packaging, good fragrance and stayed on.  May purchase again, depending on whether he gravitates to wearing it more often.

review_title: Good smelling, good deal, pretty solid all around.
review_text:
There is nothing wrong with the Brit Rhythm cologne.  I tested it out in my classroom and let my students smell it.  I used a sample of boys and girls ranging from 17 to 19 years old and they pretty much said the same thing.  It was ok.  I let my aide test it and she is a bit older then my students and she said it was ok but smelled a little sweet.  I tried it as well and agree with what my aide and students said.  It was ok and a little sweet smelling.  I have another student that I teach after school and she thought it was a little sharp smelling.  She said it was good but not for her and she wouldnt want her boyfriend using it.

That all being said  It is a good smelling cologne.  It isn't overpowering after a few minutes and mellows into a a smell that people will wonder about.  I do not like people spraying scents in my room because of how long the linger and this one really does get light smelling quick.  I have to give props to Burberry for this one  You apply a small amount and it does add a good scent to your body/clothing that is very distinct and not overpowering.  You don't have to be embarrassed to wear this if applied correctly.

All in all this is a decent deal for the price.  Good cologne isn't cheap.  You can tell cheap when you buy it and use it once.  This is a solid product and a solid deal.  My reason for four stars, It just isn't something I would want to wear on a daily basis.  I do have a few I would but this isn't one of them.

In reviewing proper application protocols, it's said to apply at a distance of at least six inches to avoid over saturating one particular area. Some sites also suggest spraying your chest/biceps so that it becomes trapped in your clothing, so people have to be really close to you to take in your scent. review_title: Jack Black's Blue Mark is a fantastic fragrance, but weak in longevity and projection performance...
review_text:
Out of the bottle, I get the beautiful blend of vetiver and bergamot notes that settles close to skin level.  I can smell this fragrance inside my circle, but it does not radiate beyond that circle.  Longevity is modest at best, lasting about 4 hours on me (and again, inside my circle), and perhaps a bit longer on clothing. Yes, the performance could be better, but the actual scent/fragrance is very pleasant.

I would offer that Blue Mark provides great flexibility.  I see Blue Mark as a great selection for an office environment or where there is much (and somewhat close) contact with the public where you do not want to be offensive.  Additionally, while previous reviewers have suggested this is more of a Spring/Summer fragrance, with the vetiver notes, I would pitch that Blue Mark can be worn for all seasons, and both day or night.  I also see Blue Mark as a fragrance more suited for a more mature, established, and distinguished audience.

In addition to loving the scent/fragrance, the bottling and packaging are first class.  The 100ml bottle is heavy and well designed.  The packaging is a large cylinder which the bottle sits down in the bottom.  (Yes  call my crazy, but I notice these type of details..)

Still a little on the pricy side for designer fragrances, there are options on-line for this fragrance in the moderate range of around $70.00 USD for a large bottle.

My final tally for Blue Mark is 4.2 stars out of 5 stars.  I love the fragrance so much that I can get by the performance issues.  I highly recommend adding to your collection having an alternative for the office or any other event where you don't want to overwhelm.

Enjoy your day and make it count.  Invest your time rather than wasting your time

review_title: It is light; begins with a citrusy fragrance but mellows to a lighter flower scent
review_text:
Now that I am older, I am picky with fragrance. I've never liked heavy scented fragrances because my sinuses are sensitive. The heyday of 80s and Giorgio were the worst years for me. I've always preferred the lighter fragrances but as one ages, the body chemistry changes so I literally stopped wearing perfume for a number of years until a year ago when I found a particular fragrance that went well with my body chemistry.

That long preface is so that when I say that I rather like Burberry's The Beat fragrance, I mean that it passed my pickiness. It goes on light at first with a nice citrusy, slightly spicy scent but as the hours progress, it mellows in scent to be a soft flower scent. So far, it hasn't irritated my sinues and it also hasn't soured as the time wears on so it holds well in that it gradually fades in scent rather than turning into a scent that I need to wash off to get rid of.

I'd say it is likely targeted for a younger audience (early 20s to mid-30s) than I am but someone of my age can wear it well too.

I'd have given it a 5-star except the packaging was a little lazy and not the packaging by Amazon but rather by Burberry. The fragrance is solid but when I opened the box, the bottle was loose as if it was just thrown into the Burberry box.

Otherwise, I really like the fragrance and it will be a nice change up from my other fragrance that I use.

product_title: BURBERRY The Beat Eau De Toilette for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_title: Subtle, long-lasting fragrance perfect for daytime wear
review_text:
I don't have a "signature scent"--rather, I love using a variety of fragrances to suit my mood as well as the occasion.  Although I usually prefer testing a new fragrance in person, the description of this Eau de Toilette suggested strongly to me that I might like it, as it mentioned notes of mandarin, Ceylon tea, white musk, and cedarwood, all of which I tend to like in perfumes.

With the name "The Beat" and the check-patterned bottle, I get sort of a preppy vibe from this fragrance.  However, the glass container is also sleek and modern, and I do like the cute little Burberry hang tag on the side.

I'm not an expert at describing fragrances, but I definitely like this.  Although other notes are mentioned in the description, the strongest ones I get are the white musk, a subtle cedarwood, and a citrus-y scent that must be the mandarin.  I find THE BEAT to be very reminiscent of CK ONE, although the later scent definitely has more powerful citrus notes.  But both also are subtle fragrant of tea, although the description of CK ONE purports to be green tea, whereas THE BEAT mentions Ceylon tea.  These two teas must be quite similar, as THE BEAT also reminds me of another green tea fragrance, Elizabeth Arden's GREEN TEA, which is much softer.

Overall, I am extremely pleased with this scent, which is perfect for daytime.  Furthermore, although I frequently wear CK ONE during the summer, I will now swap out with THE BEAT on occasion, especially when I want something a bit lighter.  Although the scent did fade slightly over time, it had excellent staying power--I could even catch whiffs of it on my skin the next morning.  The only (slight) negative I have to mention is that when I go to pick up the bottle, the cap slips off in my hand (the cap was actually loose in shipping as well), so a larger/more secure cap would have been nice.  In summary, if you enjoy the other scents I mentioned and like the type of fragrance I described, I would highly recommend THE BEAT to you.

product_title: BURBERRY The Beat Eau De Toilette for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_title: Invigorating Energetic Fragrance Perfect for Summer for Any Age
review_text:
After trying Brit and having it be such a terrible disappointment, I was not sure what to expect with The Beat.  I tried it on both me and my teenage daughter so that I could have two different types of body chemistry to compare it on, plus two age differences too.

The bottle of The Beat is really cute and I like it better than Brit.  The top fits well and the little handle looking thing on it is a cute addition although I am  not sure it is good for anything but to look at.

1st stage
The first stage of the fragrance is a quick one so you have to smell it right away.  It is a beautifully invigorating explosion of pepper and spice, maybe cardamom?

2nd stage
The second stage shows up quite quickly.  It moves into a wonderful energetic fresh explosion of green and fruit with a splash of citrus.  That is my favorite stage.

3rd stage
The dry down goes to a great light summery fragrance which is fresh and green yet has a fruity fresh appeal of like peach, nectarine, and perhaps grapefruit.  It is subtle but definitely there.  This stage does not tend to last all day but I would say maybe six hours.  I don't mind in that the reapplication is another exciting explosion of scents and energy, so if it is not too inconvenient to reapply, I gladly do.

FINAL COMMENTS
This scent is a winner for me and my daughter.  We both wear this fragrance and love doing it.  It is rather ageless too.  I would say that any age would enjoy this as it does not seem to have itself pushed into one specific age group.  I would say it is a great spring and summer scent mostly.  I can not see wanting to wear this a lot in winter unless I needed a boost in the dead of winter.  It is quite invigorating.

I have a problem finding scents that don't turn sour on me, so this is a surprise that I could wear this as well as the Burberry Body Tender with no problems.  It is also unusual for me and my daughter to both be able to wear the same scent and like it.  Not only because of the age difference, but also because of the huge difference in our body chemistry.

I highly recommend this fragrance for summer as a fresh light energetic fragrance for all ages, but the key is to try it first and see if it melds well with your body chemistry.

product_title: BURBERRY The Beat Eau De Toilette for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text:
Some time ago, my wife made me a gift of Burberry's French-made British cologne (or "eau de parfum," "water of perfume"), and it has become my favorite scent. So when I saw the new Burberry "The Beat" perfume for women, I thought I'd return the favor.

As usually with Burberry, the packaging is appealing -- which is important when you want your gift to be appreciated. The 50 ml. glass bottle comes in an impressive box, slightly oversize (5.5" tall) . The perfume itself is well padded inside, and the glass bottle is striking. It is printed in a pattern reminiscent of the "London" cologne check, baked on the glass. There's a pleasing style to the whole presentation, down to the leather and metal strap on the side (says "Burberry").

While perfume is all about how it makes you feel, it's the contents that truly count. For this, it is impossible to top the Company's own description: "intense and energetic scent with warm top notes of bergamot [the stuff that gives Earl Grey tea is distinctive aroma], cardamom [the Indian sweet spice], pink pepper and mandarin [citrus zest]. Heart notes of Ceylon tea, iris and bluebell add a floral texture. White musk, vetiver and cedar wood give depth to this sensual fragrance." Yummy!

(As usual with perfume, some reviewers didn't like the scent. We do. These things are certainly a matter of personal taste!)

My wife, who was already a Burberry fan, couldn't be more thrilled, so "The Beat" is a hit at our house.

Recommended!

review_title: Cute bottle, but fragrance dies too soon.
review_text:
Burberry is known for its trench coats and Burberry-checked scarves. When I saw this perfume, I just had to try it out.

The packaging of the bottle is very cool and does fit the brand very well. It looks great sitting on my vanity top, but unfortunately, I think that's where it will stay. Despite the cute bottle design, the top pops off too easily and the bottle is hard to grip with the Burberry signature tag in the way. Cute, but not good for actual use.

The Beat has a great summer fragrance that is part flowery and part musk. It's light but has a strong presence. However, it doesn't stay on the skin for very long, so reapplying is necessary. I've tried another Burberry fragrance and really did not like that one, but this one is pleasant. BUT - I wore this fragrance for two weeks and not one person commented on the scent (good or bad). When I had a girlfriend sniff my wrist after only a few hours, she could not detect the scent.

Cute bottle, nice try, but I won't be buying more.

review_title: Warm citrus smell that lasts but does not overpower
review_text:
I have never worn Burberry before.  I always tend towards really floral, yet light fragrances.  I do like their perfumes, but I always felt they were too warm or strong for me.  The Beat is a strong warm fragrance, but I love it.  The green tea and citrus notes are very fleshing.  The musk gives this scent some body and it lingers, although it does not overpower.

The bottle has the signature Burberry plaid and includes a leather strap.  It is decorative, but useless as far as I can tell.  It also a small white cap.  The design is clean and simple, just like the fragrance.

The price is pretty steep, but Amazon has priced it to be competitive with the department stores,so if you like it, Amazon is a good place to buy it.  I have purchased perfume from them before and they are great at maintaining product integrity and customer satisfaction.

Burberry is a quality brand and The Beat is a great fragrance.  I would recommend you try it.

product_title: BURBERRY The Beat Eau De Toilette for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_title: Clean Light Scent Of Musk, Wood, Spice & Floral
review_text:
Burberry The Beat Eau de Toilette is a scent that has a lot going on. This complicated scent was launched in 2008 by creators Dominique Ropion, Oliver Polge and Beatrice Piquet. The Beat has top warm notes of Bergamot, Cardamom, Pink Pepper and Mandarin. These very spicy top notes stay quite predominant and give the scent a very masculine intensity. The middle heart notes contain Ceylon Tea, Iris and Bluebell creating a light floral fragrance. The bottom notes of White Musk, Vetiver and Cedar Wood give the scent a very sensual fragrance, yet quite masculine with it's very animal and woodsy aromas.

This is a scent that many Burberry parfum fans felt had too many hands in it's creation. Created by two men and one woman may be the reason there are so many masculine top and bottom notes and a very light middle of feminine floral scents. This is definitely one scent you should try on before buying it, if you are not certain how the stronger Spices, Wood and Musk scents will mix with your own body chemistry. I worked in a cosmetic factory for over half a decade and I know this is a very Uni-sex scent that someone like me who prefers a more feminine aroma will not like.

If you are familiar with Burberry Brit, this scent is very similar without the lime citrus notes. It is also quite similar to DKNY Pure. For myself, I like light-medium Oriental Floral made in Paris scents- Chanel No. 5, Chanel No. 5 Eau Premiere, Ecusson and Boucheron are some of my very favorites. If you like the same scents I do, you may not like the added masculinity notes of The Beat. For those who like a more complicated clean smelling Uni-sex scent, you will like The Beat. This scent is made in Paris and is packaged in a checked pattern bottle with a little metal and leather hang tag around the neck. Even though The Beat is not my type of perfume with it's masculine top and bottom notes, this 3 1/2 Star scent is overall nice and light with it's clean and crisp smell, with only one drawback and that is- it doesn't last a full 8 hour day. You will need to touch up after a half a day, as it is light and does fade.

I found myself spraying more than usual just to give off a slight aroma.  My number one complaint is that the scent does not last as long as other perfumes I have worn, meaning I would need to reapply during the day.  While this is not a scent I would wear often and would not likely purchase for myself, the product description says this has a youthful fragrance.  I would agree.  The light scent would make for a nice first perfume for a teenage girl, as it is not overpowering.

If you're looking for a fragrance that would probably go unnoticed. Burberry The Beat may be for you.  However, if you're looking for a scent that would garner compliments, I would try something else.

product_title: BURBERRY The Beat Eau De Toilette for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text:
It's difficult to review perfumes because smell preference is by definition very subjective. But, here goes.

I'll say that I'm in my mid-30s, and often wear "sportier" perfumes, and sometimes even men's scents because I find many of them to be "cooler" or earthier smelling, respectively. I've worn Burberry scents in the past, so I thought I would give this one a try. I found it to be a bit too floral for my tastes, and there is a kind of alcohol undertone that makes the perfume smell a bit cheap; it's hard to describe, but it's almost as though it seems already very diluted just minutes after putting it on, except for this trace of floral and alcohol -- but the worst thing to do would be to apply more of it.
I "tested" this perfume on my significant other, who agreed (and also gave me the missing "alcohol" ingredient that I couldn't quite put my finger on).

All that said, there's absolutely nothing wrong with it; if you prefer more feminine, floral, and lighter scents, this might appeal to you. But, if you enjoy cooler -- and perhaps more earthier (think undertones of cedar) scents, you might not be impressed by this Burberry perfume.

product_title: BURBERRY The Beat Eau De Toilette for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text: This is a light, fresh tea scent.  To me it smells predominantly of green tea, with a slight fruity complement.  The green tea note is a true one, it smells almost exactly like dry green tea leaves waiting to be brewed.  I appreciate that this smells like actual green tea.  I've found that what often masquerades as a 'green tea note' in perfumes smells nothing like the real thing.  This one is the real thing.  The slight fruity complement makes it smell like a lightly flavored green tea.  This is a light, fresh scent that is easy to wear.  Unfortunately it does not last very long.  After an hour or two it's basically gone from my skin.  I've used both the EDP version of The Beat, and this EDT, and I like the scent of the EDT better.  Unfortunately, though, it does not have the staying power of the EDP.

It has a nice balance of spice, citrus, and floral so that it doesn't really fit into any of those categories.  It seems tailor made for summertime with its clean, fresh scent.  While advertised as "youthful" this is not a sweet or simple fragrance.  It's nicely layered.

It comes packaged in a clear bottle with a white design on the glass, a white cap, and a Burberry tag.  This would make a lovely gift.

My girlfriend, Tammy, loved the fragrance.  I tried a dab on my own wrist and approved it.  Tammy enjoys a sweet, soft fruity fragrance that is subtle and not overpowering. I love the smell, I could smell the woody elements in it. Two small spritzes (one one each arm) were enough to last most of the day. product_title: BURBERRY Touch Eau De Parfum for Women, 1.7 Fl. oz.
review_text:
Fruity, flowery, and woodsy are the words that come to mind in describing Burberry Touch. It is a fresh feminine scent that is natural without being overwhelming florid. It is hard to find a fragrance that lasts as it tones down after several hours of wear, but it seems as though Touch has it down.
I'm not a big perfume wearer because I find a lot of fragrances too heavy. Some make me sneeze and sometimes my eyes just water, but not this fragrance. Much like the clothes and accessories from Burberry that I have enjoyed for a couple of decades, this fragrance is modern and smart. It is subtle and nifty in that you can define the scent without it defining you. Unlike my mother's chosen scents, you can't smell this a mile or a block away. However, people do notice its pleasant fragrance and will comment on how lovely and serene it is.
I'm a outdoorsy type. I like to hit the woods and hike and I like the mix of flowers and plants. Touch is lovely and can fit in anywhere. The packaging is simple and modern. It is not your grandma's overdone idea of chic, but you will get noticed.

review_text:

The smell didn't change much after I applied it, and it lasted at least five hours. To me it seems at heart like a more feminine version of a male cologne. I don't get a lot of floral or fruit from it -- more woody with a touch of vanilla. I think I'd describe it as powdery and a bit intense.  I asked my husband to describe it, and his best effort was "kind of musky."  My 14-year-old said it smelled like an elegant woman should be wearing it when she went out somewhere fancy.  It definitely is a smell with a presence, something I would wear when dressing up to go out. I'm not sure I'd wear it to work unless my office was fairly private or I knew for certain that my coworkers weren't bothered by it, because it's not a scent that can easily be ignored.

product_title: BURBERRY Touch Eau De Parfum for Women, 1.7 Fl. oz.
review_text:
This Burberry Touch perfume comes with a very elegant packaging, but I don't like the bottle design so much.

The fragrance smells very much like the traditional Chinese fragrance ( Flower Dew Water), which became popular in China since about 700 A.D. However, this Eau de Perfume is a little milder, maybe due to less alcohol content, making it smell more like a classier designer perfume.  The scent also lasts all day but is not overpowering.

I recommend it!

product_title: BURBERRY Touch Eau De Parfum for Women, 1.7 Fl. oz.
review_text:
I hate hate hate fruity fragrances--the sort that celebrities seem to make, and the common drugstore shampoo scent. I am not overly fond of most florals--I much prefer "mens" type fragrances like vetiver, leather, oak moss, spices (like cardamom and nutmeg) and sandalwood. This lands somewhere in between. It is definitely floral, and feminine, but not overpoweringly so. It doesn't scream "old lady" or "teeny bopper" either. It smells the most like the John Frieda Color Gloss, if this helps. The dry-down is meh. I love either a powdery iris dry-down or a sandalwood/musk/vanilla one, and this seems floral-ish to me.
It would be lovely to wear to a wedding, a tea, something like that, or maybe a date? Studies show men like the smell of desserts, so maybe better off choosing a vanilla scent?

product_title: BURBERRY Touch Eau De Parfum for Women, 1.7 Fl. oz.
review_text: Light and fresh scent. I enjoy it very much. To me, it's a softer feminine scent which wears well for the greater part of the day, for me from morning through the late afternoon. The scent becomes more subtle but is still there.  Choosing a perfume is very personal. I enjoy this one a lot and would purchase it again. I can't denote particular fragrances but the overall blend is very pleasing and not overpowering.

product_title: BURBERRY Touch Eau De Parfum for Women, 1.7 Fl. oz.
review_text:
Living in the Bay Area of California for a time, my wife & I were always captivated by the smell of jasmine in the air.  It seemed to be everywhere and we always loved the fragrance.  This perfume has those same notes layered with orange and a touch of rose.

Best of all, it is not over powering yet it lasts and lasts.

Great stocking stuffer or a gift for any occasion.

product_title: BURBERRY Touch Eau De Parfum for Women, 1.7 Fl. oz.
review_text:
I couldn't wait to try this perfume.  I love perfumes that have a clean as well as a woodsy scent.  This perfume has a light and fresh scent that is not overpowering.  I think that it is not the kind of scent that I will grow tired of any time soon.  It's got a really fresh appeal that I love and that suits me.

Of course we all know how personal choosing a scent is.  Someone else could really dislike this kind of clean uncloying scent.  I personally really enjoy it!  It does not overpower me and it seems to fade gently.  I use it at night after my shower so my sheets and pillow cases smell yummy, too!

product_title: BURBERRY Touch Eau De Parfum for Women, 1.7 Fl. oz.
review_title: Lovely light floral scent that mellows as the day progresses
review_text: I generally wear Ralph Lauren's Safari for women as my signature scent.  For "dress-up" I like to wear Yves Saint Laurent's Opium.  I was interested in trying Bruberry Touch for women because of the floral notes that are used in making it.  I discovered that it is a very light floral scent - nothing overpowering - just pleasant.  When I first put it on, it had a more pronounced scent but as the day went on it mellowed to a light floral that is just enough to awaken the senses.  It is a lovely scent and one that I will certainly add to my collection.

product_title: BURBERRY Touch Eau De Parfum for Women, 1.7 Fl. oz.
review_text:
This is a safe and easy fragrance created in 1998.  It has a clean powdery woody (cedar) scent with fruit and flowers.  Nothing is too heavy and it is fairly simple & doesn't change too much during the day.

It opens with a woody & vanilla note that quickly moves on to a fruity but not sickly sweet scent with peach, black currant and orange hint.  Then the flower notes with tuberose, rose, lily & lily of the valley.  None of the flowers are terribly strong but you do get a flowery feminine scent.  The wood notes last thru wearing, underpinning the fragrance & keeping it interesting & not cloying flower/sweet.

Burberry Touch is a cuddly feminine fragrance that is not the disgusting, overly sweet, frooty-tooty scents that are in so many bottles today.  I like this fragrance best in cold weather.

review_title: Not My Thing--But My Mom Loves It!
review_text: I was a newbie to using fragrances, and during my search to find the perfect perfume, this was the first designer brand that I tried out. I was mostly just doing a lot of sampling to find out what scents I was into...and I realized that this is just not for me. I have discovered that I love floral fragrances, and anything with even the slightest amount of musk does not mesh well with my body chemistry. However, my mother and almost everyone else I know SWEAR by this perfume. To Burberry's credit, unlike most musky perfumes, the Classic fragrance is not at all overpowering. It contains just the right amount of musk to give it a little kick, yet is not headache inducing. You can also detect a hint of spices and orange blossoms, which gives the perfume an interesting and very complex smell. Even though I do not care for it, most people I have spoken to absolutely love this fragrance. Whenever my mom wears it, she gets so many compliments and people asking her went scent she is wearing. There is just something about Burberry that seems to be irresistable. If I had to sum up Classic in one word, I would say: Sophisticated. I am only 20 years old, and though I am not a fan now, I may be in another ten years. It's not for me, but if you were excited by my description, you should try it out.

review_title: A nice fragarance, but you are mostly paying for a tired and predictable "brand image."
review_text:
Who wears Burberry these days?  Certainly nobody with much independent thought or fashion sense; Burberry as a creative and innovative brand is all but dead and has been for a long time.  Rather, they milk that same tired plaid into generic product after product for those  desperately trying to buy into social legitimacy through branded products.  I'm sure they sell plenty in Moscow and Shanghai to daughters of corrupt officials and mid-level entrepreneurs.  Burberry is an exercise in brand marketing and product placement; if it ever had a soul, it is long dead.  For a mild chuckle, google "Burberry Polo Shirt" and ask yourself what kind of utter tool would pay for, much less wear some of the ones that consist of the burberry plaid on their chests.  They'd probably sell burberry shoelaces for $90 if they could.  I spend a lot of my time in britain; I have yet to find actual british people who wear Burberry - or at least, I haven't since the post-ironic "burberry chav" phase about 5 years ago (google "burberry chav" to see what i mean).

But what about this fragrance?  Without any disrespect to other commenters, who have done their best, I don't think you can really describe a smell here online.  Go into a store and smell it.  If you like the smell, buy it.  If not, certainly don't spend $100 for it.  I think it's ok, personally, but I also realize that most of the price of this perfume is for the marketing and brand image.

It comes in a nice presentation box, so is suitable for use as a gift when you're all out of ideas.

product_title: BURBERRY London Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text: I used to wear Burberry Tender Touch (the one in the pink bottle) but they stopped making it years ago. Recently I tried Burberry Body and I love it but feel like it's really a summer only fragrance. My other favorite is Kenneth Cole Black for women. Burberry London for women is that perfect perfume, I can wear it every day. It's not chemical smelling, it's not overpowering, I never feel like I need to wear a certain outfit to pull it off. I love it so much I've moved the bottle from my bathroom to my nightstand so that when I put it on in the morning the scent hangs around in my bedroom all day. Buy it for yourself or for a gift without worrying about the season or your age, it's just wonderful for everybody!

product_title: BURBERRY London Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_title: Lovely Scent That is Moderate in Tone -- Balanced and Not Too Flowery
review_text:
This BURBERRY PARFUM comes in a Burberry plaid box.  The Burberry/London logo is a glued on block.

When you pull the bottle out of the outer box there in an internal split sleeve that easily falls out of the way.  The bottle is covered with a textured cloth that makes it easy to hold.  The cap pulls off to reveal a sprayer.  You can see through the glass at the top all the way through the perfume through the bottom.  The perfume has a slightly pink tint and I like being able to see it so I can tell home much is left.  [Not needed now but in the future I'll be able know when to drop hints that mom needs some new scent.]

I love the scent.  It's not overwhelming but gentle flowery with strong hints of sandalwood and musk.  It took me a while of inhaling but I finally did recognize the patchouli.  Very nice done.  To me the scent is unique.  And I really like it.  It's warm and friendly and quite affordable given how much you get for this price.  I actually prefer this now to my Chanel 5.

product_title: BURBERRY London Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_title: A hit with my coworkers at work.
review_text:
I did a test with this perfume (parfum) with several of the girls in the office.  When I say this, I mean I went around to the creative peeps in the office and did the old school department store lady who squirts your whether you want it or not.  For the most part it was a hit.  Roz, Traci, and the new girl liked it and recognized it right away as a floral smell.  Laura was on the phone so her palm got it instead of the wrist.  She liked it though.  Jacque was also on the phone and didn't like me squirting her because she has so many allergies.  She said it was too strong and washed it off.  (I find this hard to believe because she does so many essential oils).  Then my BFF JSCAH came over to my pod and said, Okay, let me try it.  She said she could not smell it all the way over to her office, but she is sensitive to smells because shes pregnant.

product_title: BURBERRY London Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text:
I'm in love. That's all I can say - I'm in love with this perfume! I'm someone who doesn't wear perfume often - not because I don't like perfume, but because it tends to be tricky for me to find a scent that I not only like but that also works well with my body chemistry.

When I got this perfume I put a spritz on my wrist and rubbed and a spritz that I walked through. I wanted to make sure the scent was thoroughly on me to see how strong it was, if it was off-putting or if it wasn't too bad. Firstly, the scent was definitely not too strong. Every person that I came across I asked to smell my perfume. I wanted to see what their opinion was without me telling them how expensive the perfume was. Every single person sniffed my wrist and their eyebrows shot up. "wow - that smells REALLY good!" they all said! My husband, Mr. Cheapskate himself, took a whiff and immediately said that he loved the smell - then he started sniffing my neck to ask if I'd put any there!

I have now learned that you should ignore the price of something and go with what works for you. This perfume absolutely works beautifully for me and has enough of a scent that it smells amazing but not so much that it's cloying. I'm definitely a fan!!

Since scent is a personal thing, my advice is go to a local store and sample before you buy. While I like this very much, everyone's body chemistry is different.

product_title: BURBERRY London Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_text:
This is my first Burberry perfume and I really like it. When asked, I describe Burberry London as a subtle yet sinfully sexy scent. It is a lovely combination of florals (honeysuckle, peony, and jasmine to name a few) with a hint of sandalwood. I personally have found that it smells better the longer you wear it. In the morning, I spray a mist in the air and then walk through it. This prevents me from putting too much on or wearing it too heavily.

The price of this perfume is comparable to other high end perfumes/colognes. This 3.3 fl ounce bottle costs under $95, which if you use sparingly, should last awhile. Aesthetically, the bottle is simple and attractive. It is a slightly tinted glass bottle with the signature/iconic Burberry fabric wrapped around it. In conclusion, I am enjoying this parfum and would highly recommend it to those in the market for something out of the ordinary.

product_title: BURBERRY London Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_title: Elegant, modern yet classic, and long lasting. Really, really love this fragrance!
review_text:
This fragrance for women comes wrapped in the signature Burberry check pattern fabric. I like glass bottles but the fabric wrap looks nice too, since it's iconic Burberry. I have the original Burberry as well as Burberry Brit and I like both, but love Brit. This fragrance is also a little more floral like Brit.

It is meant to embody the spirit of London - cosmopolitan yet alive with the history of the ages. Burberry markets it as the fragrance for an independent woman with relaxed confidence. It is subtle yet long lasting. Since I love Jasmine based fragrances, I really like this one. The Burberry original is more fruity, followed by vanilla and musk but this fragrance is more flora.

The top notes are rose, honeysuckle and tangerine. The middle notes are jasmine, peony, tiare flower, clementine. The base notes are musk, patchouli and sandalwood. The jasmine really leads, and is very noticeable, along with honeysuckle. The dry down is fabulous, as it's musky and oriental with the patchouli and sandalwood. Again, it's very long lasting, a great thing about Burberry fragrances, if you can get a genuine bottle. I am so loving this fragrance, I want to spray it and then sniff my wrists all day long. It's very lasting and I can smell it on my clothing even after a full day, makes me feel so sexy!

After 2 months of using it, I like it even more and more. I never thought I'd like London so much as I never cared as much for the original Burberry scent or even Burberry Brit although my daughter loves Brit as it works well with her cooler body chemistry. But this one has me hooked and it works magic with my warmer body chemistry, I have even women asking me what I am wearing and have noticed men turn around when I walk by them and they get a whiff. Something's working.

Some fragrance sites have it for half the price or less, which makes me very suspicious, but previously I have purchased fragrances from some of these sites and it has been the real thing, so it may be worth taking a chance. I have purchased fragrances from Amazon that turned out to be fake, so make sure you buy the bottle directly from Amazon as seller and not a third party seller.

Overall, a very nice fragrance, it's a good one for round the year. It also smells very classy, elegant and fresh so I really love it for work.

product_title: BURBERRY London Eau De Parfum for Women, 1 Fl. oz.
review_title: French-Made Burberry London Perfume for Women
review_text:
From the female of the family: some time ago I was perusing the cologne counter, looking for a special gift for my husband, and I came across "London Burberry." It was intoxication at first sniff! It's been my favorite thing to scent on my man ever since.

Recently I discovered that Burberry London has an Eau de Parfum for women as well. I thought I'd give it a try.

First comment. This is an entirely different scent than the man's version. When I first misted some on, I thought it might be a little too sweet or floral (probably the honeysuckle), but those "top notes" soon fade a little, and I really like the effect. I can't match the company's own write-up so here it is: "...elegant rose and a sweet heady blend of honeysuckle. Deep heart notes of tiare flower, jasmine and peony are uplifted with a whisper of fresh clementine zest. Solar notes of sandalwood, musk and patchouli...." I wasn't sure what "tiare" was, so I looked it up. It's probably better known to you as gardenia -- a fragrant tropical flower. "Clementine" is a type of tangerine, so that is the citrus. I was a little taken aback by the "patchouli": worn too heavily, that is the classic "hippie" scent of years ago. However, you'll probably be pleased to know, the patchouli is so blended, I can't pick it out.

I'm don't usually trouble myself with product boxing, but I do like the "whole package" by Burberry. If you are buying "London" as a gift, ladies, the box itself looks good - understated and yet expensive. It is printed in the "check" pattern of the bottle itself -- a harbinger of good things to come.

I don't like the women's version of "London" as well as the men's, but I do find it fresh and summery.

Recommended.

review_title: A friend for 20 years, still sensual but also still modern and relevant.
review_text:
This fragrance launched in 1995 and became an instant classic with it's flowery and refreshing top notes, amber and musk base notes. I have been using it for 20 years, but not exclusively. I like to wear it in the evening in winters as it is a rather heavy perfume. It's a distinctive fragrance, almost instantly recognizable due to the Bergamot top notes, the sandalwood and mossy middle notes with a hint of geranium and the musky dry down due to amber. If fragrance could be defined as a mood, Burberry evokes sensual but practical at the same time. A woman who knows she's arrived. Some days I find it overpowering and other days I reach for it like an old friend.

Top Notes: Lavender, Bergamot, Thyme, Mint
Middle Notes: Geranium, Sandalwood, Moss, Cedar
Base Notes: Amber, Tonka Bean

Keep in mind that discounters might be selling you the genuine product, but old perfume, which will not smell the same. As perfume ages, like anything else, ha ha, its scent changes.

product_title: Burberry Women's Classic Eau de parfum Spray, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
Fragrances are very personal things, and it's difficult to choose a new scent based on an anonymous person's opinions.  My favorite perfume has always been KL, by Lagerfeld, which was discontinued almost ten years ago - it's a spicy scent, with hints of cloves, sandalwood, and amber.  Since BURBERRY claims to have similar notes (cedar, sandalwood, amber), I figured I'd give it a try.  I'm not a fan of "sweet" or "flowery" perfumes, so BURBERRY sounded promising.  And I do like it.  Not as much as KL (too bad, since it's almost impossible to get a bottle these days), but enough to wear it from time to time.

The overall scent (at least on my skin) seems more lemony than anything else - it actually reminds me a bit of the old Jean Nate splash I used to use after swimming in the summer.  I do pick up the woodsy notes, which suggest spiciness, but there's a distinctly fruity aspect (lemon and green apple) that stands out most.  It's a pleasant scent, if a little underwhelming.

This is a very potent spray, with more punch than you might expect.  I was tempted to use it like an eau de toilette and spray it liberally on my body - but it's definitely an eau de parfum, which can be twice as potent as eau de toilette.  The scent is very long-lasting (if I apply it first thing in the morning, it's still noticeable when I'm getting ready for bed).

Now about price - I suggest a little shopping around before making your purchase.  I easily found it for less than half of the Amazon price at a number of discount perfume websites, as well as at my local Macy's.  Just make sure you're not paying more than you need to for this perfume.

Bottom line, I'm still searching for a replacement for KL.  But BURBERRY is a good product - it has a pleasant scent (neither flowery nor overly sweet) and it's quite long-lasting.  It's nicely packaged, too.

review_text:
Burberry is by far my favorite perfume I've ever worn in my life. I have worn it for years and still never get sick of it. On my skin, it smells warm, slow & sweet, like warm honey, subtle and balanced to also be classy and sexy. I have been told that this perfume smells much differently on me than other people (I guess we were made for each other!) so I'd recommend trying it on at a department store first to see how it wears on you. I've had some perfumes I love the smell of not work on my skin at all (like Bvlgari Noir Jasmin, which is a beautiful perfume but turns into an "old lady" smell on my skin after about 30 minutes) so always try stuff out first.

It's a very soft scent, the kind of perfume you only smell when you are close to someone. If you are looking for the kind of perfume that announces you in a room, this isn't it. The scent lasts a long time, I will smell it clearly on sweaters that I haven't worn in months when I take them out of my drawer. I'm sensitive to perfumes and this one does not give me a headache.

I seriously can't say enough about it. I always get huge compliments when I wear it, especially right after I first put it on and the scent is still strong enough to attract attention. Unfortunately, I dropped my current bottle on the floor and broke the sprayer, so half of my 100ml bottle is stuck inside :(
