review_text:
My wife is very picky about what fragrances she wears as she's very self-consciencious about how she is perceived by others and scent plays a critical role in that regard.  Eternity Now by Calvin Klein mixes a great blend of mature rose scents but not overpowering or screaming old lady.  One gets a sense of maturity and youth when exposed to Eternity Now and that's a great blend for any woman over 18 but doesn't want to be mistaken for someone raiding grandma's perfume cabinet.

Truth be told, my lady has worn Eternity Now for every big event of the past few months from her recent job interview (she starts that new job today, BTW), and all photography shoots she works on.  She really loves it and I think any woman that wants a touch of youth and maturity will too!

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_text: Daughters favorite perfume- she loves it

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_text:
I am a big fan of Calvin Klein scents, so I jumped at the chance to try Eternity Now.  I'm glad I did.

It's a difficult scent to describe, but it is definitely on the light and fruity side on the front side, and as I wear it throughout the day it gradually changes to a light musk scent.  I definitely like this scent, as it reminds me a bit of the perfume I used to wear when I was in high school.  I think this scent would best be worn in the summer as I think it would wear well in the heat.

A slight warning: A little bit of this perfume goes a LONG way!

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_text: Love it

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_text: I don't know how to explain this scent, but I love it. I grew up in the 80's/90's and it reminds me of something from that time. You only need a little and it lasts a long time!

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_text: Wife loves this perfume!

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_text: I was looking for a perfume for my wife. Her type of perfume should be not too light, not too flashy and it should have a graceful scent.  This Calvin Klein Eternity Now was a perfect fit.  She liked every single bit of it including the bottle.  She did not wear a perfume frequently, but this one was an exception.  The scent lasted long and it just smelled great.  I think this perfume would be a great gift for almost any lady.  My wife and I loved it so much.  Thanks, Calvin Klein.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_text:
I love this scent.  Scent information is really hard to portray in a review as a smell can be different for each person, but what I can share is this is my current "date night" perfume for when hubby and I go out somewhere nice.

The scent is more luxury and exotic floral scent to me (I don't really smell the fruity, and a little bit goes a long way.

The bottle is pretty and is a very nice size.  The bottle itself is a weighted glass with rounded corners.  It is very feminine with the pink toned perfume liquid. It comes inside a box that is sealed with an outer plastic wrap.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_title: Floral and fruity smell that is light and pleasant for the summer or any season
review_text: Floral and fruity smell that is not overpowering and that is great for the summer. My wife likes that it is pleasant and light scent for the day.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_title: Long lasting but not over powering! Love it!
review_text: I love this perfume! The reviews don't lie. It really is a lovely, floral sent that isn't overpowering. A lot of perfumes that I've used fade too quickly and don't leave a lasting smell until the end of the day, but this perfume really does a lovely job. It's just strong enough to be able to smell it, but no so strong that you get sick of it or leave a trail letting everybody know somebody with too much perfume just wafted in. I've always enjoyed Calvin Klein perfumes and this one is no exception. Considering how long these last, I think it's definitely worth the price!

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_title: Peachy keen but may be too fruity.
review_text: This perfume tickles your nose with a sweet, fruity smell.  The sorbet top note exudes an icy sweetness that flows into a peachy sensation, and then dries down to a warm, musky aroma.  The peachy, fruit cocktail notes in this fragrance are not for everyone and this interesting scent may venture too far from its namesake, the original Eternity, to belong in the same lineup of fragrances.  This fragrance, with its initial, dominant fruity overtones and musky dry down would work best in the summer months and be most appropriate for younger women.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_text: To judge a perfume is such a subjective thing..but I can say what I think this smells like.  At first I got a fresh melon that seemed sporty.  After a while it melts into sweet floral.  Then after it mellowed, it was a really nice floral, toned down, with something heavier being smelled also.  It really does get better after wearing a while.  I have no idea what neroli smells like but peonies are super sweet fragrant and that and the peach blossoms could be the floral I'm picking up.  This really has a wonderful smell after it mellows..on me anyway, and I wear day or night.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eae de Parfum Spray
review_text: I love the scent of Calvin Klein Eternity Now.  To me, it smells almost powdery with a light floral note on the end.  I've been getting lots of compliments on it.  I find that it is not overpowering at all yet it lasts all day.  I am very sensitive to scents and too much floral will have me sneezing all day - however, I have not sneezed once with this.  It is very light and clean.  Highly recommend.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_text: Very strong at first, but then mellows out nicely. This Parfum Spray from Calvin Klein has a predominant floral scent that just smells like summer time. This is not my favorite from Calvin Klein for women, but he doesn't make any that aren't good if you are failure with his perfume line. Eternity for men is one of my favorites and this has just a hint of that scent as an undertone.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_title: CK has done a good job with this scent
review_text: Very pleasant smell, CK has done a good job with this scent!  I like floral/fruity scents  for my wife and this one hits the spot.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_title: A long-lasting, addictive floral perfume with a fruity first note
review_text:
Calvin Klein has always been one of my few favorite brands for fragrance. I particularly like Eternity that came out many years ago. The floral scent is classic and long lasting. Now came Eternity Now and it doesn't disappoint.

Eternity Now has a light fruity and addictive floral scent. I initially found it a tad strong on the first spritz.  A somewhat sweet fruity note which subsequently opens up to a floral bouquet, and finally ends with a cashmere and musk. The scent is surprisingly long lasting. I could still smell a hint of the perfume at the end of the day.

The perfume comes in a hefty glass bottle with a beefy, silver and transparent acrylic top. Just one spray is enough to last the whole day. A little really goes a long way.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_text: This is really nice smelling perfume. Long lasting as well!  I spray in the morning and I can still smell that evening which doesn't happen with my skin type. Usually the perfume absorbs really fast but not this fragrance-  I have been exploring a lot more with fragrances and this is my new favorite scent! A little goes a long way as well !

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_text: This will be a perfume that will last through out the day. This perfume reminds me of what a rich movie actress would use in the 1950. It is light and feminine but overall very classy.  Calvin Klein has been making amazing perfumes for years and this one is another hit.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_text: Love CK fragrances.  This one is flowery and elegant.  It seems to last through the night.  Definitely a pleasing scent of you love flowers.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_title: It's a nice somewhat flowery scent that isn't overbearing
review_text: I have to give them credit for keeping this very light. It's a nice somewhat flowery scent that isn't overbearing. Definitely has the potential to make a nice gift. I also like that they didn't go too far overboard with the design of the bottle. It looks good in a confident way, rather than some of the really over-the-top bottles I've seen for perfume that left me wondering how much of the money was just going to cover the bottle and convince me it was something I wanted to look at on a dresser.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_text:
Since my husband is a big Calvin Klein user-Obsession, Nautica, Eternity for Men- I thought I would give this scent for women a try.
First, this is my first bottle of CK and I appreciate the fact that it is a pretty but not odd shaped bottle. The rectangular shape fits on my make-up counter without taking up too much space.
Second, the scent is a bit citrusy and floral but not over powering.  I don't like scents that smell like my Aunt Florida and/or scents you smell before Aunt Florida walks in the room.
I sprayed one short spray on each wrist and one on my collar bone and it lasted for hours. I asked my husband if he smelled it while sitting across the table-no- but he did smell it while we were both sitting in the car.  He did like it and said it wasn't "too" perfumey.  Nice scent

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_title: light scent for a young woman
review_text: I think it's funny how everyone can experience the same perfume so differently! I really like it, the scent is clean and floral and I don't get any "musk" from it (which is good because I hate musk). I don't spray perfume on my skin, I prefer to spray it into the air in front of me and run through it. It makes my husband laugh, but that's how I keep from getting too much perfume on. I actually find that the scent doesn't last more than a couple of hours, so I find myself running through it again if we are going out in the evening.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_text: I acquired this Calvin Klein Eternity Now as a gift for my wife. She really likes the fragrance and so do I. There is a wonderful floral ambience with subtle tones of peach blossoms. Very nice.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum Spray
review_title: Floral and juicy, with a seductive dry down, light but long lasting.
review_text:
Calvin Klein Eternity and Eternity Aqua are in my favorite perfumes collection. Aqua is perfect for summer time and Eternity Original is a classic that has stood the test of time.

Eternity Now is the latest in the Eternity collection. Like other Eternity fragrances it is on the softer side of fragrances but is quite long lasting unlike some other Calvin Klein fragrances like Reveal. It opens up with a floral and fruity bouquet and dries down to the seductive musk and cashmere. It is more flowery to my nose in the beginning and I can smell the peach blossom, although the top note is supposed to be Lychee. It's a nice floral which has a younger woman feel to it, but not too young.

The opening notes almost had me disliking the fragrance as it smelled too sweet but the drydown is nice. I am going to try it some more and give my final opinion. Here is a breakdown of the notes:
Top Notes - Lychee, Quince sorbet
Heart Notes - Peony, Peach blossom, Neroli
Base notes - Cashmere woods, Ambrox, Musk

Overall, I like this fragrance, I am going to use it a lot more in the summer as it smells more fresh and juicy to me - the spirit of Summer. However, it can be a mood booster on dark winter days.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Toilette Spray for Men, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_title: A great smelling cologne that is perfect for a day at work or a night on the town
review_text: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Toilette Spray for Men is a cologne that's perfect for that formal day at work or a night on the town.  The scent is clean and fresh, lasting a while when it's sprayed against the skin.  I also enjoyed they package because the bottle fits nicely inside my medicine cabinet and it's easy to spray on.  If you are looking for a high quality cologne and enjoy Calvin Klein's products then look no further that the Eternity Now Eau de Toilette Spray for Men.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Toilette Spray for Men, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_text: At first impression I thought this was too Sporty (how the heck to describe that!) Like super in your face new mixes of Old Spice or something.  It didn't take long to settle down to something better..some kind of melon my husband says. THEN, it turns nice and mellow with a lasting vanilla and something.  I know this will be different for all who use it but, it does turn warm and yum on my husband!  It lasts for several hours.  This bottle is huge by the way..

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: Floral, but not unusual or complex
review_text: I tend to go for very feminine, floral fragrances and Lacoste Pour Elle Natural is in this zone.  It smells like a flower bouquet without trending too "old lady."  That said, I don't think it is the most complex or unusual smelling fragrance.  I don't detect the fruitier coconut or raspberry notes noted, mostly just floral.  I do like that the fragrance settles in well to my skin and mixes well with my natural scent, but over time I also find it smells a little one note.  Where as with some fragrances (Tokyo Milk Dark in particular) I find I smells something a little different every time I inhale.  This just smells...the same.  It's certainly wearable and inoffensive, but doesn't stand out.  I also think I prefer my previous go-to floral fragrance, Vera Wang Lovestruck, over this.  It's ok, but not a standout for me.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: Light, Fresh Scent - OK, But Nothing Special
review_text: When it first comes out of the bottle, the perfume smells strongly of alcohol and reminds me of cheap perfume, but then it gets subtler and you're left with a light, fresh scent. It's OK but kind of bland. It comes in a rather plain minty glass bottle with the Lacoste logo on it - an alligator patch. If I didn't know it was "for women" I would have sworn it was a bottle of cologne for a guy. Overall it's OK but the scent is not particularly interesting.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: Heavy, strong, sweet, more floral than fruity
review_text:
Oddly, this doesn't particularly smell like rose, raspberry, or coconut, and the overall scent comes across as more floral (not so much rose as gardenia and others) and extremely sweet, rather than fruity, as many of the ingredients might suggest. If you like very sweet and floral, you might like this.

For my tastes, it is too sweet and heavy, not very light or fresh. But once again, for those who like heavy, strong florals with some fruity notes, this will work.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: At first, I smelled this and thought, no way! It smells very old lady floral at first. But as it settled in, you can smell something sweet in it, which makes it more of a youthful smell. It ends up being a really nice fresh feminine scent. A little does go a long way, though. But definitely a nice fragrance.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: This is a nice scent that is not too powerful. It is a feminine scent but not too flowery. I would say it is what I would call more earthy. Over all this is a nice simple bottle that sprays easily. The logo is cloth stuck on the bottle. I would say that this is not a scent that would last all day. You would want to add later to maintain the scent.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: A bit too strong, and it reminds me of my grandmother.
review_text:
Lacoste's Pour Elle perfume has a strong floral smell that reminds both my spouse and me of our grandmothers.  The fragrance is sweet and very feminine.  Obviously the smell of a fragrance is a very personal thing, mind you.  Therefore, if you love floral scents and prefer them strong, you will probably appreciate this perfume.  To me, however, it comes off as smelling a bit "cheap".

A little bit of it goes a long way.  One spritz lasts a few hours before it starts to dissipate.

The packaging and bottle are quite nice and will make a wonderful gift presentation.  A nice touch is the small alligator patch that is affixed to the glass bottle.

All in all... floral fragrance that feels "old".

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text:
Feminine and refreshing complex scent. Use sparingly, the scent lingers.

Beautiful, heavy, clear glass(?) bottle.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: Didn't smell as good as I remember it smelling in the store. It seemed more watered down or something.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: Does not smell too good

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text:
I've really been enjoying this scent, and I find myself reaching for it more often than some perfumes I usually use (like Juicy Couture)  A friend of mine said she liked the scent, and every time she smells it, she comments on it and says it's "very distinctive."

While I agree that it has its own unique (and not too overpowering) scent it's hard to pin down exactly what it smells like. The scent is described as "rose, raspberry and coconut" but I swear I smelled vanilla. Also, I definitely smell flowers, but I don't really pick up on any raspberry. Some of my favorite perfumes are fruity, so that's a bit of a disappointment.

Nevertheless, this has become one of my current favorites for when I want a scent that's strong while not being too overwhelming.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: Reminiscent of 90s hits Millennials love, lacks longevity.
review_text:
This scent is very refreshing, clean, and reminiscent of the 90s hits such as Clinque Happy or the recent reboot of Calvin Klein's CK2. Millennials will like this scent, I think. It's a summery, day time scent with floral and citrus notes. An aquatic aspect as well. I would definitely expect it to be more of a young adult targeted scent. Not a very mature scent, very youthful.

The bottle is large and pretty, I love the color and the clear appearance. The classic Lacoste alligator adorns the front, just like on the shirts. It's a real embroidered applique!

My only criticism of this scent? It does not last long. At all. Like, I've had scents that didn't have great longevity before, but nothing like this. It fades very quickly. But the way some teenagers bathe themselves in scent...not sure that's a bad thing. It does last longer on clothing than skin (as usual). But the longevity, or lack thereof, is this scent's weakest aspect.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: I was expecting more fruit and less floral.  On me, this smells floral, without any fruit, and if I put 2 sprays on, throat and wrists, it comes off as grandmother's perfume.  If I do a single spray on my wrists, it's soft and subtle and enjoyable.  For me, the coconut isn't there.  I don't smell it, the kids don't smell it, and The Man doesn't smell it at all.  My middle son says he can smells "some kind of berry, like maybe blueberry" but he's the only one who smells anything remotely fruity.  If there is a fruity smell, it's just a hint of citrus.  The rose described is more generic floral notes on me than actual rose.  If you've ever been to a botanical garden, you've gotten the overall floral smell, and this is more like that when it's on me.  In the bottle, it smells MUCH LESS floral, so keep in mind that it will always interact with your chemistry to change the overall smell.  In the bottle, it also smells less like something you'd expect on a little ol' church lady.  I like it because it's not overwhelming, it's a clean scent, and it's pleasant overall.  I do wish the scents described were a bit more obvious, so it gets 4 stars instead of 5.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text:
I really like the sweet smell of this perfume. The description says that it is wild roses and raspberry enveloped in coconut. Some people say that they think it smells flowery. To me it smells more fruity. It doesn't smell like raspberry or coconut. To me, it smells more like a sweet citrus. My Husband said that he thinks it smells like "citrusy flowers". Regardless, we both like the smell. I read a comment that says it smells like grandmas. I don't think it does at all. I am 32 and I have worn it several days. I have asked the opinion of several others and none of my family or friends think it smells bad.

The bottle is really nice and it is a large size. It will certainly last me for years even with using it regularly. The perfume sprays out an appropriate amount and functions as expected. I do wish the perfume lasted a little longer. I feel like it fades a little fast. This isn't my favorite perfume that I own, but I do like it a lot and will use it regularly. I personally recommend it.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: I love the scent of perfume, but I'm always scared to try new ones afraid that it will smell like an old lady or just plain stink.  I was initially worried about it smelling too "old ladyish".  It wasn't at all.  I love it.  It is a nice scent without being too overwhelming.  It seems to last pretty well through the day at work and church.  I'm really happy with it and would purchase it again.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: Soft, floral, and a bit sweet....
review_text:
I like the Lacoste Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray, but scent is personal.

Im told by my psychologist husband that women tend to have more a more keen sense of smell than most men.  At least thats the case in our marriage.  I can locate the rose, raspberry, and coconut notes; he just smells floral.

Id like a bit less coconut if truth is told.  But I enjoy the light fragrance, though I do wish it were a bit less sweet.

This is a simple, unsophisticated scent.  Its not dramatic and fails to enter a room with bells and whistles.  Its soft, floral, and a bit sweet, and suitable for daytime wear.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: A sweeter scent, goes on very strong, but mellows quickly
review_text:
The description for the scent says rose and raspberry with a hint of coconut - maybe my olfactory senses aren't quite up to snuff because I really can't discern any of those notes. The "Natural" just smells like a generically sort of sweet, floral, scent to me. I can see people calling the sweet notes a rose, but it's like an artificial rose. The raspberry I can't find at all, but I tend to think of raspberries are more tart - and I can't find that sort of smell anywhere. The coconut I can sort of agree on, but more in a subtle sweetened coconut water sort of way, definitely not the meat.

I'd say that the scent goes on rather powerfully, but mellows very quickly. When outdoors, I could barely smell it after an hour in the sun - but that may be due to this being an eau de toilette instead of parfume. The closest scent I can say this reminds me of is probably Davidoff's Cool Water.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: Doesn't smell like the described rose, coconut and raspberry.
review_text: It is a strong smell, and a lot goes a long way but it wasn't the smell I was expecting. With raspberry, rose and coconut I was going for a summery smell because of coconut that would maybe remind me of the beach and light and refreshing raspberry but I did not get any of that. I do get a sweet floral smell, it isn't overly sweet. I like the smell once it calms down after the initial spray but I it just wasn't what I was expecting after reading the description of this perfume. But it reminds me of a lot of perfumes I have smelt before it isn't a unique smell. I have tokyo milk cherry bomb and that smells just like cherries and I find it appealing. But his one just smells like an everyday perfume with no notes of rose, coconut or raspberry that I was looking forward too.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: I really like the light clean floral smell.  I normally feel that rose is a more "mature" scent, but this is light and fresh, I can detect a slight fruitiness in it but not really any coconut. I think this can easily be worn everyday. The bottle is a pretty teal color looks nice on the dresser as well.  Overall a nice product.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text:
I think this is a really great scent for those who enjoy what I would classify as "clean" or "fresh" smells. It is quite potent and long-lasting....you definitely don't want to overdo the spritzing or you will regret it later.

There is something in this that seems to remind me of the Jennifer Aniston perfume in a good way. I like both.

A fun note for those who like to collect bottles: the alligator is actually stitched.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: Love this fragrance but it doesn't last very long.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: Nice scent but doesn't last very long.
review_text: I got this as a gift from a friend. It's a very light fragrance. Not overpowering at all. However, didn't last very long.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: A very pretty fragrance!  It's true, the scent does fade to being very subtle in a few hours but this works for me because I am able to wear it in a healthcare environment without it being invasive.  For me, this quickly reaches the level of a nice shampoo or scented soap.  My husband's nose is also very sensitive and he appreciates a subtle scent.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: The scent is nice, clean and floral
review_text: I wish I could give this more stars. The scent is nice, clean and floral, but it simply doesn't last.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: Nice aroma but short duration

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: I am a 30 year old female and LOVE this scent. I wish it was sold in a larger size, very fresh and floral great for everyday!

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: This is perhaps the nicest Lacoste fragrance I've sampled to date. The scent is light, fresh, floral, and slightly sweet. The sweetness tames down quite a bit after dry down, leaving a wonderful fragrance on the skin that lasts for hours, and stays close to the skin. This isn't one of those powerhouse fragrances you smell from across the room with one mist, nor should it be. This is a delicate, intimate fragrance to be enjoyed only by those you allow into your personal space. This fragrance is as suitable for the office as it is for evenings out.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: Certainly not a generic scent - somewhat unique...
review_text:
My wife likes this Lacoste "Pour Elle Sparkling Eau".  She tells me the scent is a little strong but does fade over time.  The actual scent she likes and so do I - slightly flowery jasmine scent with a bit of spiciness.  Certainly not a generic scent - somewhat unique.

The actual bottle is also attractive/ elegant looking with high quality build and of course the cool Lacoste alligator on it.

We have the 3 ounce bottle which is pretty large - at current price of $76 on Amazon it certainly appears reasonable price for a nice perfume and large size.  Tip:  I did see some lower sale prices on the 3 ounce bottle via google search (one sub-$50).  Tip2:  if you're not sure - get the smaller size bottle for less $$.  Overall 4-STAR rating from me in consideration of price/value.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: Love the fragrance. Just Didn't Last.
review_text: I purchased this (online at a different, fragrance site) because I loved the scent, which came in a sample in a magazine. I do LOVE this fragrance, but within an hour or so, the scent was completely gone. I thought I'd give it to my daughter, and perhaps she'd have better luck with it. Not so. She, too, loved the fragrance, but again was so disappointed when the scent was just about gone by the time she got from her home to her bf's, less than an hour away. Maybe there isn't enough fragrant oil in it to last on the skin? Don't know. Just too bad, because we both loved the fragrance. Light, sweet but clean. Wish it could have lasted! BooHoo :<(

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: I have been wearing Ralph Lauren Romance fragrance for years and never thought I would find another fragrance I loved as much at is until I tried Lacoste! I am very sensitive to fragrance and there are very few I can wear that won't give me a horrid headache. This fragrance from Lacoste has a wonderful sweet scent with just a hint of spice. Everyone reacts differently to scents, so please bear that in mind when going by reviews. What I think smells wonderful might smell horrible to someone else. The bottle was a very nice light pink and is huge! You get enough fragrance to last a long, long time! I think the little stick on emblem actually took away from the pretty bottle and found it unnecessary, an etched logo would look much nicer but that doesn't take away from the wonderful scent inside. I do spray a tiny bit more on than my other perfume simply because it does fade as the day wears on but even putting it on in the morning, it still has a nice light fragrance by night time. I personally love this fragrance and have been wearing it daily with many compliments.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: Very nice sweet, fruity, floral scent, best for younger women
review_text: I got this perfume for my wife and she loves it.  Being a teacher, she loves the sweet, kind of fruity and floral scent.  The fragrance is strong without being overwhelming and it lasts a long time (i.e. still noticeable on her clothing after a day at school).  I would recommend this most strongly for younger women and for weekend and/or daytime use, but maybe avoid if you have a job where strong fragrance is discouraged, or if you prefer the kind of fragrances preferred by older women.  This smells young, if you know what I mean.  Good luck!

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: ok

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: This is a slightly sweet and floral scent that I find very attractive but not overpowering. I do notice that it fades away pretty quickly and by the end of the day, there is no trace of it on my skin at all. For this reason, I decided to take a star off.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: Very Nicely Balanced Floral Scent With Fruit Undertones But Does Not Last
review_text: This scent is a very nice balance of floral with fruit undertones.  It is light but smells elegant and expensive.  The bottle is simple but still conveys a rich feel and even the "Lacoste" alligator is done in a subtle way.  The only real downside to this fragrance is that it really does not last more than a few hours.  It becomes extremely light by the end of the day so this is not something you can wear and expect to last even half a workday.  Overall this is a great scent but if it lasted longer it would be 5 stars.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: When I sprayed this Eau de Toilette on my wrists I could smell something very sweet and kind of nice.  I think this smells complicated and interesting. Different.  I thought of bubble gum right away.  It is fascinating to me that this has patchouli, jasmine and french macaroons.  No bubble gum, but I'm not so far off really am I?  I fel like this is very nice, and that I will enjoy wearing it.  This is fun. Since this is not perfume the smell only lasts a day, but it is a wonderful smell if you like slightly psicy sweet stuff.  I recommend this for girly girls.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: This is a very subtle water based perfume that is perfect for going out but won't last more than a few hours.  The scent is is more flowery and less citrusy and we really like it.  The bottle is very aesthetically pleasing  and at first I thought the cloth Icoste was logo was a bit strange on a glass bottle but it's actually quite striking.  This would make a great gift for a younger wearer who is in to trendy things.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: This sweet fruity scent is not overly strong.  It gives you a hint of fragrence without wafting someone who is standing in your vicinity.  I was wearing DKNY Delicious prior to this. That scent is a little too strong for me and more floral smelling. My husband bought it for me. This scent is something that I will not  grow tired of quickly because of the subtle smell. It does not last through the day, but few perfumes, in my experience,  do last for more than a few hours. Overall, I like this soft scent.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: Really like this scent.  It's subtle and light while still having somewhat of a punch.  It reminds me as a less powerful Gucci Rush in the spice/essence of it, but at the same time it has a sweet flowery scent.  I think this would be a good day scent as well as an evening scent.  My daughter loves the smell and wearing it as well as my wife.  A solid all year round do almost anything scent.  The bottle is pretty cool as well, the signature Lacoste logo is the same appliqu style, but glued on the bottle.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text:
I love the packaging with the pink tinted can't cologne and the green bodied and red mouthed alligator.  The clear yellowish/pink (it's actually pink but the gold toned pump underneath tints it yellow) snap on top is stylish as well as easy to take off and put back on.  It came packaged in a nice box covered in clear cellophane which makes it nice for gift giving.

Unfortunately I didn't love the scent.  There's nothing inherently wrong with and to be fair I'm overly sensitive to smell.  It reads to me as mostly floral and I'd describe it as bright and upbeat.  I think it would be a good daytime fragrance.  I put a very small amount on and it's lasting a long time.  The only reason I'm giving it three stars rather than four is because I don't love the scent.

UPDATE:  After wearing this scent for a few more days I like it better so I changed my three star rating to four stars.  I've noticed that some reviewers feel the scent fades quickly however that wasn't my experience.  Within an hour of first putting it on it tones down but it's still in the background just the way I most enjoy fragrances.  Others may not smell it distinctly unless they're very near you but you will sense it as a constant.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text:
To start off a review on perfume I have to preface this with a warning, perfume is very hard to give a good subjective opinion on.  This is for two reasons.  One, it is pretty difficult to accurately describe a smell.  And two, perfume is a personal item.  Everyone smells different.  So just because a perfume smells good and works for someone doesnt mean it will specifically work with your body chemistry.  Ok, with that out of the way let me give you my thoughts on this perfume.
It comes in a shorter round bottle.  Colored pink with an Alligator on the side.  The nozzle sprays fine.  The perfume itself is a light and sweet scent.  Not too overpowering.  My wife instantly fell in love with it.
Only downside with it, the scent doesnt seem to hold up very long over the course of the day.  But maybe you need to put more on.
Ultimately a good perfume if you want a light sweet and flowery scent.  Might need multiple applications in a day if you want it to last though.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: My wife and I both love this!
review_text:
Perfume is a very subjective product. What I like and what you like may be very different. But this is a very "sweet" smelling perfume. Think of a candy store. It has a touch of a powdery buffer though, so it isn't like - say - jolly rancher strong, but it is more like a strawberry creme smell instead of a tart tangy strawberry smell.

The bottle is a rose colored glass bottle with an embroidered cloth Izod alligator glued to the bottle. Not sure if it will stay forever. But the bottle and sprayer are pretty much standard (high) quality that you are used to with perfume/cologne.

This is a tad more expensive than many colognes out there, but if you like the scent then I'm sure it won't really matter. Even expensive cologne/perfume lasts a really long time as little as you use each time.

It also seems to last a long time, easily still smelling as strong as it did when it was first put on 4 hours later. We haven't really tested it for longer, but I can still smell it the next morning to some degree after we go out to dinner and come home.

If you are a brand name snob, Izod Lacoste has come back into fashion in the past couple of years, so there is no shame in telling people what you are wearing when they inevitably ask. It is a good choice!

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text:
Perfume scents are equal parts subjective and objective. We all have unique likes and dislikes with scents, plus the specific scent has to interact with our own chemistry. So what I pick up on here might be totally different than another person's experience.

I find this perfume to be light and powdery, with a splash of spice and a hint of floral, sort of like the perfect spring day. This is definitely more subtle than overpowering (unless you spray too much!).

The scent is not long-lasting. While a trace lingers, the majority of the scent dies off within a few hours.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text:
Buying a perfume for someone is always tricky, what might seem good to you might not work for the other person. This perfume though is of the subtle kind and has a very nice fruity/floral smell to it. It's not strong so that way it won't be an olfactory nuisance to anyone and wears off soon so you don't have to worry too much about it.

It comes in a simple package and the bottle is very nice. As you can imagine, it's for the ladies and the pink touch goes a long way to establish that. The smell also conveys the same and is the type that will be enjoyed by most ladies. It's a bit pricy for about 100 mL but overall you do get a quality product.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text:
I've never purchased anything from Lacoste before, so this product was totally new to me.

Perfume is a totally personal thing, it can react differently on different people.  Unless it's a scent you are familiar with, it might be something you would want to smell in person, before purchasing it.  It might be a scent you like, or you may not like it, especially if you have allergies or asthma.  I have both.

I like the pretty pink color on both the bottle and the box.  The box is a little hard to read when I was trying to see where the product is made. because the print is white, so I kind of had to tilt it to read it.  This perfume is made in the UK

Now on to the scent, which to me is kind of hard to describe.  It's kind of spicy, sweet, and powdery.  One of the ingredients in the description is macaroons, which I find kind of odd in a description for a perfume.  It is the color of a pink macaroon tho.

The scent is kind of strong, at least to me, at first, but then the scent tames down.  It must be water based and not oil based, because the scent doesn't last more than a few hours.

It's an ok scent, it's not a perfume I would have purchased had I been able to smell it first.  There is nothing wrong with the scent, it's just not the kind of scent I prefer.  You may feel otherwise.  I tend to like clean, citrusy scents, more than flower scents, which to me can smell too sweet, which gives me a headache.

Like I said, scent is a very personal thing.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: The Lacoste fragrance Sparkling is one of a trio of light scents that appear to be marketed towards younger women but I personally enjoy this simple layered fragrance which is neither cloying nor pungent. I first get citrus hints followed by vanilla and, unlike some people, I apply the scent but do not rub it into my skin. The bottle is about the same size and shape of another Lacoste fragrance for men that I have but the bottle color is a shade lighter than my Lacoste Pink bottle. As with any fragrance or cosmetic, I recommend testing in a brick and mortar store prior to purchasing online and oftentimes you are able to obtain a sample to try for a couple days. This is a very suitable sent for hot weather, moreso than a winter fragrance which I prefer to be less in the citrus family.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text:
I've always been a fan of Lacoste fragrances. They are unique, often pleasantly trendy, stand out from the crowd, and offer a good variety of scents for both male and female customers. Reviewing a fragrance, however, is a challenging task because of the nature of the product. One's preference of any given fragrance over another is very subjective matter. The same product often wears/smells very differently on two individuals. Having said that...

My teenage daughter absolutely loved the sweet, flowery, playful fragrance of Lacoste L12.12. It stays consistent from the moment you spray it on and leaves a light, mellow trace. It does have noticeable plant/flower base with a light touch of powdery scent and candy. My wife however, didn't care of it. Personally, I prefer more pronounced fragrances with a touch of citrus. Overall, if you prefer this particular family of perfume/eau de toilette, you're most likely going to love it. You can't ever go wrong with Lacoste.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: I do not wear perfume. I haven't since Clinique "Happy" came out back in the 90's . I make my own now, out of essential oils/coconut oil and I have been super happy with that for a decade. Lacoste Sparkling Eau de Toilette .....is a game changer. OH I remember Lacoste back in the 80's, my preppy older sister used to wear the clothing and I used to make fun of her. I thought I would maybe like this, because of its supposed scents: French Macaroons, Jasmine, Patchouli..Fruity. I actually really love it, and I love how it is not so strong that you regret even spraying it anywhere near you. You aren't supposed to smell like a whorehouse, you are supposed to have a subtle scent about you like a breeze over a flower garden.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: My dad used to travel to France for business when I was little... and we would have new "alligator" polos every time! I was very pleased to see the new cloth/embroidered alligator on this beautiful bottle of perfume. The top is sturdy and the spray very misty. And the smell is wonderful. I am very pleased.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text:
This is a good fragrance for a young woman or teenager.  It opens with a cotton candy scent that moves into apples, berries & spice.  The patchouli is just a backing note & keeps it from being completely sweet.  It stays fresh & sweet/clean smelling.

Longevity is short, lasting less than 3 hours on my skin.

It is a well made version of a young, sweet gourmand that I think many teens will like.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: Its got a nice scent that really doesn't last too long. That's not a bad thing. I don't like overpowering and strong scents. Its got hints of Jasmine and Patchouli of which I love both. I would have given it a 5 star rating until I saw the retail price. It's not what I would have or like to pay for this. Its more of a casual scent.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: A unique and subtle but vibrant fragrance
review_text:
This fragrancs is unique.  My wife liked it much better than the Donna Karan Cashmere mist fragrance that she has been using for many years.  I agree.  Although Lacoste describes this fragrance as containing patchouli, jasmine and french macaroon, the only one of these three that comes through for me is jasmine.  But the key characteristic of this fragrance is a freshness and athleticism that is very subtle.  On the right person it is sexy.

Others have commented that this fragrance has a short lifetime, and that is true.  After about two hours, the intensity drops to less than half of the original intensity, but it is still there and very subtle.  The promised 'Joie de vivre' essence is present, but I would relabel it slightly to 'La joie de l'athlétisme', a joy in sports.  This fragrance suggests the wearer is athletic, fun and seeking fun.

OK, so it is a bit overpriced.  Everything Lacoste is overpriced, but I think this fragrance is worth it.  Unique and joyful.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: For me, the warm, spicy, patchouli fragrance is the top note, with the sharp jasmine immediately following. There is a light after-note of sweetness and vanilla.  It is a soft perfume, which mellows to a powdery version after several hours.  I could still smell it, though faintly, after 8 hours.  Overall, it is a pleasant perfume that wears well, without being overpowering.

product_title: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text:
I love this, its just what I want in a perfume, light, floral, and fresh.  It's not too sweet or strong.

It does fade to a nice subtle beautiful scent thats still detectable six hours later.

The only perfume I regularly wore was Lovely by Sarah Jessica Parker of which this reminds me.  Id been searching for a new scent for a while, this maybe it.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Toilette Spray for Men, 1.7 fl. oz.
review_title: Very, very strong, but still relatively pleasant
review_text:
Fortunately, I was able to try Eternity for Men prior to trying this particular Eternity Now fragrance. Therefore, I can compare the two, and have a point of reference for the same product line. This is not my preferred scent.

I find this particular scent to be extremely overpowering. Where I may use two to three sprays of Eternity, I only need one spray of Eternity Now. It is extremely strong. While I consider Eternity to be more on the "citrus" side, this is definitely more on the "spice" side. Eternity is sweeter, while Eternity now is more bitter.

That said, it's not unpleasant, and I typically use one or the other depending upon my mood. However, when I use this particular product, I now know I need to use less of it. This is good in a way, because it will probably last two to three times longer than Eternity. I do find that either lasts all day, and depending upon my stress level, it has a tendency to reactivate.

If  you like Eternity, you may not necessarily like Eternity Now.

review_title: Another great scent from Calvin Klein. Will buy again!

I don't know if that even makes sense LOL. I love the smell of vanilla so the tinge of it that this had was just enough. We will be adding this scent to the collection and will but it again. review_title: Great but I like the original better..

I have been using the original Eternity for quite a few years now and haven't tried anything new in the last couple of years. Comparing to that, this one:
- is milder; just apply a little and it seems to vanish in a couple of hours. (at least I can't smell it anymore)
- is pleasant, but I still like the original and IMHO, the original is more masculine than this one (but then what do I know? have to ask the ladies :) )
- The packaging is more attractive on this (the bottle and the cap)
I can only smell the vanilla and ginger/coconut but not all the things they say as ingredients.

In any case, I would still rate this at 4/5 and will use it as an alternative to the original Eternity once in a while. It is definitely mild enough to wear for offices, and so I do use it for that purpose

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Toilette Spray for Men, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
This fragrance is attractively packaged and small enough to easily throw into a gym bag or backpack. What immediately struck me about the scent was something I liken to coconut oil; a tad 'tropical', but not overpowering and somewhat fresh. Both my husband and I found it to be a nice daytime scent that became slightly sweeter the longer it was worn. Over time I also picked up hits of patchouli, but again, not overpowering.

I guess the greatest compliment I could give this scent would be that if the women's equivalent smells like this one - I'd buy it. Eternity Now would be a fragrance that should appeal to all ages of men who like a fresh, warm, sweet scent without being too 'in your face' about it. The scent retained its character throughout the day, and was very complimentary to the wearer as it didn't scream "I've got cologne on!", but rather whispered "Come closer to find out more."

Definitely a scent I'd recommend as a gift. Really nice!

--------------------------------------------

NOTE: the description on Amazon: "...captivates with the unexpected freshness of spicy ginger, coconut water, and star anise...with notes of crisp starfruit, cedarleaf, and patchouli. A bold masculine signature of exotic moroccan cedarwood, tonka bean and madagascar vanilla linger with vibrant sensuality."

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Toilette Spray for Men, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
I really enjoy wearing many of the new complex masculine fragrances - particularly as the weather turns colder.  I'm not talking about something that could be mistaken for a "unisex" scent, but rather colognes with heavy base notes of cedar, resin, leather and tobacco. If you are familiar with the original classic Eternity line (for both men and women), you can probably figure out that I was never a huge fan.  Even in warm weather I tend to avoid those beachy, "ozone" scents.  That said, I was intrigued that the description of Calvin Klein's Eternity Now for Men included Moroccan cedarwood so I thought I'd give it a go.

Unfortunately, it disappoints.  This is a very sweet, almost tropical, fragrance, with strong coconut and vanilla at the front.  If I did not know this was formulated specifically for men, I would categorize it as unisex.  I can't say I detected any woody notes either.  And, much like the classic Eternity scents,  it lacks the staying power of other high end fragrances and by the middle of the day, the spot I'd applied it at my wrists smelled only vaguely talc-like.

Overall, it's not a bad scent and I intend to put it aside for summer when it will be more appropriate.  But if you're looking for a heady, masculine scent - this is definitely not it.

review_title: A nice fragrance with good staying power.
review_text:
Calvin Klein's Eternity Now cologne has a pleasant scent, comes in a substantial bottle, and lasts a long time.

The Eternity Now is boxed in a simple cardboard box with a reinforced liner to protect the glass bottle.  The bottle itself is a chunky piece of glass with a simple and masculine design.  The whole presentation is very elegant and refined.

Eternity Now's fragrance is subtle and pleasant.  It has an earthly and slightly sweet scent.  It's not overly masculine, or smelling like a "lumberjack's shed", but it doesn't need to be.  It perfect for most occasions.

It has great staying power too.  I sprayed one spritz on myself, and it was still noticeable 6 hours later.  A little goes a long way.

I had no issues with rashes, itching, or skin irritation of any kind.

All in all... a wonderful cologne.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Toilette Spray for Men, 1 fl. oz.
review_text: Obviously fragrances are a matter of taste, but here's why I like this: it isn't overpowering--with a normal application of a spritz or two, you can smell that you are wearing it, and someone who comes nice and close to you can tell. You do not make the whole room have watery eyes, like some fragrances (and body sprays--the worst offenders). This smells nice and clean to me, and is less cloying, but similar to Atelier Cologne's Mandarine Glaciale---minus the strong tangerine smell of the latter. It smells expensive--not like cheap musk or overpoweringly of vanilla--more of a subtle vanilla dry down, with clean woods smell!

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Toilette Spray for Men, 1 fl. oz.
review_title: this one is a good quality one
review_text:
As a quality goes, this one is a good quality one. A single spray will stay with you the full day, even though it doesn't assault as strongly as it did when you started. On clothes, it's got one scent, but on skin it's a slightly different one. These are all things you expect from a perfume or cologne that's made well.

As far as the smell is concerned, this isn't my favourite by Calvin Klein. The one I love most from CK is CK One. It's timeless, and distinctive, and seems to smell slightly different on each person who wears it. This one has an undertone of baby powder on it. While that does lend to the "clean" part of the scent, it's not something that I'd wear all by itself. If I spray this on, I'll be adding some sandalwood oil to myself, so that I don't remind people of diaper changes.

product_title: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Toilette Spray for Men, 1 fl. oz.
review_text:
I don't wear cologne very often as I have very sensitive eyes and the alcohol dries them out pretty easily.  As such, I have to be judicious in which colognes I wear, as well as how often.

I won't compare this to the original Eternity because, frankly, I've never tried it.  I know it's popular, but even though Eternity Now shares a name with the original, it should probably be judged on its own merits.

Honestly, I really, really like this scent.  It's much sweeter than colognes I've used in the past.  To me I smell a lot of warm vanilla.  It could be its just how it reacts to my skin, but I quite like it.  I enjoy musky and citrus scents, but I'm a bit new to sweeter scents.  But, as I said, I really like it.

It's hard to write a review on cologne because it reacts differently to different skin types.  All I know is that it smells good on me and, bringing it back around to my opening sentence, its a scent I can very easily see myself wearing so long as my eyes allow me.  Which is saying a lot, frankly.

review_text:
This is my second bottle and it's become a regular in my cologne rotation. It's a clean almost soapy smell in the same mold as Gendarme or Thierry Mugler, understated yet pleasant and perfect for an office environment or during the summer.  It lasts 5-6 hours which isn't the best in terms of longevity compared to a lot of of other frags or body sprays, but at this price point I'm not really complaining. I usually spray this on in the morning and keep some in my gym bag if I need a bit of a recharge if I'm going out after work or after the gym.

If you're looking for something that makes a statement or is a bold in your face scent for the club, this ain't it. But if you're looking for something that's light and fresh and under $50, I would definitely recommend this.

review_title: I did NOT receive this product for free or at a discount in return for a review ! ! !
review_text: This is my new favorite WINTER men's Eau de fragrance I like all the the fragrances from John Varvatos. OK, I only like MASCULINE fragrances. I also like a more mature fragrance. Depending on what you know about fragrances, if you LOVE Paco Rabanne 1 million, you will HATE this fragrance.(don't confuse that with the original Paco Rabanne which is great and totally different,}. If you feel that Paco Rabanne 1 Million smells like chewing gum for kids, you will LOVE this product. This fragrance is NOT for everyone. I like and use many different fragrances. From very expensive to very cheap. This, in my opinion, is a winter fragrance that is very masculine. In the summer I use the nice old classic Nautica Voyage, Boucheron for men, Allure Homme Sport (which I wish was a bit more masculine but it's still good), and Acqua di Gio Profumo among others, In the winter months, I use Tom Ford Leather and of course, Dark Rebel. Just giving these examples so that you will know my preferences in fragrances and then you might be able to determine if you like Dark Rebel. My favorite, ALL YEAR ROUND fragrance is Green Irish Tweed By Creed. Dark Rebel is NOT your typical fragrance and I DO suggest you get a sample first. This is NOT for the young kid set. Younger women, for the most part, do not like it. This is NOT for those who want a sweet or feminine scent. This is masculine, winter and very different from other fragrances. The duration of the fragrance on your skin is long! The sillage is strong at first and then dies down to a "close to the skin" type of fragrance. I bought mine at Nordstrom.

review_text:
While I quite like CK One, as does my spouse, this one falls short of the goal of being great for both masculine and feminine preferences.  The fragrance in the bottle isn't exactly inspiring, but I tried it on me anyway.

On my female body, it smelled better than in the bottle - a definite plus.  On my husband, however, it didn't smell right at all.  Neither he nor I could stand how it smelled on him.  To quote him on how he felt about it, "I do not have words to express how much I HATE HATE HATE this fragrance. It's not terrible on you, but it turns my stomach and it has no redeeming features at all."

I think it's only okay on me, and I certainly wouldn't buy it for myself.

product_title: Calvin Klein CK2 Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text: Another unisex scent thats a very nice one. The smell immediately conjures up positive thoughts. The first thing I notice is a spice resembling cinnamon blended with juniper.  It has a very sweet grassy finish thats clean smelling.  Very pleasant (i.e. not musky or fermented).  It;s not a heavy scent fir scent like original Polo for instance, its much lighter and more complexthus a fine scent which will please a man or woman in most all cases I believe.  I do think its pretty unique therefore possibly polarizing to a relative few.  The only fault, for me at least, is the longevity isn't too good as it mostly recedes to zero well before the end of the work day, at least in my experience.

review_title: Like CK Eternity Aqua with some grassy and spicy notes
review_text:
I by no means have the professional vocabulary to describe all the various notes and nuances of this scent. I don't know what drydown or top notes are. So I will attempt to describe my experience with this scent in simple layman's terms.

I know that scents react differently with different people's chemistry so I can only speak for myself. When I first applied this it seemed very harsh, almost unpleasantly so. It smelled like several disconnected scents to me with one dominating, very dry and sharp scent (the wasabi? I think I just figured out what a top note is!) But after awhile (drydown perhaps?) the various elements became lighter and more harmonious.

Overall I would describe this scent as being very similar to Calvin Klein's Eternity Aqua-- one of my favorite summer scents because it reminds me of blue Caribbean waters-- with a dry, grassy element to it. It's a pretty scent, with some sweetness and a bit of spice to it. Delicate but complex.

I don't see this as a unisex scent at all. To me it smells very feminine. I'm not fond of the bottle; it takes a scent with a lot of elements from nature and makes it look like a laboratory specimen. Also, although I am sure the full 1.7 ounces are in there, the 3/4" of air space at the top of the bottle makes it appear that it's not a full, new bottle.

Those are my unprofessional, ordinary girl-on-the-street responses to this scent. To me it's a watery-grassy-spicy, light, summery, feminine scent.

product_title: Calvin Klein CK2 Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text:
This is a surprisingly complex scent.  Initially, it's almost harsh.  And even though the publicity cites wasabi as one of the top notes, for me the first impression was of a strong ozone with spicy black pepper at the front.  As it dries down, it reveals a crisp ocean/salt water note accompanied by a definite woodsiness (cedar or pine, perhaps?).  This is the perfect gender neutral fragrance with only the slightest hints of floral.  But even though the floral is very downplayed, after about an hour, the scent this most reminded me of was a past favorite - Prada's Infusium D'Iris.  I have no idea whether the floral note in CK2 is iris or not, but the lingering effect is strikingly similar to the popular Prada fragrance.

The only reason I would probably not recommend this is that, similar to Infusium D'Iris, the lasting power is fairly weak.  While the scent did not dissipate completely over the course of the work day, the strength and complexity faded significantly within the first two hours.

product_title: Calvin Klein CK2 Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text:
There's no question that this smells good, but as a cologne enthusiast I don't think it's worth significant praise. To test just how 'unisex' it is, I conducted a mini experiment where I asked friends to smell a sample and try to determine if it was a 'male' or 'female'. The results were expectedly mixed, with some leaning towards male and some leaning towards female. No one was especially passionate about one side or the other and when they discovered it was a 'unisex' scent there wasn't much surprise. Personally, I think it is more feminine than masculine.

What leaves me underwhelmed is how un-signature this fragrance is. Call me cheesy, but I like to select unusual colognes and even mix together favorites. I also want a fragrance that conveys images of mystery and intrigue, or at least convey SOMETHING. It doesn't have to be ultra masculine, in fact I've even mixed in some of the less sweet perfumes before. I think this fragrance is just kinda bland. By aiming to be neither male or female, it ends up being nothing. Like a clothing store where too much perfume and cologne have been sampled and they mix together into a bland mix of nauseous.

It does make me a little nauseous, too. A small spray goes a LONG way and too much is not flattering. I find myself almost being scared to use it because I'm afraid it'll end up being too much.

OVERALL: Not bad smelling, but it is strong and it doesn't have a lot of personality. Use in moderation and you'll smell nice, but I doubt you'll get any complements. The one area where it might work best is in a business professional environment, where a musky cologne is too overbearing and a flirty perfume is too sensual. For that, a more neutral pleasantness could be appreciated - but remember it's STRONG and nothing is worse than strong fragrance in a close-quarter work environment.

And that's probably my number 1 issue with this spray. It really doesn't last long at all.

My number 2 issue is the rather out-there bottle/bottle cap. Designed to be stored upside down, the cylinder housing the perfume will roll off your bathroom counter if you're not paying attention, and it seems like the bottle was designed with "trying to be different" in mind. It doesn't work for me.

Overall, a fine spray, if a tad feminine, and not long-lasting enough.

3.75 out of 5. Decent.

review_title: A nice citrus-y scent, great for daywear
review_text:
CK2 is a very interesting scent, the strongest tones that I detect are citrusy, reminding me strongly of grapefruit. The secondary tones do come in at the end for me, but they do not have a strong presence in my opinion. It's not a strong scent and does not seem to last for very long, I would say an hour or two at max, less in high sun conditions. I would definitely classify this as a "sporty scent," good for day time use, but maybe a little too bright for the nighttime (although that's really up to the wearer). It reminds me a bit of the Davidoff Cool Water line.

Unisex or not?  I can see it being unisex, but the scent does lean more towards the floral than the musky. I really do think either sex can successfully carry this scent. If I were to smell it wiithout any introduction, I would probably assume it was for the women rather than the men.

The bottle - for you bottle lovers - is unique.  The 1.7oz version has a large acrylic cap with the atomizer pointed downwards.  The bottle itself cannot rest without the cap as it's perfectly cylindrical on the sides and rounded on the bottom.  The topper is the only flat piece. If you loose it, the bottle is going to be rolling around unless you support it.  The plain and clear glass does stand out against other more ornate designs and looks nice and clean.

It's a nice general scent that will fit well into a rotation or as a daily use for the day, however if you're looking for a standout performer, this probably doesn't have quite the punch you're looking for.

product_title: Calvin Klein CK2 Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: A unisex scent which really is
review_text:
This is one of the first "unisex" toilette sprays that actually could be. It has enough warm and spicy notes to satisfy me but it's not too flowery for my husband. I should really add though, that men's colognes have gotten more complex and interesting over the years, so that while this may not have suited him, say, 20 years ago, he's become accustomed to these types of fragrances over the years.

I have always liked spicy notes in fragrances, and this has that. What it doesn't have is what I would describe as "leathery" notes, which to me smell too masculine. (Remember the original English Leather?) This has a lot of clean grassy notes that make it seem like a more casual, daytime fragrance. It will be a good one to wear on really hot days or nights when some of the floral or woody fragrances would be too cloying or overpowering. This feels light and has to be reapplied after 4 or 5 hours. It doesn't hang around for a long time. And that can be a good thing.

Sultry? Romantic? Mysterious? No. This is more of a fresh, alive and fun fragrance, a welcome addition to my fragrance wardrobe.

review_title: A fun, youthful revisit to the scent of the mid-90s!
review_text:
Boy does this perfume take me right back to the mid-90s when I was a preteen and scents like CK One and Clinique Happy were oh so popular. This is a very similarly scented spray that has an aquatic or ozonic base. It is not the most natural scent, and organic elements are not strong, this combination has a synthetic aspect to it. However, that won't turn everyone off. In fact, for Millennials like myself it is quite appealing and takes me back to shopping a mall in 1998.

The bottle is very attractive and fresh, a good representation of what scent is carried inside. It resembles a water cooler or tank and uniquely stands upside-down in its cap. The scent does not have the longevity I'd hoped for. It is certainly a unisex scent, however, it will wear better on women or youthful men, in my opinion. This scent would be a turn off on my 32-year-old husband, I think. I'd feel like, "Grow up, already." But my husband loves it on ME! And I think any teenager could pull it off well.

product_title: Calvin Klein CK2 Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: Vanilla, spice and a slightly sweet bias.
review_text: The original CKOne is now in middle age, but when it was introduced I loved the concept, the scent and the packaging. It was all about simplicity, a unisex scent emphasizing clean citrus notes that was fresh and energizing. So I was very anxious to see what this new interpretation of Calvin Klein perfumers had come up with. The packaging itself seems to elicit diverse extremes of opinions. One reviewer called it "goofy". Personally, I think it's brilliant, clean. clear, and ultra-modern suggesting a laboratory beaker. The bottle actually rests upside down with the spray head tucked inside the base, though it will fit upright as well. The lettering and font is also very clean, modern and minimalistic, which aligns perfectly with it's concept of unisex simplicity. All that noted, you buy a scent for it's appeal and the feeling it produces and projects. The appeal of a scent is highly relative and individualistic. This scent is pleasant, with a slight sweetness, vanilla and spice and a suggestion of baby powder. When I first applied it, I frankly thought it was too strong and sweet, but in a few minutes it settled down and became more smooth and even. As the day wore on, it took on the subtle vanilla aroma that I think is universally appealing, and also appropriate for either gender. I waffled between giving it a full 5 stars or something less, but decided on a four star rating only because it does retain slightly more sweetness than I prefer. Of the two incarnations, I still favor CKOne for it's more citrus bias, but this is still an appealing choice I'll wear intermittently for a change of pace. As always, when it comes to a scent, it's always best to try a sample when you're wading through a department store or at the airport DutyFree store to make sure it's something you find appealing before offering your credit card.  Amazon offers the no tax sale and quick delivery I always appreciate when it's time to order.

review_text: Before ordering this Calvin Klein CK2 eau de toilette spray from the Amazon Vine program, I already owned two different Calvin Klein fragrances:  Eternity and Eternity Aqua.  I do like this new CK2 scent, but out of the three of them, Eternity is my favorite.  CK2 is a gender free fragrance, meaning it is designed for use by both women and men.  It comes in a cool-looking, contemporary bottle.  The CK2 scent is a bit hard to describe.  Per the website, it combines spicy electric freshness and the warmth of magnetic woods.  Not exactly sure about that, but I find the fragrance to be quite pleasant.  The scent does not fade quickly like some of the other fragrances I have used. Like other Calvin Klein fragrances, CK2 is pricey; the larger 3.4 fl oz bottle is a bit more economical.  Overall, I do like it and would recommend.

product_title: Calvin Klein CK2 Eau de Toilette Spray
review_title: This is definitely a unisex product that has more feminine notes.
review_text:
This CK2 fragrance is a new 2016 twist on older CK products. Indeed, colgnes and perfumes smell differently on people and even objects. I had a very mixed reaction to it in the beginning and after careful, extended examination of the fragrance can - rather subjectively - classify as a more feminine product. There are noticeable highs and middles of rose, citrus, and violet leaf that make this spray more feminine.  Yet, there's a noticeable base fragrance of sandalwood that gives it the overall masculine undertone and caused it to be classified as unisex. It's a complex formula that upon spraying immediately greets you with a sharper fragrance, but after a minute a two it mellows out significantly. It does not have a strong sillage but has a good longevity overall.

The scent and what makes things smell attractive to you is a very subjective thing. Overall, like any other cologne or perfume, it is imperative that you smell it first before ordering it. I personally didn't fall in love with it. My teenage daughter, on the other hand, really likes it.

review_title: Wife prefers this Mr. Burberry to my old Platinum goste
review_text:
Mr. Burberry is the first cologne I've found that tempts me away from the Chanel Platinum goste I've been wearing for years (er, decades). That's not too surprising, as I did a little online research and found quite a few similarities in the basenote/topnotes* between them. Both have a sandalwood base, and a citrus top note.

Between the two, my wife much prefers Mr. Burberry. A survey of the four kids breaks along gender lines, with the boys liking Platinum goste and the girls preferring Mr. Burberry, probably because it's a little lighter and more "floral" on top.

The black and white photos don't do justice to the color of this cologne - a lovely, pale aqua vitae blue. The bottle looks really great on the shelf.

* Mr. Burberry
Top Notes: Grapefruit, Tarragon, Cardamom
Heart Notes: Birch leaf, Nutmeg, Cedarwood
Base notes: Sandalwood, Vetiver, Guaiac wood

product_title: philosophy for men Amen Men's Spray Cologne, 2 fl. oz.
review_text:
Top notes: tea and citrus
middle notes: spices
base notes: musk and sandalwood

Scent: I was worried this was going to be just another cologne composed of citrus/spices/musk. That's a proven and easy-to-like scent profile -- so proven and likable that it's become common. Amen is actually something more -- a subtle scent where the tea tempers the brightness of the citrus up top and the spices and sandalwood provide an almost woody dryness underneath. The notes are very well-blended; no one note predominates. Amen definitely has a personality -- a sophisticated, soft-spoken one. While marketed to men, this cologne could work for the right woman.

Performance: Amen has surprising longevity. I could still faintly smell this on my wrist six hours after spraying, which is very good for a soft fragrance. The downside is the projection, which is almost non-existent after the first hour. According to philosophy, this is not a bug but a feature. Amen is being marketed as an anti-Axe Spray -- not so much a fragrance as a kind of alternative to fragrance. People who get close to you won't think, "Ah, philosophy's Amen sure smells good" -- instead, they'll think, "Ah, [YOUR NAME HERE] sure smells good." In short, this cologne is for the guy who likes the clean, close-to-the-skin smell of fine soap but wants it to last most of the day instead of an hour.

Price: While Amen is not top-of-the-line expensive, it's not exactly inexpensive, either. Make sure to compare colognes by cost-per-ounce. I have a 2-oz. bottle of Amen that prices-out at around the same cost as some 3-oz. and 4-oz. bottles of other colognes. I don't think Amen is too expensive given the quality of the scent, but your mileage might vary.

Summary: Amen is a spicy, sophisticated scent that lasts a long time but projects weakly. For me, it's a cologne that works for every season and for any time of day. It's not the kind of bold fragrance suitable for clubbing, but that's by design -- it shines as an office scent. It's primarily made for you and for those whom you pull close. Overall, I'm giving Amen four out of five stars.

P.S. philosophy dresses its packaging with copy blocks written to sound contemplative and/or food-for-thoughtish. Below is the copy on Amen's box. I'm not certain how this copy connects to the scent, but I'm including it here in case it speaks to you:

philosophy: the difference between a hero and a superstar is that a hero doesn't need a crowd. many of us have lost sight of who our true heroes really are. they are the "a" men and women who defend our country, do menial chores and act as good neighbors. whether they sweep streets or lead a nation, they walk the talk. we don't need another superstar. we do need to salute our true heroes. amen.

review_title: Nice, not overly aggressive scent, the citrus notes fade too quickly for me
review_text:
This was an impulse purchase.
I had been thinking about how i missed Loves Lemon fresh from the 70s, as i have a rough time with synthetic fragrances, and Loves didn't trigger respiratory issues and smelled so happy.
About an hour later this Mens cologne appeared in my vine queue. In reading that it was citrusy I decided to give it a try. I haven't found a mens cologne i could handle my husband wearing and hoped this would do the trick.
I sprayed a spritz outside to see if it was going to be overpowering or trigger any negative response.
Passed that test, so spritzed once in house and turned on ceiling fan to disperse.
Still good.
Spritzed husband when he got home. Really liked the citrus top note. Smelled of lime to me. The base notes are subtle at first and have a nice depth and complexity that compliment the citrus.
After about an hour went back and had nice lingering hug with husband, and citrus pretty much gone and remaining scent quite different and surprisingly more intense from the starting point. More musky, soapy, linen like. Not bad, but not what i hoped for.
This makes a nice home fragrance spray for tose who don't like overly floral, heavy scents. Doesnt take much!
