review_text: Got this for the Hubby, but he is not a fan.  He thinks the citrus notes are overwhelming.  I rather liked it, in fact, so much that I have taken to using it sparingly myself sometimes.  It's a clean and slightly citrus scent, and when used in small doses it adds a nice fresh scent, great for those of us gals who dislike the flowery heavy perfumes that are the usual female norm.  The bottle is a nice quality, and so is the spray mechanism.  Many times, I have purchased scent and found the bottle and sprayer so cheaply made that it was tough to use and control the amount of scent released.  This is actually a pretty large bottle, and will last a long time.  At the price, I wouldn't probably buy it for myself or my husband, but if you normally spend this much and like a citrusy fresh scent or your man does, it will do the job.  Just remember, not too much at once, because when overused the citrus is way too strong to be pleasant.

review_title: Subtle, citrus and 'laundry' scent = office friendly
review_text: I love my Theirry Mugler colognes, but they're strong enough to put someone in a scent headlock. While normally I could care less, there are times - especially in male dominated office environs - where this isn't the best option. The excellent Avon Derek Jeter Driven (yes, you read that correctly) is my go-to when scent Batman needs to be cologne Bruce Wayne. This reminds me of that...only a light lighter, citrus versus grapefruit, and with a gentle laundry undertone to it that keeps it fresh. Too bad Avon doesn't sell the original version anymore. Despite being subtle, philosophy's Amen is a cologne meant to wear sparingly. Too much of it, and the lesser textures dominate in a bad way. Again, it's more of a nice accompanying versus heavy scent. Would I spent ~$50 for this? Probably not. You'd be surprised what one can find going into Perfumania, speaking to the reps there. Michael Jordan Flight Michael Jordan Flight Eau De Toilette Spray for Men, 3.4 Ounce, for instance (again, I'm not making this stuff up) is an equivalent and higher quality subtle scent at half the price. Ditto Usher for Men Usher By Usher For Men, Eau De Toilette Spray, 3.4-Ounce, a best seller on Amazon for it's scent versus hokiness. Now if you're wanting to truly up your scent game, Thierry Mugler, peeps. The Bourbon and Cigar scents are awesome.

review_text: I'm a long time fan of Amazing Grace scent by Philosophy. I thought the men's Amen fragrance sounded promising. The scent starts off with a pleasant citrus scent. Unfortunately, the scent than takes a bad turn. It's hard to explain, but the citrus fades to a cleaning fluid smell. Yuk. Three of us all came to the same conclusion.

product_title: philosophy for men Amen Men's Spray Cologne, 2 fl. oz.
review_text: I love bulgari. It is a wonderful clean scent with just the right hint of manly spicy end notes. This starts off with the same citrus notes with a little heavier lime but as it transitions to the floral bouquets and spicy undertones it loses some of the depth and staying power. It quickly devolves into just hints of sweet citrus. 4 outa 4 people could not tell difference between it and Bv for first few minutes. After an hour 4 out of 4 could and preferred bulgari.  As a scent alone I'd give it  3.5 stars. For this price and this staying power and for being a total bulgari knock off id give it 0 if I could.

The scent of the one I bought online lasts only for 30 minutes max.  I asked my husband to smell me after 15 min of spraying it liberally, and he couldn't smell a thing! This is the first time buying this perfume online, and I went by all the positive reviews I read - so I am very disappointed in receiving a fake product.

product_title: Lolita Lempicka Au Masculin Fraicheur by Lolita Lempicka For Men. Eau De Toilette Spray 1.7oz.
review_text: I can pretty much guarantee you that if you wore this out, no one else will have the same scent as you. It is very unique and noticeable but not as mainstream as most scents these days. This is a great blend of licorice, anise, vanilla, and greens with a tad of pralines in there. It basically comes out to a candy anise scent with some vanilla and greens. This is a definite must try but a hard blind buy since it is so different than most fragrances. If you do not like anise or black licorice chances are you won't like this. Also, for some reason women love the anise note...it weird but they do. To me this is close to unisex. It is better in cooler weather as well. For the price, I think it is a great buy if you like anise.

product_title: Lolita Lempicka Au Masculin Fraicheur by Lolita Lempicka For Men. Eau De Toilette Spray 1.7oz.
review_title: Lovely, but perhaps not for everyone
review_text:
I'm an anise fiend, so the vanilla/anise note that LL is constructed around was a clear winner, and I'm thrilled to find a vanilla scent that's not sickly sweet as so many tend to. Very strong projection on my skin, and it lasts and lasts, so I apply pretty lightly.

The 3oz bottle will probably last me quite a while but once it's gone I'll definitely be on the lookout for more.

product_title: Lolita Lempicka Au Masculin Fraicheur by Lolita Lempicka For Men. Eau De Toilette Spray 1.7oz.
review_text:
Lolita Lempicka is an unusual fragrance in that you won't find everyone else wearing it. That semi-exclusivity, along with its exotic name, lends it an air of elitism. All this at a price that's typically less than the Acqua di Gios and Polos of the world that seem to envelope every restaurant and bar around the globe.

Lolita starts out a bit strong, with sharp notes of licorice and black pepper, but quickly dries down to heady blend of cotton-candy and sweet spice. It's absolutely intoxicating, if a bit sweet. But don't let that sweetness scare you - it's a refreshing change from whatever you've been wearing.

After sampling Lolita and wearing it for a few days, I discovered that it has staying power usually found only in EDPs or especially cloying scents like Hypnose or heavily woodsy ones, like Polo Explorer.

For me, Lolita Lempicka offers tremendous longevity; I spray two or three times in the morning (on pulse points, like the base of the neck and behind the ears) and find that it dries down and lasts well into the evening.

You'll find yourself telling everyone what your wearing, as the longevity offers numerous opportunities for the curious to inquire as to your fragrance. Do us both a favor. Tell 'em it's Canoe.

product_title: Lolita Lempicka Au Masculin Fraicheur by Lolita Lempicka For Men. Eau De Toilette Spray 1.7oz.
review_title: May be I am not the gourmand guy
review_text:
I know this product is genuine but I just could not work my way around this. I love Boss Bottled which I believe is a gourmand as well. But Lolita Lempicka has a kind of very sweet sugary spicy smell which my nose could not stand. It is very sharp and I would not recommend this for people with sensitive nose. I thought my nose just needs to get used to this type. So I tried 3 times and I had to wash my hands off because I might throw up if I kept it on my skin. Finally, I gave this up to a friend. If you know someone who has this, try before you buy. This is definitely not a blind buy kind of fragrance.

Update 02/09/2011
I stopped by at my friend's place and I was curious to try this one more time to see if I have developed a liking towards this. Fortunately I have not. It still smells bad on me. I am sorry, but I will not recommend this to any man.

review_title: Not what I was looking for
review_text:
I was under the impression that this fragrance would smell like roses,  which it does not  perhaps I was misinformed.  To me, it has a dusty, powdery, faded, muted, muddy quality -  as if there are too many  ingredients, or as if it's trying too hard to be too many things -  rather than having a "clear" scent.  But that is my subjective opinion, and may not be the experience of others.  It gives me a headache  but  I think I may be oversensitive, since  that is my experience with a number of fragrances.

 I had been looking forward to the classic scent others have  described    but I will be returning this one.  To be fair, others may like this, but it's  just not quite the right one for me.

5 stars on the product but 1 star on the pricing.

product_title: Pink Sugar Eau de Toilette Natural Spray
review_text:
Its Pink Sugar. You either love it or hate it! Its an intensely sweet fragrance that smells like spun sugar with a hint of licorice candy? Also to me has a little of that new doll smell if that makes sense? I know, it sounds like an odd smell, but this fragrance garners compliments like nobodys business all day long, especially from men. People think it smells like cotton candy or cookies or baked goods when I wear it. Its generally marketed as a younger woman fragrance, but I am almost 50 and I love it on days when I want to indulge my sweet tooth! I think it is too sweet for intense summer heat.

This was a fresh bottle, this perfume can get yellowed if old or exposed to heat or sun, the bottle I received was new and fresh. Good sprayer, the paper tube outer packaging is nice to have to protect bottle for travel, and to keep it protected from light.
Pink Sugar is incredibly long lasting, no need to overspray because a single spritz of this will make you a walking sugar bomb for the whole day. Lasts days on clothing.

product_title: Rochas Eau de Rochas Eau de Toilette, 3.3 fl. oz.
review_text:
Eau de Rochas eau de toilette
Contents: 10.6 ounces
Amazon price: $73.00

This fragrance has been produced by the Parisian house of Rochas for decades. It has never gone out of style. Because this is an eau de toilette, it is not at all heavy. Instead, its light and fragrant with a clean, refreshing citrusy top note. The secondary notes are floral with some bergamot. Just because Eau de Rochas has been around for a while, it doesnt mean its your mothers perfume. Quite the contrary, the refreshing lemony, grapefruit notes feel youthful and contemporary.

Strong perfumes have fallen way out of fashion but nice, clean eau frache fragrances are still very much in demand. This is an eau de toilette, don't expect the fragrance to last all day. French perfumery is never inexpensive, but remember that this size is 10.6 ounces. Thats a lot.

Im writing this for my wife who has now rediscovered Eau de Rochas. She wore it years ago and is enjoying the lovely citrusy fragrance again. Im happy as well, as Im a beneficiary. If you like lighter fragrances, youll like Eau de Rochas. Recommended for its fragrance but realize that you may need to reapply it during the day.

product_title: Rochas Eau de Rochas Eau de Toilette, 3.3 fl. oz.
review_text:
This Eay de Toliette is a nice everyday scent. It seem strong for the first minute then lightens up. I smell a citrus smell only for the first few minutes then a mix of citrus and floral. After an hour or so the citrus is lighter and I smell a mixture of citrus, floral, and powdery (very light on the last) mix.
This is a pleasant, light, scent. I can see why it is "multi-generational". It has a classy edge without being heavy. As with any Eau de Toilette it will need to be reapplied after a few hours. But atomizers are not difficult to find, I just filled a small one for my purse.

product_title: Rochas Eau de Rochas Eau de Toilette, 3.3 fl. oz.
review_text:
So, perfumes tend to change once they hit the skin of the wearer.  Meaning: they smell one way in the bottle, another on the person.  Thankfully, this one didn't change much at all when my wife put it on.

If you've never experienced Parisian perfume before, you're in for a real treat here.  This is a delicate, complex scent, as all Parisian perfumes are. One maybe two spritzes is all it takes for this perfume to do its work.
*NOTE: If you've never used perfume before, here:
ONE spritz on your wrist, then rub your wrists together, then rub your wrists high up on the sides of your neck. DONE.
Perfume is an intimate thing.  Only a person well within your personal space should be able to smell it.

Back on point:  for me, the most pronounced scents in Eau de Rochas are: citrus (orange and grapefruit), rose petals, jasmine and a touch of musk.  The musk is nice (not overpowering at all) as it grounds the perfume.  The rose & citrus are the real stars of the show.

A very winning scent!

review_title: Very "French" herbal, heavy on the bergamot.
review_text:
Judging a scent is a very personal thing.  I'll try to be fair here.  This cologne is quite strong but because it has a high water and alcohol content the scent does not linger forever.  To me that is a plus.  Although it is full of many notes - citrus, floral, even musk - to me the overwhelming smell is bergamot.  This is a complex scent.  Although I did not recognize the name, I did recognize that I have smelled this on other people more than once.  The blurb calls it a classic - I guess that means it has been around for a long time.

Eau de Rochas was too strong for me, and I dislike bergamot.  But someone else might find it wonderful.  It is more herbal than floral, and though it lists musk, I did not get even a hint of muskiness.

Your best bet would be to try it at a perfume counter before buying this large bottle.

product_title: Laura by Laura Biagiotti Eau de Toilette for Women
review_text:
This review is brought to you by the lady of the house....

Laura is an alluring, yet fresh, slightly citrusy scent.  There is a deeper, strong undertone, too, which gives it body.  Struggling to describe it, may be a mixture, cassis?  Anyway, I like it!  Seems like so many perfumes smell the same nowadays, this is different.  Would make a good signature scent.  It is subtly bold, noticeable but not shouting, like that quiet power in a room.

I wore it behind my knees and it lasted well.  It is a fine all season fragrance, well-balanced, with different notes that seem more or less prominent in warm or cold weather.

The lovely bottle consciously takes up little vanity space, but sits in a stable way.  It is also easy to identify by its pretty blue top among my lotions and potions.

Random thought, but I am a label and am curious to see if it will repel Mosquitos at all. It appears to have small amounts of what I think is a citronella derivative.  However, does NOT smell like citronella.  Going to save some for summer and see how that works out, will repost then.  Hope it does, would be pretty great to smell nice and keep off the pesky bugs.

As with most scents, this one smells differently when applied. I did not care for the scent when I smelled it (aerated)  initially but really liked it when it was applied and had time to settle. On my daughter, the floral was not as notable and the musky side of the scent was more pronounced. product_title: Lacoste Original Eau de Toilette for Men
review_text: Scent is a very subjective thing, and it's hard to review one in writing, but I'll try. By the time I started choosing my own cologne, I found that trying to choose one from a department store was a waste of time. I thought they all smelled the same: gay/metrosexual. I have nothing against that, but I am neither. I needed something clean, masculine, and down-to-earth. Doesn't have to be fancy. This fits the bill for me. It smells somewhere between lemons, soap, and woods. Very smooth, very casual. The bottle is white, and I think white is a good color for the scent honestly. Go light, and you'll be alright. It's also fairly linear, unless your body starts to heat up, like if you're working out -- the scent changes only slightly, becoming a little stronger and spicier but maintaining the essence of clean and casual. I've been wearing this for almost a decade, and I've become quite fond of it. I once decided to try Sung pour Homme as a replacement for this, but that was a mistake. This is way better. By the way, buying cologne on Amazon is a gamble. I'd recommend getting it from a store. I got mine from a Burlington that opened right by my home, and was surprised to see it as I hadn't had it in a few years. It was about $30, compare that to Amazon's $55.

product_title: Laura Biagiotti Roma Eau de Toilette for Women
review_text:
Roma by Laura Biagiotti is a lush fragrance, perfect for a woman who likes a touch of mystery and sophistication. I was on the fence when I first applied it, but as it dried down the intensity of it deepened. I would describe it as elegant, sweet, a bit decadent. It can go to the office or out to dinner, and would suit virtually any occasion.

This eau de toilette lasts most of the day when sprayed on pulse points. After about 8-12 hours, its pretty much faded away. I prefer scents that fade this way, as I don't like to wake up smelling of the previous days fragrance.

An added bonus: Roma comes in a really attractive bottle that suggests a broken column from an ancient Roman ruin. Gorgeous.

review_title: Rockstar performer in longevity/sillage an unique fragrance...
review_text:
For those of you tired of weak performers, Costume National goes "beast mode" with the Homme fragrance.  Out of the bottle, you are hit instantly with a blend of cloves, cardamon, patchouli, and sandalwood notes.  The fragrance goes through the dry down period and those same notes remain.  And do they ever..!!  Word of caution - use sparingly.  With a vast collection of fragrances, I am not sure I have any that can top the longevity and projection for CNH.  Great fragrance when used for the right occasion.

Based on the notes, in my opinion, CNH is best suited for Fall and Winter wear and night outings.  Any coolness will take the "edge" off that some may find offensive.  Definitely not a fragrance for the office or outings in tight quarters with other people. I see this fragrance is being worn by a younger crowd up to 35 years.  I will also add that given the right personality, a woman can easily "pull this off" - it is daring enough to be enjoyed in mixed company.

I love the bottle and packaging - both first rate with a classy touch.  The bottle has a slight curvature that is well designed.  The price/value is not too good for a designer fragrance and I imagine it is the whole supply/demand thing.  I spotted one current online price of over $100 USD for a small bottle.

My final tally for Costume National's Homme edition is 4.1 stars out of 5 stars.  If you like unique and daring fragrances that make a statement, this one is for you and you will love it.  The Thierry Mugler Angel and A*Men fans will love this edition.  For that audience, I highly recommend.  For those not looking to make a statement or like to "fly under the radar", pass on CNH.  Be bold - be daring and go for it.  Step out of the comfort zone - you may like it..!!

Enjoy your day and make it count.  Invest your time rather than wasting your time...

review_title: A little stronger than I'm used to, but still very wearable
review_text: I have my favorite perfumes, but wanted to switch things up a little, so tried out the Juicy Couture perfume. It's definitely not my all-time favorite, but it's a nice addition to my collection that I'll wear when I'm in the mood. I've learned that I'm a more light, fruity and citrus perfume person (my regular perfume of choice is Tory Burch's 1st perfume, but I love DKNY Be Delicious, too), so I felt this was a bit too strong and powerful for my liking. But definitely nothing close to some of the perfumes I've smelled. There is a little bit of fruitiness to it and I get a touch of baby powder on the end.

product_title: Juicy Couture Women's Perfume
review_title: Knockout of an Eau de Parfum by Juicy Couture
review_text: This EDP spray by the fashion house of Juicy Couture Is extremely pretty in appearance, and it smells completely delicious! My first impression is of honeydew melon and of honeysuckle. These top notes quickly dry down into the scent of tuberose and lily, two "white flowers" which are often used in perfumes. I barely smell the base notes of caramel and brown sugar, however the scent is very long lasting and wonderful for fruit (the honeydew does linger) and flower lovers. I would say if you particularly love tuberose, go for this! Also if you like really stunning eau de perfum bottles (which I do), try this offering from Juicy Couture. The bottle is very heavy, and the cut glass top is a total wow. The little charms, attached at the bottle's wrapped neck by a quaint silver tone safety pin, are of an imperial crown in faux ivory and a silvery "J" for Juicy. The label has the couture house scottie crest in silver on the front and the box is--what else? Pink! It's Juicy Couture. Makes a super gift for the perfume lover in your life, or for yourself. I love this: it really does have the juice!

review_text:
Such a subtle refreshing smell -- I get compliments ALL THE TIME. But since it's a subtle smell, people usually only notice when they hug me. Which is nice - who wants to walk into a room and smell the place up with perfume?

I've used it for 2-3 years, and its still my favorite. Smells like lotion, but the scent lingers all day.  In my opinion, it smells even better than the L'Occitane cherry blossom lotion actually.

I highly recommend if you are looking for a subtle flowery scent :)

product_title: Hugo Boss FEMME Eau de Parfum, 1.6 Fl Oz
review_text:
I've used this scent for years, and it is wonderful. I also used Dior's Miss Dior, Candy by Prada, and Delicate by Narcisso Rodriguez recently. I mention this just so you can get an idea of what kind of scent appeals to me, not because I am here to give you detail account of my personal preferences, but to give you a point of reference.

This is a very delicate, feminine, sensual scent. It does not overpower, and it is very wearable - from the office to the date with your significant other. I got more compliments about this perfume than any other one I have had, so that tells you something. Men and women like it equally, and even my friends who are sensitive to fragrance have spoken favorably about it.

If there was any downside it would be that you have to order it online, however, that may be a plus side too, since your friends won't have it. :) I have not seen it in any local stores.

Word of advice: everyone has different chemistry, so the same scent will smell very differently on different people. I would tell you to go to Nordstrom and get a sample first, but they don't carry Boss fragrances. If this is your first time buying it, I would go for a smaller size to test it. I find it lovely, but scents are such a personal thing and tastes also change overtime.. So you have to decide for  yourself.

review_text:
This is my favorite fragrance.  Whatever the individual notes are, I'm sure absinthe is in there somewhere.  But that doesn't prevent me from describing it.  Absinth is an incredibly smooth, spicy, green scent, that is reminiscent of smokey or spicy grass.  It opens very powerfully, only dying down to something more palatable after an hour or so.  But I thoroughly enjoy this fragrance, so the initial power of the top notes doesn't bother me.

To be quite honest, the scent doesn't really develop over time.  It's quite linear on my skin.  Again, this isn't a big problem for me because I enjoy it so much.

The only negative thing I might have to say is that the longevity of Absinth could be better, considering the quality of the notes that Nasomatto has put into this.  I would rarely say that a fragrance is worth 175$, but this is one of those rare cases IMO.

review_title: If you like the smell of secondhand books
review_text:
Once I buy a book, I smell it. If you like the smell of secondhand books, you will love this scent. I finally found out why it smells like an old book. Luca Turin, who is an authority on scents and the science of olfaction, states in his book "perfumes, the guide", that the cologne contains Lignin, which trees make to prevent them from "weeping".
When tree made into papers, this compound breaks down and smells like vanillin. That is why Dzing smells of a "vanilla book".
This cologne fulfills two loves: books and perfumes.

review_text:
When this scent first entered our house, my DH loved it. I thought it smelled like cardboard and cotton candy; intriguing, but not sexy. I've spritzed it on here and there blended with other scents for depth and it smelled phenomenal on our Pomeranian. Well, we've got 25% of the 100ml bottle left, and last week I spritzed it on casually and went to the movies. In the movie theater, I thought what's that great smell and realized it was ME. I've figured out that my body chemistry has changed in the six years this bottle has been with us, because my DH says it still smells the same on him. I am now obsessed with it and am purchasing the 3.4 oz bottle.

I think it'll be different on every person (like every scent right?) but in itself it's a very unique scent by a parfumeur who has a cult-like following; very unusual scents. Whether you'll like it or want to wear it is another matter.

Cologne is a nice, simple fragrance that is what it appears to be - a simple citrus scent. It's nothing fancy and likely has been done a thousand times, but this one's still nice. There's nothing really hidden here or exceptional - the notes all seem to be there. Orange remains throughout the fragrance and is partnered with the floral notes. review_title: Very, very sad and disappointed that C & E reformulated the "Rosewater" collection--but there is some hope
review_text: i have loved and used the Crabtree & Evelyn Rosewater collection products for many years--over 20.  I fell in love with them when I worked at a Crabtree & Evelyn store (long since closed) during my college years.  My husband has kept me well supplied over the years, Valentine gifts, etc. so I had plenty on hand but when he placed an order recently, we both just assumed that the packaging had been updated.  Sadly, it wasn't just the packaging that was changed but the entire formula.  It is no longer the wonderful, beautiful rose scent that I have grown to love.  I do not care for the new products-- the "added scents"--yuck!  I poked around the C & E website and found they have added "violet, peony, and musk"(musk???), to the Rosewater products.  However, I guess that they have heard the many, many complaints (on Amazon as well as their own site) and after some careful searching, I found that they are AT LEAST still offering two of the good older formulations, labeled as "Classic Rosewater" Bath and Shower Gel, and "Classic Rosewater" Body Lotion.  They don't show up when you search the "Rosewater Collection" page however.  You have to dig a little deeper--I have no idea why they are "hiding" them.  So, I am very happy that I can at least still obtain these two products, thank goodness.  I have never been able to find comparable rose scented products that have such a wonderful fragrance.  I am very pleased that I can continue to take my Rosewater bubble baths that I have grown to love and treasure.  It seams that for some reason, I am finding more and more of my faithful go-to cosmetics and toiletries suddenly discontinued and spending lots of frustrating time and money attempting to find acceptable (often disappointing or inferior) replacements.  I guess I'm getting old!  From some of the other reviews, it seems that some of Crabtree's other product lines have been "reformulated" as well. product_title: Rochas Eau de Rochas Fraîche Eau de Toilette
review_text:
I got this for my fiance and here's what she has to say. The packaging wasn't particularly artistic or swanky--a bit plastic-y and run of the mill. When I opened the bottle, the scent made me pull away...my first thought was, "not my cup of tea...too strong and spicy, with an old-ladyish powdery scent.  BUT - the initial spiciness & powdery smell wore off in a few minutes, after which the fresh floral notes underneath really came to the fore and I enjoyed the lingering scent immensely.

I love expensive perfumes, particularly flowery ones, and although this wasn't one I would have chosen from a bevy of others, I do think it's a unique and perfectly acceptable perfume.  Sharp and strong when first sprayed but after all is said and done, Eau de Rochas Fraiche is a nice subtle scent and good for every day use. Considering the price, I don't know that I'd keep buying it, however--there are others I'd prefer. In the meantime I can make those favorite expensive brands last, saving them for special occasions.

review_text: I really coukdn't decide how many stars to give this toilette spray, and wavered between two and three. I decided on three. I know the scent of a perfume is very subjective, but I asked several people to try this on, and tell me what they thought, and the consensus was that it smells matronly, not very good, and that they woukd not buy this after smelling it. That is pretty much my opinion, too. It's a nice bottle, very pretty, but I just did not like the scent.

product_title: Rochas Eau de Rochas Fraîche Eau de Toilette
review_text:
This sounded like a fragrance I'd like - it contains notes that have been in other perfumes I've worn - so I thought it might be something nice to try for spring. It didn't smell anything like what the description sounds like. It's close to something or more accurately, many things my grandmother wore. It's slightly peppery, sharp and medicinal and has that undefinable something that just says, "grandma." I initially sprayed a little on my wrists and neck to test it out and the smell was so strong and irritating that I ended up washing it off a half hour later.

The bottle is pretty inexpensive looking. It's textured glass with a big ball cap. There's no pretty shape or design to it, things I'd expect from a scent  at this price point.

If you're looking for a perfume that screams "grandma!" for someone special, then this is a perfect choice.

(I should add that I'm not far off from my own AARP membership so the title is kind of tongue in cheek)

product_title: Rochas Eau Sensuelle Eau de Toilette
review_text:
I got this fragrance for my wife and found it decent but unexciting.  I think it smells a lot like soap.  Not deodorant soap mind you, but one of those fancy little soaps you aren't supposed to use or the wife gets mad at you.  It is fruity and flowery with just a hint of baby powder.  Certainly not offensive, but also not particularly sensual or romantic, at least not for me.  Other reviewers have said it is good for summer; I can understand that but think it would be just fine any time.  I would say it is medium-body, certainly not heavy and maybe a little on the lighter side.

It's half-life is about 4 hours or so; in other words, I can still smell it on her after a full day, but it's only about 1/4th as strong.

I would say it tends older, i.e. 30s and up.  My teen daughter characterized it as "musty flowers" and while she thought it was okay, it wasn't something she found special or would wear regularly.

Overall I would say this is a good, basic scent that is just fine but nothing special or head-turning.  If that's what you want, it could be perfect for you.  If you want something a little spicy or musky or daring, this is probably not the one.

review_title: Much more floral than citrus scented - too floral for me...
review_text: I love citrusy scents and the description was that this would be citrusy with some floral notes. Well, unfortunately the floral notes are too strong and overpower the citrus in my opinion. At first I thought it might still be ok even though it was more floral than I usually like. However, whatever they're using to create the floral scent it has that "avon" product aspect that gives me a killer headache after about 30 minutes or so of smelling it. I put the bottle in the dock house - the entry to our houseboat dock and where folks put stuff to give away - and someone seemed to have snatched it up right away, so you might like it as well. I'd just say that if you're sensitive to Avon scents or other inexpensive scents you might want to pass on this, or also if you'd prefer stronger citrus over floral.

product_title: Rochas Eau Sensuelle Eau de Toilette
review_title: A delicate blend of citrus, floral and spice elements that is fresh and appealing
review_text:
This is a lighter, fruitier fragrance with slight overtones of jasmine and spice mingled in with the citrus notes. Even when initially applied, it isn't cloying or overpowering. It is delicate enough so that even if you find perfumes to be initially overwhelming, you probably won't have that problem with Rochas Eau Sensuelle.

Upon application the citrus notes predominate. This lends the fragrance an appealing freshness that is subtle enough so that as it begins to mature on the skin and the floral elements come to the fore, it retains its appeal even as the aroma becomes more complex. The various elements of the fragrance don't clash as they are released on the skin, an unfortunate attribute which can give lesser perfumes a slightly unpleasant bitterness which I find off-putting. There is a pleasant and attractive balance of fragrances that is revealed over the 4-6 hours of a single application's efficacy.

The Rochas Eau Sensuelle is a subtle and delicate blend of citrus, floral and spice elements which make this an appealing fragrance.

product_title: Rochas Eau Sensuelle Eau de Toilette
review_text:
As pretty much anyone knows, evaluating a particular fragrance is entirely subjective and personal.  With that in mind, I quite like Rochas Eau Sensuelle and find it pleasantly fruity/floral with an appealing hint of spice to counteract and balance the sweetness.  The bouquet which is comprised of Rochas' signature white flowers plus mango and a smattering of dried fruit, is neither overwhelming nor cloying but as fresh and clean as a warm spring day.  And while its complexity certainly makes a statement, it's not so heavy that it can't be worn during the day as long as you take care not to apply it too lavishly.

To avoid over-application when using a spray bottle, rather than spraying it on myself directly, I prefer the old trick of lightly spritzing the air  and then walking into the cloud of fragrance.  I've never gone wrong with this technique.  You derive the subtle benefit of the lovely scent without stopping people in their tracks.

product_title: Rochas Eau Sensuelle Eau de Toilette
review_title: A good scent for the mature woman
review_text:
I really don't think I can describe the actual scent of this perfume as eloquently as other reviewers already have, so I will not try.  Instead, I'll say that in my mind, at least, this scent is one for a mature woman.  That is completely qualitative and my perception only, so take it for what it's worth, but to me, this scent belongs on a woman who is at least 30.

I'd also point out that 1 spritz seems perfectly adequate for you to carry a light scent so 1.6 oz should last a very long time (if it doesn't last you a long time, then some people you are sitting near may wish you had stretched it out more).  In my opinion, any perfume that can be sprayed should be applied as follows: spray 1 spritz slightly upward in the air in front of you, wait long enough to replace the lid and put the bottle down, then walk through the falling mist.  Done.  This works best with the mist is very fine.  This mist was pretty fine, but coarse enough that it fell a bit faster than other perfumes I've seen, so with this technique, the scent you carry will be very light indeed--some of you may wish to walk through sooner or even repeat, but since I strongly prefer any perfume on any person to be very light, it still worked fine for me.

Normally, I like to award stars on a quantitative basis.  In that case, this would earn at least 4... and perhaps 5--the bottle is attractive and the lid is secure, and the fineness/coarseness of the mist is not excellent but is certainly satisfactory.  However, in this case, I think it is more appropriate to rate based on the qualitative measure of how much I like the scent.  In that case, 4 seems pretty good... it is good but it's not my favorite.  Take that for what it's worth.

review_title: Clean light citrus accord leaning to vetiver.
review_text: At first spray immediately loved the crisp opening and then the dry down too. I have tried 4 Caron products, each very different, each spanning the decades, and all classics. This seems  to fit morning and midday wear on a hot day without too much of a statement and perhaps a weak and close skin scent. Perhaps the only issue is poor sillage and poor projection. Perfect in a profession where scents are not allowed or discouraged.  Also good in summer in tropics in high humidity. In that regard, it's the opposite end of the spectrum to Caron's Yatagan. It's a lemon vetiver fig smell that's clean and crisp, not aldehydelic, not with a candy-like midnote such as Caron's pour homme, and less sharp and less complex than Guerlain Imperial  which seems similar to on my wearing but at 2x the price. Although Yuzu has a slight vetiver accord, it's gentle, and far less spiced and less woodsy than a true vetiver such as Guerlain's latest reformulation of Vetiver and many others with a more smoke or forest floor accord.  Basenote experts are neutral on Yuzu elsewhere on that website. I  am not  taking off a point for poor projection and that it's not long lasting since that may, in theory, be an asset if want that  After a week use, I feel very good about the purchase. Nicely done.

product_title: JUDITH LEIBER Topaz Eau de Parfum Spray, 2.5 fl. Oz.
review_text:
The ORIGINAL scent named "Topaz" was marketed years ago by Avon for perfume, cologne, and body powders.  The trademark golden Topaz color was featured throughout.

The perfume had a rich golden color and the scent was intense, compelling, and lush.  Wonderful!!!

My description of this classic vintage scent is not exaggerated.  Avon's Topaz was heady and truly intoxicating.  Many in that day considered it to be a wasteful luxury due to its price when you could buy a bag a groceries for what Topaz cost.

Go Avon!  Wish you still offered it.  A pox on you for discontinuing it...probably for all the wrong reasons.

This scent?  Sorry, but Judith Leiber's perfume named "Topaz" is a total strike out.  It has a very complex scent, but it is also truly nasty.  It assaults the nose and offends the senses.

As a card carrying heterosexual male, I would absolutely and categorically refuse to date anyone who wore this scent - PERIOD.

And if my Mom (God rest her soul) had ever worn such a scent, I would probably have disowned her.

The Bottom Line:

I work with scents extensively and my nose is in great working condition.  I don't have a cold or seasonal allergies or a deviated septum.

A word to the wise: This scent is NOT a good one for a true lady.  Do NOT spend your hard earned cash on this "perfume" line.

Want to purchase a scent which is really, really so much better?  Remember that women are very scent oriented - maybe a survival strength and they do love perfume.

So, my recommendation is that you do a noble, a kind, a sweet thing for the lady(s) in your life:

Go with the classics - scents which have withstood the test of time...like Chanel No. 5 and the like.

Judith Leiber?  I would suggest that you surrender the name rights of this scent line back to Avon.

They did such a much better job than you.

Final score:  Avon 1, Judith Leiber, 0.

Review ends.

review_text:
Floral and fruity

This fragrance has summery floral and bright fruity notes complemented by lingering hints of vanilla and sandalwood.  It is assertive, but not aggressive or overwhelming.

It would be perfect for summer evenings in Florida, but as the decorations on the bottle might suggest, it is a distinctively youthful and sweet scent, much more suggestive of Miami Beach than West Palm Beach.

product_title: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy La Fleur, 2.5 fl Oz., perfume for women
review_text: This perfume is a pretty floral scent that is light and fresh. I think it smells great, and so do my teenage daughters. My older teen has been careful to tell me what a "young" fragrance it is, and I'm old enough to understand that she'd love for my bottle to migrate to her room. This won't be happening, though. The bottle will stay in my room where I can enjoy the lovely bottle and both girls will have equal access (until one kidnaps it and I have to perform a rescue mission). The only downside is that the fragrance isn't the longest lasting I've used -- it was gone after about five hours.  Plenty of time for a date, but if you're looking for something to last all day, understand you will need to reapply this scent or perhaps apply it in layers (lotion and perfume, for example).

product_title: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy La Fleur, 2.5 fl Oz., perfume for women
review_title: Sweet White Floral With Gourmand Notes
review_text:
This is a sweet gourmand, white floral.  It opens with a dose of sweet red berries, honeysuckle & caramel.  It's not sickly sweet but definitely sweet.  Background notes of jasmine, gardenia & orange brighten it & keep it from being just a fruity, sweet-bomb of goo.  The bottom notes of hyacinth & sandalwood give it some sophistication.  It's playful & sweet without being cloying.  If you like white flowers & sweet gourmand notes, you may like this fragrance.

The sillage is almost arm length.  But don't overspray - this has a tendency to be too much if you pile it on & it's not really going to last any longer.  You are better off just reapplying another spritz or two when it fades.  I believe it was designed to be worn as a close-up/intimate fragrance.

The lasting power is average - this disappears within 3 hours on my skin.  It is an EDT so that is not unexpected.

product_title: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy La Fleur, 2.5 fl Oz., perfume for women
review_title: Decent Floral Scent, Surprisingly not as Bold as We Expected
review_text:
We were a little surprised to find such a conservatively understated floral scent in such a jazzed up container. Juicy Couture sounds youthfully edgy, and the scent is rather mildly floral.  It's a decent scent, but I found it almost generic.  Especially when juxtaposed to such a glitzy bottle.  It almost seems like an entry level perfume for tweens.

But I don't want to knock it, just show my surprise for it's seemingly understated fragrance.  It is a decent floral perfume.

product_title: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy La Fleur, 2.5 fl Oz., perfume for women
review_title: Love this soft and flirty fragrance!
review_text:
Love it -- the only negative for some, may be that it seems to fade quicker than perfumes, but it is a toilette spray, and not as concentrated as a perfume. I actually prefer the toilette over another that is so strong that I can't stand to wear it until I rinse it off my wrists and allow what's left to linger on my skin.

I am very sensitive to most chemicals and other and fragrances -- this is one of the first that I have not only been able to tolerate, but that I actually like! Both my son's, 16 & 21 even sniff tested for me and liked it, as well as our highly sensory daughter - she loved it! We even put a spritz on a couple of her favorite stuffed animals so she could enjoy it too.

Beautiful, soft, sexy and playful - love it!  (reviewed by my wife, I don't use perfume much ;-)

product_title: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy La Fleur, 2.5 fl Oz., perfume for women
review_text:
Sparkling, sensual fragrances. Mandarin, wild berries, honeysuckle, gardenia petals, and soft jasmine. Charms with luminous florals, mandarin, and berries plus creamy gourmand.

I was surprised by this perfume!! I always thought of Juicy Couture for the "younger" crowd but was pleasantly surprised by the scent. It's light and not overpowering. Perfect for spring or summer when it's warmer and you don't want to wear heavy scents. My only complaint is that it doesn't last all day, Spray it on in the morning and by afternoon, it's faded. product_title: Juliette Has A Gun Universal Purse Spray (PERFUME NOT INCLUDED)
review_text:
I really like this perfume container. It has a good weight to it and feels expensive. I have had mine for two years, I bought it at the same time that I bought Juliet Has a Gun "Not a Perfume" and do not regret either purchase at all. I was worried that the metal would eventually get discolored or look cheap but I have had this in my purse non stop for two years and it still looks brand new from the outside.

The only problems I have had with this perfume container is that the cap doesn't seem to have a super snug fit and the inside of the bullet is made of glass. The cap comes off really easily which isn't a huge deal because this in no way makes the perfume leak, it is just something to look out for because the cap could get lost. The inside of the bullet being glass was more problematic. After being in my purse for such a long time, it must have gotten banged around because the inside of the bullet cracked and pieces of glass started floating around in the perfume. I still use the bullet but as the glass continues to break off inside the container, I worry that eventually the glass at the top (where the spritz part screws onto the bottle) will also break and I will no longer be able to use the perfume container. I absolutely love this product but I don't know that I could rationalize spending another $35 on something that isn't really necessary.

review_text:
Scent: This is a very dark and alluring fragrance. It's Sexy yet sophisticated and cool. This smells like the coolest most mysterious guy in the room. Who everyone wants to get to know but very few are close to him. He has this aura of sexiness and curiosity about him that draws people in, but also keeps them at a social distant because he is more elevated in status than the people around him. Very amazing creation, it definitely takes a certain type of guy to pull it off but if you can this will be your signature scent, it's that amazing. Great for fun occasions like dates or nights out, and also formal occasions when you want to smell respectable, sophisticated, and high-class. Scent Scores 10/ 10

Performance: Easy on the spray, this one is a beast of a fragrance. You gotta tame it, only 1-2 sprays at most for the warmer season, 3 max for the colder season. It last on my skin for at least 9 hours and projects very nicely for about 2-3 hours. Projection is just right, it's not too overpowering but not too subtle, you will get notice, while not putting off anyone if you don't over spray. Performance Score: 10/ 10

Compliment Factor: This is very very sexy and for the right situation, it's an absolute killer. But for some situation it might not fit too well. Like if you wear it at the beach you probably won't get any compliments because people think you are strange for wearing a dark fragrance to the beach. But for the right situation, compliment factors are very high. I love wearing this one, it's such a confident booster for me. Great stuff. Compliment Scores: 9/ 10

product_title: L'Occitane Woody Eau des Baux Eau de Toilette for Men, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_title: Amazing, intoxicating smell for a man
review_text:
So-This isn't a review of a product I purchased via Amazon, this is a review of the product itself. I purchased my bottle at a small L'Occitane shop in my local mall. It was a gift for my man. And I would buy it again and again and again-and I hope he never opts to wear any other cologne.

(For frame of reference, we're in our early 40s-and we're not fancy people. I think my man owns 1 obligatory long-sleeved, button-down dress shirt-and somewhere I believe he has 1 tie, too.

We do appreciate the finer things in life, but we're not generally the type of people who spend much money on things we consider silly-like men's cologne.

That being said, I absolutely love this scent. I dream about it-and I'm glad more men don't wear it, because it clicks some funny little pheremone button in me.

I couldn't possibly describe the scent accurately-that's the manufacturer's job anyhow-but I will explain what the scent reminds me of, as best as I can. Hopefully, if you're a person like me wants to linger anywhere you find these sorts of smells, this will be a little helpful.

To me, it reminds me of warm vanilla, pipe tobacco, leather, spicy sawdust, sweet bay and some nice woods and maturity. It also reminds me a little of a good scotch, but mostly-it's scent is reminiscent of a dark, rich, Anejo tequila. Not like Don Julio Anejo. Deeper & richer & better than Don Julio Anejo (with much respect).

I can also tell you this lingering scent makes me want to hold him close-constantly.

I've read a number of reviews written by men who say they don't think the scent lasts very long. My experience says the opposite.  Again, just for reference, I'll share how it's used in my house. My man is of the opinion that one man should never smell another person's scent. He believes the only time he should smell a woman's perfume is if he's within a foot or 2 of her, and he believes he should never smell another man's cologne. Thus, he hits the atomizer twice, and then walks into the spray-he NEVER sprays himself.

The cologne is applied once-in the morning after shower-and when he gets home from work 12 hours later, I can absolutely still smell it on him-as long as I am very close. It's a warm, intimate & mature smell that wouldn't have the same effect if it was worn heavily.

Really, the best review I can think to give this cologne is this: my surly, impossible to please 18 year old daughter & I were out shopping one day. We were in the L'Occitane store & saw some man browsing through their men's cologne samples. My daughter watched him for a few minutes & then walked over to this stranger, took this bottle in her hand & told the man "This one. This is the one you should buy".

product_title: Penhaligon's Gardenia Eau de Toilette, 3.4 fl. oz.
review_title: Lovely Gardenia, White Flowers With A Hint of Vanilla & Spice
review_text:
This is a beautiful fragrance.  It's ladylike, classy & sexy in a pretty way.  It opens with a fresh, green gardenia that smells real, not synthetic.  There are more white flowers; a fresh green tuberose, lovely jasmine, bright/zingy lily of the valley & orange blossoms.  Then more fresh flowers - hyacinth, ylang-ylang, a tiny violet & a bit of rose.  Very complex & in balance.  Underlying this flower garden is a light spice which makes it sexy.  I smell  vanilla, sandalwood & a touch of cinnamon.  There is nothing cloying & fake smelling, no fake, sugar-sweet fruit & no dirty smells.

This would be a lovely wedding day fragrance or any day fragrance.  I like to wear this casual & dressed up.  It is instant happiness & mood lifting when I wear this.  I think this is a fragrance for many different ages.  It is classic and isn't trying to chase a trend.

The sillage is arm length & a bit beyond.  One or two spritz are enough.  This lasts most of the day on my skin becoming more of a skin scent as the day goes on.

I bought mine from Penhaligon's.

review_title: Some brands will play on my skin like a perfect orchestra
review_text:
It is a generally a rare circumstance when I encounter a fragrance that works so well with my skin chemistry and expresses so clearly all my peculiarities and confidences that when I do accidentally fall in loveI knew it had to be fate.

Due to the finicky nature of perfumes (scent association, environmental conditions, the individuals own physical makeup), I strongly believe that it is the fragrance that picks the wearer not the other way around. How a scent behaves and the exhilarating feeling that follows is completely up to the ingredients and whether or not it will complement your body.

Some brands will play on my skin like a perfect orchestra, whereas others just sit there stubborn and unwilling.

A perfect example was when I first tried on Dark Obsession by Calvin Klein; this fragrance is just so darn good that I felt I have found the perfect scent for my fall collection. There is just so much going on here: a thick accord of espresso, chocolate, soft leather, and smoke. This is a walk through dark mysterious woods with your jacket collar propped up against your ears, you see a tiny little house and enter ita whiff of dark coffee, spices and tobacco assaults your sensessuddenly you are at home, safewarm, comforting.

I sense so much of Tom Fords Tobacco & Vanille in this blend, the guarana and vanilla are so expertly synchronized that the appearance of suede and balsam firs appeared natural and expected. There is nothing here offensive or uninviting.

Overall a masterpiece in my mind; but like I have stated, this perfume is not for everyone. Hubby has tried on Dark Obsession and to my nose he does not project the same harmonious results that I fell in love with. The smell was off by a hair; that velvety blend got lost in a cocktail of scent fragments that never seemed to fit in anywhere; in fact some people find that there are no chocolates or coffee in this perfume at all. I was disappointed but also relieved; I guess this will be my personal fragrance after all. =]

For the price and quality, I would recommend this one over Tobbaco & Vanille. It would be an adventure in gourmand heaven, and an unforgettable experience.

Top Notes
Mandarin/ Guarana/ Wormwood

Middle Notes
Clary Sage /Fir /Vetiver

Base Notes
Labdanum /Vanilla /Suede

review_text: I was looking for a light, summery fragrance and found this one among the Crabtree & Evelyn selections at an apothecary in my neighborhood.  I tested it on my wrist, and it seemed to fit the description perfectly -- delicate, green, citrus-y, like fresh flowers blooming on the margin of a stream -- so I didn't hesitate to purchase it.  When I began to use it, however, I discovered that it lacked one very important factor in a fragrance:  staying power.  Only a few minutes after applying it, the scent faded into oblivion.  I tried using several more sprays, but it was still undetectable within a very short time.  A pity, as Somerset Meadow is a lovely fragrance -- but it's just too ephemeral to be worth the price.

review_title: Mature, maybe not an ideal gift...
review_text:
Carven Le Parfum has a pretty enough scent, unfortunately it is not for me. It has quite a mature feel for it, while I thought I'd like it based on the description, unfortunately in real life it reminded me of something my grandmother would have worn. Again, not to say it isn't a pretty scent! It's just not one I would ever wear, as a mother of three in my early thirties. It's fancy and mature, for sure.

The bottle is simple and pretty, the label looks like plain paper, and there is a ribbon coming out of the top. The glass on the bottle is frosted, while the topper is glossy. The scent is strong and has a good longevity.

One complaint, and I realize this is more of a shipping issue, but my perfume box came dented on all corners as they shipped it in a bubble envelope. I am not giving fewer stars for this, but I am mentioning it because I feel that if you are looking for a perfume to give as a gift, you *might* be disappointed if this arrives with the corners dented like mine were.

review_text: Perfumes react differently on different people and individual preferences are just that - individual.  A review based on one person's experience with a scent then is by it's very nature subjective.  On me this was a light and rather flowery scent with some deeper spicy notes.  I liked this as a casual, daytime scent.  It was lighter than the Estee Lauder Beautiful that is my usual winter scent although a bit stronger than the EL White Linen that I prefer for summer.

product_title: Laura Biagiotti Essenza Di Roma Eau de Toilette for Women, 0.84 fl. oz.

product_title: Laura Biagiotti Essenza Di Roma Eau de Toilette for Women, 0.84 fl. oz.
review_text:
Essenza di Roma is a very heavy scent. It reminds me to a great extent of the Eternity perfume. Both of these are what my coworker calls elevator chokers - meaning, if you have someone wearing this first thing in the morning and they get on a crowded elevator, the scent engulfs and overpowers everyone around them.

I sprayed a short spritz on my wrist and neck, let it dry and then put on a turtleneck, which, when I smelled it the next day, it still smelled as strong as it did the day before.
Frankly one of my favorite scents is almond based which this one says, it has "Layers of vanilla and almond'. I could discern no trace of that, instead it is a musky fragrance - nice for people who like that, but I certainly hope no one sits beside me in a theater or restaurant wearing this - it's just too strong.

product_title: Laura Biagiotti Essenza Di Roma Eau de Toilette for Women, 0.84 fl. oz.
review_title: A little on the strong side at first but mellows down quite nicely
review_text: My wife and daughter both love this scent. My teen daughter says it smells like cherry blossoms. To me it seems like  a sharply sweet smell with a hint of vanilla.  It's a versatile scent that can be worn just about anywhere. It's a little on the heavy side, so it's more of a cold weather scent to me. I don't think it would play nicely with high heat and humidity but I could be wrong. I have to wait at least three more months to find out.  The heaviness is why I'm not a fan of the scent when my wife first sprays it on (too strong and generic smelling initially). However, after it has had a chance to settle in and mix with her body chemistry, it actually smells quite nice. I even find myself enjoying the subtle lingering aroma that she leaves behind right after she walks away. It's a good scent but my wife has other scents that really blow me away. I'd personally rate this three stars but she and my daughter really like it. It's a women's perfume, so the women's opinions outweigh mine.

review_text:
I have fallen in love with this perfume since I felt it on my Godmother. She visited us and after she left this sweet enchanting aroma stayed in the room and the armchair smelled divine even the next day. Then my mother bought the same perfume and when I came home my mom's scarf smelled with chocolate and roses. It had this fragrance even after I washed it. So I realized I need this perfume as it became our family signature fragrance.
The perfume arrived on time, nicely packaged in a nice black pouch, also the seller added a nice bonus of a sample of men's perfume of Montale.
The only drawback is that the golden sprayer head keeps falling off, which is annoying.
I still play with this perfume, still it surprises me, as it develops differently on me depending of temperature, humidity and even food I eat and clothes I wear. I will later add my experience with this perfume to this review.

No worries, however, you won't feel like you've just dusted your whole body with Johnson's Baby Powder, rather the mild powdery hint just adds a gentle softness that's really alluring.  Perfect for day or evening...and no headaches.

review_title: but give a nice clean scent
review_text: This is one of those fresh laundry/clean linen colognes that don't smell original at all, aren't very strong, but give a nice clean scent. Very inoffensive, and warm smelling. I'm not a fan of these scents personally, I prefer aquatics and more sporty fresh scents, but I still appreciate this here. If you have ever smelled Lanvin, this almost smells identical to it. It smells like toned down fabric softener. If you rubbed "clean linen" scented fabric softener, that is exactly what this would be. I almost prefer Lanvin, because Burberry Touch smells slightly more feminine. Both are woodsy and a little floral. Like I said.. think "clean linen" dryer sheets and bingo. I would wear this cologne during colder months moreso than spring/summer. I don't think these fragrances are supposed to be very in-your-face. Be careful not to overspray it, because you easily can. Just accept that it's more of a subtle scent and you'll be fine. It sits pretty close to your skin.

Use this cologne and just wait for the ladies to compliment how good you smell. Not everyone can be a ladies man naturally like me, for those who can't, GET THIS COLOGNE!
Don't confuse this w/ the aftershave w/ same name, Burberry aftershave is a good, albeit, different scent.

review_title: VERY nice way to introduce both fragrances economically...
review_text: I am NOT a huge rollerball fan (the scent usually wears off way too quickly), but I bought this one to sample BOTH these fragrances (hard to find the NOIR version in anything except on it's own).  I LOVE THEM!  Out of all the Juicy Couture fragrances, I think these 2 are the best.  The funny thing is...I noticed after about an hour, they basically smelled identical after drying down.  I also realized (after my husband made the observation):  They BOTH smell interchangeably like "Noir Tease" (Sexy Little Things) from Victoria's Secret, which I already had in a limited edition (ie: gorgeous) bottle!  Because the prices for the Juicy Couture are SO high (really, I mean, my Estee Lauder Sensuous Nude and Calvin Klein Down Town cost even less...not mention the "Noir Tease" runs about $45USD per bottle while the "Viva La Juicy Noir" runs about $70USD per bottle), I will stick with the Victoria's Secret.  That little fact aside, I give this product a full 5 star rating because it is a great way to sample 2 amazing fragrances and it's portable.  I have been wearing them over my Bath & Body Works Vanilla Bean Noel body cream (both fragrances have a strong vanilla note in them after the initial fruit note dries down) and it's PERFECT.  It ends up a lovely subtle warm scent...not too fruity and not floral at all (I hate hate hate perfumes with ANY hint of floral at all...just personal taste and tendency toward migraines triggered by florals).  I do recommend trying this 2-for-1 if you're tempted toward these scents.  Great for year round, but awesome in winter because of the vanilla base (who knew).  These do have the pick-me-up effect of a clean fruity top note while drying down to delightfully warm base.  Fun yet mature at the same time!

review_title: This is my favorite fragrance. I am very familiar with it
review_text: This is my favorite fragrance.  I am very familiar with it.  Though I am not an expert in perfume development, I do know differences between eau de parfum, eau de toilette, and parfume versions.  This product defies any of those classifications and not for the better.  While I read many reviews, including high, medium and low on Amazon , I decided to order through Amazon because I rarely have had a problem with them.  While this is labeled eau de parfum, is boxed as such, and indicates it was made in France, it is not the classic Burberry perfum that I have used as recently as September 2017 (not through Amazon)..  Some clothing I wore during the fall still has that fragrance.  The one from Amazon is not that fragrance.  Additionally, there is no fragrance, nothing within10 minutes !  Not on my skin, not on my clothing, nothing.  It shocked me.  I don't know  what quality control measures Amazon has in place for checking its products prior to accepting them for sale, but something is very wrong.  I do not believe that Burberry changed its formula for this fragrance  and markets it under the Burberry Classic name since last fall.  Does anyone know?  I will not purchase fragrance from Amazon in future, and this has reduced my trust in them overall.

review_text: I've been a Juliette Has A Gun fan since this niche brand first established a presence in the perfume market. What impresses me about this fragrance is that it's fun, but mature, lacking the cloying quality of many perfumes on the market. Well balanced and subtle, this is a versatile fragrance I would find acceptable on all women of all ages. It has a low throw, making it good for work, yet the sillage is insane. review_title: citrus notes disappear quickly for me; musk and wood last longer
review_text:
I've been trying this perfume out for a little over a week and I'm a fan.  It's probably not my favorite perfume ever, but it is definitely something I can see myself using on occasion.

I like the way this works with my body chemistry.  The citrus notes (for me) disappear fairly quickly.  The musk and wood scents (especially the musk) are much longer-lasting.  However, they do lose a bit of strength after a few hours, so you might want to reapply on occasion.

I can *almost* buy this as a unisex fragrance, but not quite.  It is still more feminine than masculine to me.  But again, different people's body chemistries may interact with it differently.  It seems to be freely available in sample sizes, though, and that would be the ideal way to try it out before committing to a full bottle.

As with any fragrance purchase, please check seller feedback carefully.  Unfortunately, large bottles of perfume are somewhat likely to be counterfeit.  But if the feedback is good, that indicates a higher likelihood of a positive outcome for your transaction!

review_title: Long Lasting Parfum. Sweet Floral/Vanilla Tones.
review_text:
Juicy Couture Viva La Noir Eau de Partum is marketed for evening & special occasion wear.  It boasts that it will embody the woman who is dangerous - but in a good way.  While I'm not quite sure what that means, I can say that a little spray of this Juicy partum will grab you by your senses and will continue to provide a strong scent for quite a long time - even if the skin area gets wet.

Scent-wise, this partum is suppose to have floral top notes and vanilla & candlewood lower notes.  I expected to smell more mandarin (dangerous, right?), but my nose says gardenia & vanilla come through the most.

If you are a Juicy fan, then you know what scent you are purchasing and how the scent interacts with your body. For those buying without smelling, this Juicy scent is a very sweet, floral/vanilla scent more than a musky mandarin scent.

product_title: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Noir Women's Perfume
review_text:
Juicy Couture Viva La Noir is incredibly impressive right out of the box. It comes in a beautiful pink bottle with a clear crystal-like cap, and beautiful black satin bow.  It's very feminine and gorgeous, a bottle any girly girl would love adding to their collection.

At first I wasn't sure I was going to like the scent. It's a very full blossoming scent with berries, vanilla, caramel, and sandalwood. At first glance, I thought this fragrance went on a bit heavy, but the more I tried to figure out what the notes were in this fragrance, the more I liked it. I wasn't sure I was smelling caramel, I've never smelled that in a fragrance, but sure enough, it does have vanilla and caramel notes. What you first smell is juicy berries, which was new for me. I normally go for light  floral scents . . .  Victoria's Secret, Bombshell, another VS which unfortunately is no longer made, Dream Angel Wish, and my absolute favorite go to fragrance, Philosophy, Falling in Love. But what those three all have in common is they don't last at all, much to my dismay.  Viva La Noir lasts far longer, becoming lighter and more floral as the day goes on. Applied to my neck, hair, and wrists, the scent lasts about 4 hours before I felt like I could use a light re-application.

This is a really pretty scent which could be worn by just about anyone - from late teens to mature women. If you aren't sure whether or not you like it at first, explore it a bit. Trying to figure out what's in the mix might give you an appreciation for the subtle complexities of this lovely fragrance.

I recommend Juicy Couture Viva La Noir to any woman looking for a new fragrance to jazz up her collection.

product_title: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Noir Women's Perfume
review_text:
Let's see.  The product page says this perfume embodies "the woman who is dangerous in a good way."  That, I guess, eliminates use by hired gunwomen, embezzlers, double-agent spies, traitors, and ... me.  I'm just not dangerous, in either good or bad ways, and, in addition, this perfume is not a good fit for me.

Not exactly the fault of the perfume.  It has some pleasant notes of honeysuckle, berries, gardenia and sandalwood, to name a few of the floral and fruity fragrances.  But I find the caramel and vanilla bottom notes to be too strong and the overall impression the perfume leaves on me is of almost excessive sweetness.  I prefer a cleaner, woodier, more citrusy fragrance.  My very favorite perfume even has hints of leather and tobacco to it.

So what was I doing getting this to try out?  Well, in my defense, I didn't think it would be quite so sweet and was expecting more floral notes to it.  The good news is that I was able to "regift" this to a family member who enjoys the fragrance.  So all's well and that ends well.

review_title: Surprisingly mature, a touch too strong
review_text:
I typically (perhaps prejudicially) consider Juicy Couture to be the province of too young girls trying to pretend they're a bit older (tweens and young teens pretending that they are young adults. Perhaps to my surprise, this fragrance didn't reflect that belief. Rather than being overwhelming and juvenile, this perfume has a nice mix of floral and fruity notes. While this could easily become really overwhelming, it doesn't. It's somewhat tempered with vanilla and caramel tones. I can imagine this being fine for women at almost any age (past that awkward tween phase). It does lack the complexity and the depth of a nicer fragrance, something that you'd wear to a charity event, for example. But for a night in the club, this will probably suit quite nicely.

I do recommend being judicial in your use. Probably not a perfume that is appropriate for office wear.  Your mileage may vary, but I'd suggest that you spray a cloud and then walk through it, rather than actually spraying it on yourself. Otherwise, you're likely to overdo it.

product_title: Juicy Couture Malibu, 2.5 fl Oz., perfume for women
review_text:
My wife really liked this perfume.
She usually wears most floral scents, that are light and crisp.  She usually avoids heavy musk and sweet overtones.

She does enjoy Royal Doulton and Dolce Vita.

This perfume was subtle with the passion fruit and only just a hint of musk.  She loved it and used the perfume every day for at least a week.  Strangers would ask her what she was wearing and if it was new.  She smelled nice.  She applied the scent to her wrists and some into the air as a "walk-through".

The only drawback is the pink-ish plastic heart on the bottle.  She easily got past it, but it was an unusual feature to add to the bottle.  So far the scent was perfect

product_title: Juicy Couture Malibu, 2.5 fl Oz., perfume for women
review_text:
the tagline for this says that its "great for everyday wear".

I would agree with that sentiment.  Its scent is very light, and to me, it seems like it works really great in the springtime or in the summer, because of its citrus smell.  The bottle is a bit off-putting, because its that familiar "juicy couture" overblown shabby chic kind of appeal.  But the fragrance itself is really nice.  Its clean and citrusy, not sweet nor musky.

Definitely a good gift for any young woman, or to buy for yourself.

product_title: Juicy Couture Malibu, 2.5 fl Oz., perfume for women
review_text:
This perfume comes in an attractive bottle with a little plastic heart, nice enough. It has a fresh, citrus based scent which I think most will like. Not over-powering at all, light and fresh smelling. It seems to last well enough. Certainly good for an evening out or a day trip. It comes in an attractive box and I think this would make a nice gift item and would be especially popular with the younger set, though I think anyone may well enjoy it.

You get a reasonable amount (2.5 ozs) for a reasonable price.

product_title: Juicy Couture Malibu, 2.5 fl Oz., perfume for women
review_text: Juicy Couture Malibu perfume is described as having passion fruit, sparkling jasmine, and sensual musk.  My perfume preference is either very clean or fruity (but not sweet) smelling.  I normally don't like "perfumey" smells or perfumes that contain musk, amber, sandalwood, etc.  As a reference, my favorites are Clinique Happy, different versions of Bobbi Brown (Beach and Bath), and several different Clean brand scents.  I couldn't resist on the Juicy Couture Malibu because of the passion fruit in the description.  It is very fruity (but not sweet) smelling at first.  It then becomes more floral and musk smelling with a little bit of the fruit smell.  The musk isn't enough to turn me off from it like other musky scents do.  I'm in my 40s, and I really like this scent.  The Malibu scent lasts for a decent amount of time (I spray it once in the air to get it on my hair and once on a wrist to rub with the other).  It's gone from my wrists by the end of the day because of washing my hands, but I can still smell it in my hair when it swings.  Personally, I think the bottle looks kind of cheesy.  Well, not the bottle itself, but the plastic heart attached to the lid.

product_title: Juicy Couture La La Malibu Eau de Toilette Spray
review_text:
This is another very new and "now" fragrance that has the Juicy Couture signature youthful, girly, fruity blend that so many of us love.  Gone are the days of ancient bouquets of jasmine and rose, replaced with man made fruit scents that are for your nose what Skittles are for your taste buds.

To the fruit bowl this one adds the beguiling scent of surf and sand with the "water" addition that I am fond of in scents.  Yes it is beachy.  Fruit punch on the beach with your toes in the sand.  A strawberry margarita and sunscreen.  And if driftwood has a scent, as the perfumers who concoct the thousands of newer scents in the lab would have us believe, we are right next to a big pile of driftwood, some of it charred and damp from last night's rained out bonfire on the beach.

This also has the glittery scent of nouveau riche polish with the addition of white musk and amber, making this a much more interesting blend than some of the pure fruit salads Juicy Couture has been famous for.  Men find all of the scents from this company amazingly sexy I have noticed.  Sophisticated, subtle, not at all.  In your face with the cherries, melons and berries all the way, but in a fresh and happy way.

People love Juicy Couture scents even more than the handbags and clothing line, because this company intimately knows and understands their target customers.  They are young, have money, and love Skittles.

review_title: Has a subtle scent that is pleasant and not overpowering.
review_text:
This product has been a refreshing change. Due to having migraines, asthma, and a VERY sensitive nose, my girlfriend is generally unable to wear most scents. With the BURBERRY Body Tender, Eau de Toilette, however, she found she could apply small amounts of it to places generally not near her face (on the small of her back, I believe), and it didn't cause any reaction. She's pleased because she LOVES the Burberry fragrance and says it make her feel "sexy". I wholeheartedly agree with her assessment!

It has a subtle citrusy, floral scent that smells clean and fresh. Over time it seems to smell more like sandalwood and musk, but never too heavy. The scent lasts much of the day, though she says she will occasionally apply a bit more in the evening if we're going out.

The fragrance comes in an interesting, tall, narrow, octagonal pink/mauve box, and the bottle within is heavy glass in the same narrow octagonal design, with a silver cap. It looks very classy on a dressing table.

Overall a great, high quality fragrance from a premium brand, with the commensurate premium price, which is the only thing I'm critical of. It's Made in France, BTW.

**** RECOMMENDED! - 4 STAR ****

review_title: Intoxicating scent. I can't stop smelling myself!
review_text:
Every now and again I like to order new fragrances. This one seemed interesting based on the reviews. Once I received it (and a few others), this quickly, QUICKLY, became my favorite of the new batch. My nose is terrible at identifying scents, but it knows what it likes, as when a scent intoxicates me, I know it's for me. It's not overpowering, but not subtle. It lasts all day on me, and I can still smell it in the morning (but it's very, very faint and subtle by then, but very pleasant to wake up to). The first day I wore it into the office, my coworkers' response was pretty much "Woah, did you get a new cologne?" (they know I love fragrances). Why yes, yes I did. But it didn't overpower them at all, they merely noticed it because it was different.

I've had a lot of fragrances over the years (this one was the Eau de Parfum, btw), from Armani, Dolce & Gabbana, Creed, Tom Ford, Atelier, Burberry, Cartier, Chanel, Givenchy (I'm checking my order history right now to remember some of them) and others. This is up there as a great every day fragrance that you can wear on date night or to the office, without breaking the bank. I'd definitely buy it again.

The bottle I got from Amazon seems authentic and smells the same as the one I saw in the store, so I'm happy about that. The packaging was also pretty nice, not your usual simple cardboard box. :)

product_title: English Laundry Tahitian Waters Eau de Parfum
review_text:
For two consecutive days, I have chosen fragrances by English Laundry  yesterday, it was Arrogant and today, Tahitian Waters This line is very underrated in the fragrance industry and Tahitian Waters is a Summer gem

TW is an EDP that is a beautiful composition of floral, fruity, and woodsy notes with a coconut finish.  The end result is an extraordinary fragrance that leaves the user breathing in the air around them most of the day.  There is much discussion and comparison to Creeds Virgin Island Water, and yes there is a bit of shared DNA, but each has its own identity and both are great fragrances.  Creed is my favorite fragrance line and in a class all by itself, but I will add that English Laundry (and Tahitian Waters) deserve credit and offer a great alternative.

Given TW is an EDP, I got rock-star performance today, lasting 8+ hours on me, even longer on clothing, all at greater than arms length distance projection/sillage.  While geared more for Spring and Summer wear, TW can easily be worn (occasionally) to remind the user of the past Summer or a time spent in the South Pacific relaxing in a hammock under the shade of palm trees, and sipping on a sun downer.  In my opinion, TW is best suited for day wear and for more casual outdoorsy events  I did modestly apply TW this morning prior to going into an office environment  it worked well, but be easy on the trigger Presentation of any English Laundry Fragrance is first class and matched by few designer fragrances.  Finally, TW has been discontinued, and thus, a little more challenging to find.  As a result, the price is going up.  sometimes, I get frustrated with the laws of supply and demand..!!

All said, my final tally of Tahitian Waters is 4.5 stars out of 5 stars.  If you can find it, this fragrance is definitely worth adding to your collection.  Whether you use it as a go-to Summer fragrance, or to reminisce about a favorite memory, you will not be disappointed adding TW to your collection.  Enjoy your day and happy fragrance hunting
